tei:div.tei:p: / oṃ swā sti/ da ni sngar gyi 'phros las bshad na/ 'di skabs rje 'gyur med dang lan kha yar mjal byung*/ shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul du mdzad/ rang re'i rtsom pa la yang thugs dad gus 'khrungs tshul gnang gin 'dugade nas re zhig phyogs der 'gro don yang 'phran skabs su bab pa de tsam gyis chog shes par byas/ phugs kyi dbyings dang rtag brling khel ba ni gang byas kyang dka' bar gda'/ jo nang gi phyogs su chas te 'ongs pa'i tshe/ zhabs drung lcam sring gis dpal ldan sdings su skyel thung tsam mdzad/ de nub seng ge lung du sleb/ lha rtser zhag po gnyis bsdad/ de kun tu ltas kyang 'tshub par byung*/ / jo nang tu sleb 'phral nas lo dus kyi 'khrid btsugs/ de skabs zab don gyi bstan pa dar bar 'gyur pa la lhongs kyi rnam pa dang*/ yon bdag la'ang sku dog dar ba'i rnam 'gyur la zir bun byung ba ni/ snga sor snga mo nas bu legs pa zer ba kho pas/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pa'i sku thog nas gzung*/ 'di bar du jo nang pa la gnod pa 'ba' zhig byed cing*/ kha bkod bcug pa'i dgon 'khris rang du ri dwags rngon pa dang*/ grwa rigs rnams kyi rgyags zhing 'phrog pa dang*/ lam du rdung ba dang*/ mchod thes kyi mchod gzhis rnams la gnod pa kho na byed pa rgyun mi chad byung 'dugares 'ga' zla gcig gi nang du lan gnyis gsum gyi zos mi bde yang byung*/ jo nang pa'i phyogs khas zhan pas sdug sna dgu btang ba'i nad ma theg pa dang*/ rkyen chos gzhis kyi zhing 'ga' zhig btsan phrogs byas/ slar sprod dgos kyi don la/ sde srid kyi phyag dam mi sna zhus shing gnang ba yin kyang byang pa'i g.yog po la la dpon po la rtsi mi dgos/ ma brtsis pa de la ka dpon po rang yang dga' 'gro ba'i srol cig kyang yod/ kho pas lha rtse rdzong dpon ltag khur gyis phyag dam dang mi sna la kha skyengs btang*/ de'i kham mchu'i lab la chad gzi ba phan tshun tshig rkyen ma theg pa'i 'thab mo byung*/

kho pa thal song la shor/ de 'phral ngam ring du dgongs sangs zhu bar btang 'dug na'ang*/ mnga' bdag drung gi dgongs sangs yang ma bzhes/ lha rtse rdzong pas jo nang gi chos gzhis them pa bcu lhag cig la gtsang gzhung gi dmag chen bsdus/ dang po nas byang pa'i dmag skya 'thor la jag pa byung ba'i gtam dpe gcig la/ nag mo dpon to la dang zhus nas dmag cig 'ong gi zer ba de dngos su lag len la bkal/ me rgyag shing bshu byas/ de rjes rtses len dang mchod gzhis grong pa rnams la/ jo nang pa dang kha lab mi byed pa'i mna' bkag thel tshe bsdus pa yang rting la bskyas tshang gtib pa sogs dran tshad lag tu bkal/ 'di dus kyi lha rtse rdzong dpon e bdag po dang*/ nor rgyas pa tshe ba sprel ma'i skabs yin/ de lo zir bun gyi sgang yin kyang jo nang du khrid gsar ba mang zhing btsun gsar byed mkhan yang mang*/ dam po 'debs pa dang khrid gtor gyi bar thams cad bar chad kyi dbang du ma btang bar sngar las kyang rgyas pa tsam du byung*/ jo nang sgrub sde rang la'ang*/ dmag sang yong gnangs yong gi sdigs sdigs byed skabs/ / nged rang sku 'bum gyi rdo rje gdan na sdod skabs yin zhing*/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub pa la zhugs/ de'i bya ba rnams 'dzol med du byed cing ngag ni sgrub pa'i bzlas pa la brtson par yod nyin gcig sems ni skyo shas shin tu che/ da dgon gnas 'di bzung yang bstan pa spyi sgos gang la yang mi phan par 'dugade bas zar zir 'di la chod 'doms shig byung ma thag dgon gnas 'di dag gzhan 'dzin skyong byed pa thams cad kyang bor te mi med lung stong 'grim zhing chos brgyad dang ma 'dres pa'i sgrub pa kho na byed snyam pa lhang lhang ba yod pa'i skabs/ tho rang gi cha gcig thog ma rdo rje gdan nyid na bzhugs pa'i kun mkhyen chen po'i sku 'dra de ka yin snyam pa la/ sku dngos su gyur nas zhal ras skya me re ba zhal tshom dkar po cung zad yod snyam pa spyan lta stangs can dbu zhwa na bza' bzhugs gdan sogs spyi mthun 'di ka shin tu gsal ba de mthong ma thag tu/

sngar gyi dge sbyor gyi shugs ni je che la mnyam nyid du gyur/ 'phral snang cha blo mi bde ba de yang rtsa ba nas sangs nas dga' yal yal ba bde cham cham pa cig byung zhing*/ de'i zhal nas nga'i bstan pa la phan thogs yod du nye bar sleb na mi byed dam/ / da nas je bzang du 'gyur bas spro ba bskyed gsung ba cig byung*/ de nas kyang lo shas ni cang ma byung ste phyis rim pas yong ba la dgongs par 'dug yang de'i phyi nub kun mkhyen chen po la gsol ba btab pas/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags yin snyam pa mdo bkod dang mthun pa'i rnam pa lha'i sku can zhig byon te/ rnam par bzhag bya 'jog byed dang*/ rnam gzhag thams cad rdzun pa yin/ / blo la snang ba 'khrul pa ste/ / bden pa'i don la gos pa med/ / gsung pa zhig byung bas/ de tsam kho nas kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed pa gzhan stong gi grub mtha'i gting sleb/ the tshom dang gol sa thams cad chod/ chos sgo mtha' dag 'byed pa'i lde mig chen po lag tu 'ongs bar gyur to/ / yang bdag gi sems la/ brgyud pa'i bka' babs 'di la/ byin rlabs don gyi brgyud pa kun mkhyen chen po la dngos su thob kho bo brgyud thag re nye snyam pa yang yang byung bas/ rmi lam du brgyud pa la nye ring med/ sems sems nyid la thim pa yin mod zer ba zhig byung bas sngar gyi 'dzin pa rlom sems de yang dbyings su yal/ 'di skabs kyang zhag bdun song nas dam rdzas la sgra chen po btud mar byung ba dang bdud rtsi 'babs pa sogs byung*/ mtshams grol nas de'i rtogs brjod kyi tshul tu gzhan stong dbu ma'i rgyan gyi tshigs bcad dang*/ de'i lung sbyor yi ger bkod/ de skabs byang gtsang sku nye sbrel skabs yin/ ltas rten 'brel legs po ye mi 'dugade la phan thabs bcos byed rgyu phran bu 'dug ste gnyis thad nas bcol gtogs mi 'dug pas kha rog bsdad/ 'di skabs dpon sa rin mo ches/

gdong dga' ba la yon mchod bar gyi legs lam gyi thabs kyis gsungs 'dug na'ang khong pas ma mdzad/ de mthun nged la gleng bar chos rje dkon blo ba ched bsdad byung*/ de nas dpon sa rin mo che rang du dgongs pa zhus/ jo nang ba dang bu legs pa tshang gi rtsod gzhi kham mchu de byang gtsang gi mi sna gnyis 'dzom gyi steng nas gcod rgya byas/ skabs 'di dag tu 'dom pa'i thad du gtsang bo la dar chags/ rang re la nye ba ltar snang ba'i 'brel can mang pos 'dom pa'i dar 'di sngar gyi jo nang mkhan po rnams sku 'das skabs kyang chags de min gzhan ma byung ba dang*/ da res khyed mchod yon bzlos pa 'di yang*/ yon bdag snang che zhing*/ sku rim dge 'dun dang mthu mkhan dang mthu bzlog mkhan sogs 'gangs can rnam grangs mang ba nas rim gro sogs gang ci nas bzab dgos zer/ 'phral snying gtam yin yin skad blo phugs dkrugs sdebs dang sdigs ri gtong ba'i gzhi mthun par snang zhing gzhan 'dris med dang chags sdang can gyi phyogs nas spyir mi min du bgrong ba sogs rang re la grags pa dang 'gro don cung zad byung ba la phrag dog langs pa'i skyon brjod dang ngan smras sna tshogs byed pa gzhir bcas shing*/ rgyu mtshan de dang de dag la brten nas nged la dog cha che 'phral du 'chi ba yod skad kyi mthu skad dang sdigs ri sna tshogs byed pa byung na'ang sems la ni g.yo mgul dang snyems 'khrig rdul phran tsam yang ma byung ngo*/ / lar bla ma'am sde dpon sogs mi phal cher la sdigs ri 'di 'gro kyin 'dugang la yang de tsho dang 'dra snyam mthong chung gi sdigs ri byed par 'dugagazhan yang de 'dra'i rigs tshod bgam pa'i khungs byed pa sogs mang po zhig yong gin 'dug ste nga gdod nas grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa tā ra nā tha yin/ bla rul dri thug ching ching tsho dang nam du yang 'dra mi yong lags/ sdug rgan la song yang gzhan zer kho na'i rjes su 'brang ba tsho rang bsam mno thong*/

nged rang ni byis pa nas gzung gdeng chung 'dra gdog lags/ rin po che ka bzhi nas ni de tshor phan 'dogs la zhes kyang phebs dgos pa 'dug gsung pa'i tshur ston gnad byung ba la/ spyan 'dren la btang dus phebs ni ma byung*/ sde pa kun spangs drung gis snga byin shin tu bkyon par mdzad/ rang re la 'gro don 'phran bu byung ba la/ zhwa dmar nag la 'gran pa yin no zhes pa la rkangs bcol/ 'phral zar zir de la bsnyad pa'i gsung ra thon lug thon du byon/ sku nye'i gsar 'grogs kyi rgyab skyor khungs dang*/ stag lo pa snam nas yongs dus bzang ldan pa dang gser mdog can pa dang gdong dga'i 'bod mi sogs rta ba bco lnga byung ba tshun la ko long mdzad/ 'on kyang kho bo'i sems la ni da lta sna tshogs pa'i brjod pa smra ba po rnams rang 'bras dang rang mdog myur du ston par 'dug snying re rje snyam pa ma gtogs gnod sems ye ma skyes/ bstan 'dzin rin po cher rje grol mchog nas brgyud pa'i sbyong dkyil bcu gnyis kyi dbang gi snyan 'debs zhu bar dge steng slob dpon pa yang yang btang ba/ dpe gsar 'dzin byed dgos pa la khag bskur mdzad nas re zhig mi yong gsung gin 'dugade ma gnang ba la phyis khyeg 'dra byung yin/ gzhan yang bka' bkod sna tshogs nges med du 'byon cing phyag g.yog rnams kyi 'gro 'tshams la brten pa'i byed lugs dang brjod sgo sna tshogs byas/ de nas nye skor g.yas g.yon nas 'bod mi byung dogs dang de la brten nas ngam ring du 'gro dgos byung dogs jo nang nas tho rangs shig btegasngar nas lung nag shel dkar la yong dgos tshul nan chags yod na'ang ltas mi legs pa kho nas shes dkar gyi thad la yang gsang ste phyin/ de nub khro phur byams chen la phyag mchod smon lam sogs byas/ byang chen du zla ba phyed gnyis tsam phyi mtshams me bal nang du dge sbyor 'phel bar byung*/ rkang pa cung zad na ba yang nad 'don gyi dmigs pa brtad pa kho nas sel/

byang phyogs rug ma zhes bya ba'i yul nas 'ongs pa'i 'phreng gi zhes bya ba'i mi rigs kyi tshong pa zhig bal por sleb pa de'i bram ze zhig la zong bskur/ bram ze des kyang ngam ring nas nged kyi zla la 'ongs jo nang du 'chi la khad byung*/ nad g.yog sman sngags sogs gang grag byas/ nad phan cing 'di skabs tshong pa kho rang yang sleb/ sngar ma thos pa'i byang phyogs kyi yul gyi gtam mang po dang*/ bzo bkod ngo mtshar can sngon med mang po mthong*/ byang chen pa rnams la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi 'khrid dang bshad pa/ bka' gdams kyi man ngag thor bu mang po dang bcas pa bshad/ gser mdog can du lam 'bras sogs chos rgya che rab dgos tshul gyi nan chags snga mo nas yang yang yod pa dang*/ de skabs dus la bab pa'i stabs gser mdog can du 'gro ba'i mar lam/ bsam rtser shog gsung ba ltar phyin/ sleb pa'i sang nyin kun spangs drung la tshe dbang 'dra dgos gsung ba ltar byas/ de yang kun spangs drung sku snyel nas zla ba gnyis lhag song skabs yin/ snyung gzhi'i rkyen yang gdon gyi gnod pas byas 'dugaskabs der bsrung 'khor la rin po che ka bzhi nas gzims chung mdo phug tsam mdzad nas bcar bzhugs dang*/ klu sdings na rje zhwa dmar sprul pa'i sku dang*/ drung pa rin po che yang bzhugs bzhin pa la/ bla ma rnam gnyis kyi dbang byin rlabs gnang ba la phebs res kyi/ sde pa la zhud kha grag po lung med re byung bas/ bla ma rnam gnyis kyang phebs pa'i rgyun chad/ ka bzhi nas kyang mdzad thes zad pa la/ sde pa gnang ches pas mi bzhugs ka med kyi gang grag ci grag gi skabs der snang*/ de skabs kun spangs drung la thog mar bgegs skrod drag po zhig byas pa/ sde pa rang la zil chen po dang 'jigs snang gi dran med du 'gro tshad pa dang drag tu rdul ba sogs re zhig bgegs 'thon pa'i rtags gsal bor byung*/ de 'phral rang nas bzung sku khams de je grag la song*/

kun spangs drung ni kha sang nas zla ba gnyis kyi khongs su zhal nas gang bton tsho ni brjed/ sngar bka' bkyon bkyon ka mdzad mkhan de dang rgyud mi gcig pa 'dra ba cig byas/ rgyang tsam sdod dgos tshul nan chags rang gsung gin 'dugade gong gdon gyis sbas pa'i rnam pas 'tsho byed rnams kyis kyang nad ngos ma zin pa la/ de mtshams nas nad ngo zin cing sman gyi bcos byas te sku khams bde ba'i lugs byas/ zhag bcu gcig bar bsdad/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la gser mdog can du phyin/ bco lnga nas bzung chos btsugs te snga thun la sa skya bka' 'bum lung gang 'gro re dang grol ba'i thig le'i 'khrid/ gung thun la lam 'bras kyi 'khrid tshugs/ zhag brgyad song mtshams rin po che ka bzhi nas klu sdings su sgar pa mjal ba la byon dgongs mo rtse la phebs dus gdon gyi phyi 'brangs byas/ kun spangs drung la zhung shin tu thu ba brgyab te 'grongs la khad byung*/ de'i rkyen gyis snyung gzhi logayang 'bod mi nan can 'phral du byung bas bsam grub rtser 'gro dgos shar/ chos kyi stobs 'phral du gser mdog can la log 'gro rtsis yin na'ang zhal ngo thams cad kyis nan chags gnang bas/ sku khams bde bskyed thon gyi bar sdod dgos byung ba zla gcig zhag nyi shu tsam song*/ de bar la nyin re bzhin gtor dbang re re dang*/ tshe dbang gang 'gab re kun spangs drung rang la phul/ zhal ngo gzhan rnams la dgongs bzhed ltar/ tshe dbang rjes gnang rnam grangs mang tsam dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang*/ chos rje dkon mchog legs 'dzin pa la mi g.yo bla med kyi dbang*/ rnam sras rigs chen brgyad/ gzhan yang 'dod chos ci rigs bshad/ zhwa dmar ba'i sgar nas bla ma gling pa 'dod chos kyi snying po gal che ba yin zer nas/ khong sogs dbang cha gcig la gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dbang dang*/ 'khrid brgya tshang ba zhig bshad/

nged sleb 'phral ka bzhi nas ni gnod sbyin dom gyi dbang po'i dpe 'am btson thar ba bzhin du laug phebs song*/ de rjes lan cig 'cham pas re na cig byung skabs/ nyi ma dgong kha cigaganyid byung dogs zur 'phyong gi dpyangs kha na bsdad yod pas/ bud med dmar mo dre'u la zhon pa snang gsal gyi rdzong ri las che che tsam zhig nas/ las ka don chen mang po deng sang 'phral du 'grub pa yod pa yin te/ khyed 'dir sdod dgos 'dir re zhig 'gyangs song zer nas lcags kyi mda' phyogs la yal gyi song ngo*/ / sku dog phan tshun du 'gyur ba'i sde ba karma bstan srung dang*/ srang stod nas kyang sku snyel ba la bgegs sprod dbang sogs byas pa tsam gyis sku khams sangs dwangs pa rkyang ba byung*/ sgar pa rnams pa snam du phebs khar sgar ston la rtse la phebs dus kun spangs drung rang gis kyang zhud byung dogs kyi bsrung 'khor dmigs pa nan can dgos tshul 'phral 'phral gsung de dus zhud kha'i rnam pa byung yang ma byung de rjes mi ring bar sku khams sangs grag lta bur song*/

hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu la slar yang gser mdog can du sleb/ lung chos kyi rim pa sngar bzhin btsugs nas/ snga chos la lung shog bu gdong thon brgya bud re bklags/ 'khrid kyi chos thun ci rigs pa re byas/ dgong chos la lam 'bras kyi 'khrid btab/ zhag nyi shu tshun la lam 'bras kyi snang gsum rdzogs shing*/ 'khrid gzhan gshed dmar spros med/ nai gu sogs shangs pa'i gser chos bzhi/ rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ snying po don gsum sogs rnam grangs mang du song zhing*/ sems bskyed kyi dus kyang skye bo 'du 'tshogs che/ rgyu dbang la dbang cha lnga bcu nga bgrangs byung rung brtsol ba bskyed de myur du grub par byas/ / rgyu dbang skabs shar steng nas dpon sa rin mo ches kyang phebs shing*/ gzhi byes tshang ma la mang ja/ nas 'gyed/ skam 'gyed/ 'khrid ston tshogs 'khor bzab rgyas dpe med rang mdzad/ rgyud gsum gyi 'khrid kyi skabs/ snga dro 'khrid gzhan gyi thun re bshad pa la/ bsam mi khyab sogs lam skor chung ba brgyad po rnams la/ in+d+ra bhu ti'i skor ma gtogs bdun po rnams kyi 'khrid dmigs gang zhib byas/ so so'i lung yang tshang bar rdzogs/ snga sor bsam 'grub rtse nas yongs dus/ kun spangs drung la da lo bsam rtse rang du/ bzhugs thugs dam bzhin yang gnang thub na rab/ de min yang sku rim gang grag gnang 'phral spyod thugs rtog gang zhib gnang pas lo gsar nas sku dog las grol 'gro shas che ba 'dug zhus pa yin na'ang*/ 'di dus lam 'bras grol du nye ba'i skabs shigakun spangs drung pa snam du glo bur du thegs song zer bas/ mthar thon mi yong bsam zhing gzhi byes gzhan thams cad la yang smras/ lam 'bras grol 'phral u rgyan rdzong nas dpon sa'i drung sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi mgo la 'gro dgos byung zhing gdung chog rim pa zhe dgu ma grol bar du smin por byung*/ de skabs 'phur mo'i 'bri g.yag rnams dpon sa de nyid rang gi zhal chems ltar dge rgyun la sbyor ba mdzad/

sa 'dir myang ston pa sogs don gnyer 'ga' la rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs 'phreng ba skor gsum dang dpung bzang gi rgyud kyi bshad pa yul le ba re byas/ kun spangs drung ni khong ra'i dgongs bzhed dang phyag g.yog phyogs 'dzin can rnams kyis bskul pa snam chu bzang ba dang bla ma rnam gnyis kyi bka' bkod la yang brten sku khams sangs te grag 'gro ba gzhir bzhag pa la grag pa'i ngo so gzhan la mi 'chor ba'i phyir rang du phebs par gnang zhing*/ ka bzhi nas ni mchod yon lhan du chab tshan la phebs pa'i rtsis kyi rin po ches kyang pa snam du phebs/ sngar bros pa yin yang de dus tshur 'khor/ de'i thog zhag shas nas sde pa sku khams 'phral du log pa'i je lod kyi ngang nas mthar yang zhud khas bsdus gda'/ nged tsho o rgyan rdzong du sleb nas zhag po dgu tsam song ba na/ bsngo rten gyis sleb byung*/ sngar de 'dra'i sku khams gyong ba la gzhug tu su las kyang dbyings chung ba de 'dra cig yong ba ang*/ 'dir ma zad gyang gyong shang shing rdzas rdzas dbang 'dra yod gyu'i khungs la man ne mun ne/ ngan shed khyer/ bsam ngan khog bzung ba snga phyi ngad lta'i bar ji snyed cig gda' ste lang pa cig dang khum pa cig ka sngar yang byung*/ da dung yong ba 'di lar mi go bar 'dug lags/ de rjes u rgyan rdzong du dgongs rdzogs grol nas/ 'jags su rab gnas la 'gro dgos stabs chu byang ka rgyud nas phyin/ grwa tshang chen mor rin po che tshul khrims pas gsung nan can byon nas khor tsam phyin/ tshogs pa rnams la chos 'brel sogs legs lam char byung*/ de nas 'jags su phyin/ de skabs zhag po dgu bsdad/ khyung po'i yin thang zhal phyi nas gsol ba btab pas me tog gi char lag pas bzung du btub pa tsam snyon med du byung*/ lan cig stag lung rin po che sku bag tsam snyel ba zhig rmi lam du byung bas blo cung ma bde/ 'di skabs sku snyel ba'i 'go tsam yin tshod du gda'/

tshogs pa rnams la rgyu sde lnga'i dbang chen mo dang gseng chos chung ba rnams bshad/ nyung bsdus 'ga' zhig la su kha'i chos skor rnams kyang byas/ rin po che 'phrin las bkra shis pa'i nang rten thub pa'i gser sku la rab gnas byas pa'i dngos gzhi'i nyin mo sgo bsgrigs nas rlung chen po zhig byung ste/ lcog rtse mgul nas 'thung dkar dang chung 'chag med sde pa kar bstan drung gi phyag nas byung 'phral zhig yod pa de zhal ba'i dkyil du 'phar de chagade 'phral stag sna nas zhabs drung dre bo sprul pa'i skus/ stag snar khor tsam yong dgos gsung ba'i 'bod mi zhig gnang byung*/ de nyin ka nyug nas kyang 'bod mi byung*/ de'i snga nub rmi lam du kha che paṇa chen yin zer ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta rgya gar gyi dge slong rgan po'i rnam pa zhig byung ba'ang rgya 'dre'i cho 'phrul du shes nas sprul bsgyur gyi 'dul dgos snyam pa la long ma byung bar gnyid sad/ rmi lam de dang dkar yol chag pa la rtog dpyad cung zad byung bas de skabs gnyis ka la ma phyin/ stag sna nas tshur ja 'dren zhig gnang byung*/ 'on kyang ltas de 'jags pa sprul pa'i sku dang*/ zhabs drung de pho gnyis ka ring por mi bzhugs pa la lta bar 'dugamagon khang gi rdo sku'i drung du nub cig gsol ba 'debs kyin bsdad pas/ mgon g.yag rnams thag ring po na 'khyams shing yod 'phro la nub mo de ka la thams cad 'dus nas gling gseb nyul zhing ngar sgra 'byin pa byung*/ yong khar chos cig bshad pa/ dpon chung sogs chos khri'i ltag tu bsdad song*/ bar skabs tsho gnyis su 'gro ba'i ltas su go nas zla bo tsho la'ang 'thab dgos byung*/ tshur lam chums su chos rje skal bzang ba dang gsung gleng 'phel bar byas/ gser mdog can du bla phyed sgor bsdad/ sa skya bka' 'bum gyi lung gi 'phro dang rjes gnang sna tshogs pa dang chos than thun rnam grangs mang bar byas/

yar lam bsam 'grub rtser zhag bcu bdun skor bsdad zhal ngo so sor chos bka' mang rab dang*/ rang gi zla la sdod pa'i don gnyer 'ga' zhig la/ rgyud bla ma thogs med 'grel chen dag bcas pa'i zab bshad byas/ de nas khri khang du rin po che ka bzhi nas kyang phebs bde mchog sogs dgongs bzhed kyi chos bka' yang mang du phul sngar las lhag par gus pa ltar mdzad kyin 'dugayar lam pa snam du khor tsam phyin nas/ bsam sdings su sleb 'phral mtshams bsdams/ rgyal rtser 'gro dgos byung dogs pa'i snang ba cig shar ba nas/ pa snam du sde ba kar bstan drung dang yang gleng slang byung*/ de yang rgyal rtse nas bdag po rgyal ba'i drung 'brug pa'i bu chen rje lha rtse ba la thugs mos chug cing bka' chos gsan/ rtogs ldan rnams dang lhan du rlung khrid skyong bar mdzad/ de skabs gzims chung 'od kyis khyab pa dag dbu la me 'bar ba'i nyams snang byung gsung*/ nged gser mdog can na yod dus sman dpon pa brgyud nas ji ltar yin 'dri bar gnang byung ba la/ ngas ni bden pa rang la rgyal 'gong gi cho 'phrul yin las che zhus na'ang*/ shin tu ma dgyes/ rin po che lha rtse nas phyag rdor gtum po'i bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags yin par lung bstan dbus dbyung mdzad gda'/ rtags de tsho byung nas zla ba lnga drug gcig song ba'i 'di skabs nged mtshams bsdams nas zhag bdun song skabs/ bdag po sku 'das nas dgongs rdzogs la 'bod mi sleb/ zhag shas nas dus tshod tshes grangs dang bstun rgyal rtser phyin/ byang bzhu sogs bya bar 'os pa rnams 'bad de bgyis/ bdag po de snga mo nas thugs dam 'phel shing thugs rang bzhin bzang ba dge phyogs la dkar ba zhig yod na'ang*/ phyis rting thugs su bar chad zhugs pa'i rnam pas 'os bab med pa la khrims gcod tshan can sogs sna tshogs mdzad/ da de rang sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs byung gsung gin sdig pa la ye mi mdzem pa zhig byung zhing*/

'di skabs kyang bsre 'pho'i rlung sgom pa yin gsung nas khrung bag med gsol sku 'khyams byung bas rkyen byas par gda'/ sku gshegs nas dgongs rdzogs kyang hrab hreb las ma byung song der yun ring yang ma bsdad/ nged dang byang ba'i yum chen mkhon sel du song ba'i khungs la/ gnyen tshan gra bsgrigs su rlom pa'i rgyang rtse rtse chen gnyis ka ma mgu ba'i nag log ko log la song*/ sdong po khog rul gyi bla ma dang chos rdzus pho mo tsho ngom ngom 'dra byed kyin 'dug ste/ gang yang ma 'gor bar ci 'dra cig byung kun gyis ltos shig/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūṃ/ slar yang dgun thog de bsam sding du dge sbyor gang yod dang*/ nyin mo lta rtogaphran bu sogs brtsol pa ha cang che ba ma yin pa zhig la lus/ rmi lam gzung bas yul snang gi bkod pa sham+bha la dang po ṭa la sogs ngo mtshar che bar byung*/ dus gtor gyi bskang gso byas pa cig la/ gtor ma'i dbus nas btso 'thon pa dang*/ zil chen po bzod par dka' ba byung*/ de rjes zhi ba'i sbyin sreg kyang mang du byas/ 'di skabs don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ stag lung rin po che rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis zhing brjes pa'i gtam skyel ba dang*/ thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi rten skyel ba dang*/ zhus 'bul dang rten bzhengs sogs gang cir snga khyad che ba'i gal che yod tshul gyi nan chags 'bod mi la gzims dpon nam mkha' gnang ba ltar mi ring bar chas/ 'dol byung du zhag gsum pa zhig bsdad/ de min lam du 'gor ba med par zhugs/ snang kar rtser zhag lnga pa zhig dang*/ 'brang phur yang zhag shas bsdad/ lhun rab tu phyin/ skyed tshal 'og gi mkhan slob rnams kyis dgon par shog gsung ba ltar gyi chos khri'i steng nas tshogs pa rnams la bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig byas/ yol ri gong du mgon po la bskang gso dang spyan gzigs 'ga' phul gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan yang cung zad byung*/

phar lam gyi re lha khang du lha rin po che'i phyag gi 'phel gdung spyan drangs phyag mchod phul mgon khang yang mjal tsam byas/ shin tu zhag po gnyis bsdad tshe dbang sogs dgongs bzhed ltar bgyis/ lha sar yang phyin/ 'di skabs rme ru ba'i slob dpon gyi las byed byas/ sde pa dga' ldan pa'i dmag mal gro gong mkhar la bteg grub tsam gyi skabs su 'dugasnga sor lha sar sdod skabs dga' ldan khang gsar nas rtswa shing gi mthun rkyen phran bu yong kun yod na'ang 'di skabs ye ma byung*/ lho ngos brgyud nas glang thang du phyin rgyal rtse nas bla ma'i zhabs drung gis de'i gong tsam du 'brug pa sprul pa'i sku dpon slob spyan 'dren mdzad 'dug cing da rung myur stabs 'brug pa dpon slob kyi phyag phyi la phebs rgyu yin par 'dug zer bas/ re zhig rgyal rtse la yang thegs pa mi dga' zhing*/ 'brug pa'i sgar sogs gzhan la yal yul yang ye mi legs/ 'di phyogs su yang 'dul ba yul lugs dang bstun pa'i gnang sgo dang*/ chos spyod bskang gso sogs kyang phyi ltar du sde 'di kha dang mthun pa mdzad/ dpon slob nyung bsdus kyi ngang nas ma mtha' yang lo gsum glang thang rang du bzhugs pa 'thad tshul zhus te phyag g.yog gi stabs su song ba yin nam/ de rjes zla gcig tsam nas 'brugs pa'i sgar la thegs gda'/ de rjes rgyal rtser phebs/ de la brten nas lo brgyad tsam gyi bar du gtam ngan la mdzad dka' ba byung song*/ / de nas nged kyi lhun grub rdzong brgyud stag lung pa'i sngar 'khyud kyi sgrigs bkod dang bcas stag lung du sleb/ de'i gnangs nyin mchog gi sprul pa zhabs drung rin po che dang mjal/ de skabs rten bzhengs kyi rgyu tshogs la 'dre ba'i don du snga phyir gser zho lnga bcu tsam dang*/ gzhan yang rang re la ltos pa'i gang yod dkrugs pa'i tshul du phul/ zla ba gnyis tsam dbang lung 'khrid sogs chos kyi rnam grangs mang po rang dgos phebs pa ltar snga dro nyi ma shar tsam nas nyi ma phyed yol gyi bar la ci nus ci lcogs su phul/

zhabs drung du'ang*/ bla ma gsang 'dus dang thugs sgrub dang drag dmar pad+ma gling pa'i lugs sogs chos mang rab zhus/ nyin phyed man bka' chos 'bul ba rdzogs nas/ don gnyer 'dra la chos than thun 'dra yang byas shing*/ phal cher ni zhabs drung gong ma de mi bzhugs pas bag grang ba'i rnam pa dang*/ sde de dang rang re'i lag g.yog sogs gang la'ang yid 'dre ba yang mi 'dug nas/ g.yas g.yon gyi spang ri brag 'og ne gsing dur khrod sogs 'og la sa rnams su phyin nas mnyam gzhag gtso bor byas/ rin po che gong ma'i gdung ni lo de nang du zhu 'bul mi gnang bar thag chod song*/ rab gnas ni snga sor stag lung na dbu bla res mdzad pa ka mang ba 'dug ste zhabs drung 'di nyid kyis rten bzhengs gnang ba thams cad la zhal ngo ma gtogs bla ma gzhan gyis rab gnas mi mdzad pa cig 'dug pa de da lta'i zhabs drung 'di rang gi dgongs brtad yin snang ba/ don ni ri bo che ba la dpe 'dra gnang ba yin par 'dugade phyin phyag g.yog byed rgyu yang mi 'dug pas myur du 'gro ba'i dgongs grol yang yang zhus kyang*/ kar dge'i dus 'khrug 'di ci 'gyur mi shes pas sdod dgos tshul gyi bka' nan ma chogs/ bdag jo bo yab sras rnams la shin tu mos gus che bas/ snga gong phyogs 'dir yong res kyis rwa bsgreng mjal ba dang zhabs tog gang grag re byed kyin yod/ khong tsho yang dga' tshor chen po byed kyin yod na'ang rwa bsgreng dgon mi dmangs la stag lung nas kyang skyod dar yag po ma byung gda'/ khong tshos kyang stag lung la blo log byas sog po la 'jus 'dug pas rwa bsgreng ba la sngar lugs ltar byas na bla ma'i dam tshig la gnod par 'dug pas 'di skabs btang snyoms su bzhagaser gler mtshams bdun phrag gnyis pa zhig byas/ der dge sbyor 'phel zhing nyams bzang ba zhig byung*/ mtshams grol nas dpon sa gang skyid dang rje btsun drung phebs/

nai gu sogs dgongs bzhed dang mthun pa'i chos 'ga' re byas/ nyin gcig dbu khang la ri ltas byed du phyin rdo la 'khar ba'i rjes shig byung zer/ nyams 'ur re ba cig gis yin min dga' mi dga'i rtog dpyod ni gang yang ma byung de'i grags pa yam me ba zhig gis khyab/ de rjes phu mdor phyin/ sde pa'i drung la dbang bskur sogs 'ga' shas phul/ rmi lam du rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma sngo ljang gi sku shin tu gsal ba zhig byung*/ nang par dgon pa ba chen po'i thugs dam rten yin zer ba bris sku rnying pa zhig lag tu 'byor pas dga' ba chen po skyes/ gnyan thog tu khor tsam phyin/ rje btsun ma'i sku brnyan byin rlabs can dang*/ rga lo'i thugs dam 'bum cha sogs la phyag mchod smon lam btab/ gnyan thog rdzong gi rnam sras lha khang sogs kyang mjal/ slar stag lung du sleb skabs ngam ring nas dpon sa mnga' bdag drung sku 'das pa'i bsngo rten skyel ba'i mi sna sbrel ma 'byor/ dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi grol nas/

bla ma dge bshes bzang dgu la thugs dam 'dogs 'bul bar gnang bar gda'/ mnga' bdag drung de phyag 'tshal khar mgo bog pa'i rnam pas khong rang gshegs khar dam tshig nyams pa yin kyang smon lam yang dag pa btab/ mi snas yul dus gzhan du sna tshogs shig glengs 'dug na'ang de la grub 'bras rang ni cang ma byung ba 'dra'o/ / rje btsun ma'i thang ka rnying pa de la gong gsham sogs gsar pa gsol/ rab gnas skyar ma byas pas me tog mang po sku la chags pa dang*/ rmi lam thabs su yi ge bcu pa'i sgra shin tu gsal bar grag pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang po byung*/ dmag byung dus rgyal khams 'jig pa las skyob thub pa'i rten 'brel yang nges 'grig gda'/ de nas zla ba gcig tsam du chos zhu 'bul tho re ba byung*/ de mtshams gtsang pa'i dmag 'phan yul du sleb/ 'bri khung go gnyis ni dmag 'bod mkhan dngos su ka gnang*/ gzhan thams cad kyis kyang mi sna bstun phyogs snga mo nas sleb yod 'dug kyang rgyal du dmag ma sleb par stag lung nas mi sna gnang ba yang ma byung*/ sde pa dga' ldan pa dang thugs 'brel ches pas phyi ltar na phyogs su lhung ba ltar yang song nas shin tu thugs 'tshab che bas 'phan yul na yod pa'i mnga' zhabs tsho srung skyob la bdag mi 'gro kha med kyi bka' nan gnang*/ yul tsho so so dang lcang lung chos sdings pa sogs dbu tsugs kyi 'bod mi nan can mang po byung*/ de mthun 'gro dgos shar bas thog ma nyan por phyin zhag bzhi tsam bsdad/ de rjes lcang lung chos sdings su phyin/ yul tsho so sor nged re'i grwa pa re re tsam bsdad pas kyang srung skyob thub cing phan 'dogs che ba rang byung*/ yongs bsgril dmag gi 'gros dang bstun zla gcig lhag tsam 'phan yul du 'gor/ dga' mor sde pa kar bstan drung dang mjal dus da lo'i dmag 'di kun yang phugs sde pa rang la phan chung*/ da dung kar dge'i 'khrug pa yong shas 'dug na'ang da ni slar dmag mi gnang ba rang legs/

gnang na sku tshe la shin tu rang gnod thag chod zhus te/ sde pa'i dgongs pa la kar lugs la ko long byed par 'dug snyam pa'i go ba log pa shar song na'ang*/ rang re'i drang po rang yin pa phyis rang rtags bstan pa der gda'/ gzhan yang 'phan yul spyi la zhwa dmar ba'i rdzong la dgos rgyu'i shing gcod kyang zhu ngo byas pas de skabs ni rtsa ba nas chogs/ ja pa dang dgon gnas so sor ja 'don mdzad pa kun la'ang zhu ngo phal cher 'grub pa sogs 'di skabs rang res skye bo mang po la phan thogs par byung zhing*/ de min na khyad par stag lung pa la mnga' zhabs la gong shor chen po yong nges par 'dug kyang rang res zhabs tog re 'grub byung bsam pa yod/ dang po khyi lo'i skabs kyi rmi lam de yang thog tu khel bar gda'/ 'on kyang snyigs dus kyi mi rnams ngo mtshar che ste/ dmag ma log par la skyi sdug thams cad khyed la rag las zer lan cig ma yin par sgrog pa la/ dmag phyir log 'jigs pa dang bral ba na 'phral du rang 'gyur te ngo shes byed pa yang dka' zhing tshig gi gtang rag re yang mi gtong ste/ stag lung pa chos skyong bzang ba la 'jigs pa yin no zhes bya ba dang sog po la 'dzems pa yin no zhes dril sgrog par byed do/ / dus 'khrugs 'di dus rtse la sgang pa'i mkhan po sogs kong po kar srid kyi dge 'dun ser dmag rnams kyi rme ru bla ma'i dgon pa bshig de'i gser chos mang po sdebs la bzhu nas/ dpon slob yon bdag dang bcas sgo bsha' byed pa sogs chos 'gal gyi spyod pa ha las ko las rnams la yin skyo shas che zhing*/ cis kyang dgos med kyi blo dang dge sbyor la bskul ma cher byung*/ de nas stag lung du khor tsam phyin/ gling gi grwa pa phal cher zhig da res khyed kyis pho byas pa yin zer dga' tshor chen po byed du byung*/ zhabs drung rin po che thugs zab pa'i rang bzhin du snang yang*/ dpon ni zhabs tog sgrubs pa la legs so'i tshig tsam yang mi mdzad kyi steng du gnas skabs gzhan la bsnyad nas bka' bkyon par mdzad do/

/ de lta na yang bla ma'i zhabs tog yin bsam blos longs par byas/ nged lta bu la byang chub sems dpa'i re ba ci/ 'on kyang*/ gang la bdag gis phan btags pa'i/ / re ba che ba 'ga' zhig gis/ / shin tu mi rigs gnod byed na'ang*/ / bshes gnyen dam par lta bar shog/ ces pa'i don yang de skabs snying thag pa nas skyes/ stag lung nas phyir 'ongs dus lhun grub rdzong du zhag gsum bsdad sde pa'i drung gis dges dges su mdzad cing*/ me sde'i khog gi ja pa sogs phal che bas kyang phan gdags kyi drin gzo 'phran tshegs dang tha na tshig gi gtang rag tshun chod nas 'os su 'gro ba tsam byed kyin snang bas/ bsam pa la chos pa'i sa las 'jig rten pa'i sa mi gzhi legs shing byed pa bzang ba 'di ni ya re cha bsam pa yang yang shar/ de nas lcang rgyab/ glang thang*/ shing grong sogs su 'bod mi byung ba ltar phyin dus/ khong rnams ni stag lung pa dang nged rnams mos gus ni nged rnams che che tsam yin pa la/ stag lung kho na la phyogs su lhungs pa'i phan 'di tsam 'dogs pa snyam pa'i mthong ltas re byed kyi 'dug ste stag lung lha sde ni de 'dra khyed kyis ma go 'dug pa/ 'jig rten sgyu ma'i gar mkhan 'khrul snang gang shar gyi nyams skyong ba bden med la bden zhen can tu gda'/ rang res la sa cha 'di tshor chags sdang gi bcol gnyer med snyam zhe la 'dzin pa yang ma byas sel sbyangs dang*/ dag tshangs dang bshad sbyangs yang ma byas/ gang dga' gyis phaṭa snyam nas yongs/ sgo la'i nang khugs su shun nas rab gnas la 'bod mi gnang ba dang 'phrad dus/ sa cha de kha nas dung chung legs po zhig rnyed/ rten 'brel legs sam snyam pa shar/ cung zad legs par yang 'dugalho ngos su dpon sa'i drung gis stag lung pa la phan 'dogs che 'dug ces dgyes dgyes dpe med mdzad/ de res thugs steng shod kyi stabs ci yin pa 'dugadaga' ldan khang gsar du'ang yong dgos tshul nan chags gsung ba ltar phyin/

zhal ngo rnams la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang sogs 'dod chos 'dra phul/ ltas brtag pa 'dra gyis gsung ba la/ da lo'i gnas tshul 'di yang ma legs pa che ste da dung lo shas 'jam gang chags dang brling cha gang che ma mdzad na skyon che ba rang gda' zhus/ sne gdong rtse nas lcam drung gis kyang de mthun gyi gsung phebs dang*/ sbu ba gdong gi khur gzhes mdzad na ji ltar gsung ba la yang gzhan ni mi shes skyong dang gang gnang gi ring la g.yog rigs la byams po gnang dgos zhus/ lha sar jo bo'i sku gzhogs su nged dang khong dpon g.yog rnams smon lam lhan cig mdzad rgyu'i khungs la rig pa 'ur smon lam byed 'phrol bzhag nas gnas tshang du logade rjes shun du sleb nas zla gcig tsam bsdad/ thub pa gnas bcu'i gser sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba rnams la rab gnas rgyas par byas/ rab gnas grub mtshams la rten gzi byin rgyas pa dang bag dro ba'i rnam 'gyur der 'dus thams cad la gsal bar snang ba sogs byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan byung*/ shun nas zhabs drung du rgyu sde lnga'i dbang sogs shangs chos cha tshang zhig dgos gnang ba ltar phul zhing*/ de nas snye thang du gser khang pa'i sar zhag gcig bsdad khrom dbang zhig kyang byas/ sang nyin yul tsho tha dad pa'i rtsed sna sna tshogs kyi bsu ba dang bcas bla chen drung gis 'bod mi gnang ba ltar bde ba can du phyin der yang tshe dbang dang ma ṇi'i lung sogs dang bla brang du yang chos than thun sogs phul/ nang par mkhar rnga bas nan chags byas pa ltar khor tsam phyin nas/ chu lho'i nor bu dge 'phel gyi rdzong du sleb tsam byas/ skyi ru ba sde pa kun rgyal gyis mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa sbyar/ khrom dbang zhig byas/ dpal ldan gsang phur phyin rje btsun sgrol ma rtsod rgyal ma jo bo gdung rten jo bo'i thugs dam rnam rgyal mchod rten lo tsā ba chen po'i sku thang phyag gnas ma dang*/

slob dpon rin po che 'khon bsod nams rtse mos bzhengs pa phywa ba chen po'i bris sku sogs rten ngo mtshar can mang po de rnams la spos mar me snyan dar sogs bzang du phul smon lam mang du btab/ de nas rim pas brgyud de 'ongs nas drang srong srin po rir rten gsum rnams la phyag mchod phul/ bsam rtser sde pa srang stod nas sku gshegs pa'i bsngo rten yang 'dir sleb nang par gong dkar du phyin/ zla ba phyed gnyis tsam bsdad/ zhabs drung khu dbon sogs dang bla ma slob dpon dge bshes ci rigs dang*/ don gnyer sna tshogs 'dus pa gzhi bcu skor la/ 'phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum dang bcas pa'i dbang*/ phyag len mtha' rgyas rdzogs pa dang*/ g.ya' bzang spyan mnga' dang*/ ra ba smad pa'i grwa tshang rnams la/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig nyi ma sbas pa lugs kyi rjes gnang dang*/ gzhan yang so sor gang la gang 'dod kyi chos kyi rnam grangs mang du byas/ rgyal rtse nas khyim chung ba tshang nged la sngar nas mi dad pa rang yin na'ang*/ gtsang nas bka' bkyon byung ba dang nged la zhu ngo dgos tshul nan chags byed pa zhig byung*/ khyim chung ba dbang lags zer ba khong ras nged kyi zla la zla ba gnyis lhag bsdad/ rim pas ngo chen zhu rgyu'i khungs la/ 'brug pa yon mchod kyi ngo chen yong rgyu yin zer 'brang phu nas glo bur du log song bas ngo chen ma dgos pas snying sangs pa cig byung na'ang*/ kho pa tsho la don ma mthong ba'i ngang nas mi ring bar bka' bkyon gnas tshul de ltar shar song*/ dbang lags zer ba khong rang bar skabs sa skya khri chen la blo brtad zhus 'dugaphyis sa skya bdag po a mis drung gis gzims chung sgo rtsar khrims gcod lag thal la btang*/ de mtshams skyid bshag gnyis kyis 'bod mi nan can yod pa ltar/ skyi gshongs su zhag dgu bsdad/ zhal ngo sogs don gnyer mang dag la/

bde mchog dang 'jigs byed kyi dbang*/ nai gu'i mgyogs 'khrid/ sgyu lus dbang mo che zlum po bzhi'i dbang sogs chos bka' mang du byas/ de rjes gzhung rnam rgyal rab brtan du bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya che ba dang bcas nas sleb/ 'dir yang nai gu chos drug so so'i bka' dang bcas pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'dod chos rnam grangs mang rab byas/ zhag bcu gsum bsdad/ khong tsho'i phyag na las stod lho pa bdag po'i phyag gi byin rlabs rten mang du 'dug pa rnams la rten mjal byas/ nyin gcig rngog pa'i gdan sa spre zhing mjal du phyin/ spre zhing na bzhugs pa'i rje mar pa'i gdung khang de la/ sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang nor bus bcos dang nang bzhugs la gzigs rtog mdzad rigs su 'dug na'ang*/ da rung rje btsun mar pa'i gdung rus bzhugs bden yin 'dug pas gus pa chen pos mchod pa phul gsol ba btab/ gdung brgyud pa dang gsung gleng 'dra byas na'ang khong pa dbu gug gug kyog kyog tsam ma gtogs chos kyi phyogs la smra bcad dam por 'dugami la phug dang dben gnas sogs kyang mjal te/ rje btsun chos sku rdo rje'i sku 'dra zhig 'dug pa sku bzhugs dus kyi phyag gnas ma yin zer yang min pa 'dugalung chung gi dpal lha mo byin rlabs can de yang mjal/ nyin gcig chos 'khor gling la phyin dus/ dgon pa'i slob dpon rngog lugs kyi chos mkhas po yin zer ba zhig dang 'phrad byung bas gsung gleng 'dra byas dus/ 'brug pa gsar pa'i chos skad gdol thabs kyi cal col las rngog lugs rang gi phyogs 'go things pa tsam yang mi 'duga'adi skor la yar lung bkra shis rtse pa gsar 'grogs ni sangs/ khong rang tsho'i bla ma 'dra'i bslab ston la brten ldem 'gyang log ge ba zhig dang*/ yar rgyab nas sde pas ni gsung 'gros 'bug bcag yi ge sogs 'brel thag thams cad bcad/ yig 'brel sogs cung zad byas na rgyal 'gong bzhin zhud byang dogs thugs la shar ba yin te 'ong gang na'ang ngo mi shes mig gis ma mthong rna bas ma thos pa lta bur mdzad do/

/ chos rje sked srongs pa 'phrad du byon/ khong dang gzhan 'ga' shas la/ bslab bsdus chen mo'i bklags lung gzhung rtsa ba rnams la 'bru bshad dang bcas pa byas/ yar lam yang gong dkar du 'ongs/ sa 'dir 'di skabs sogs snga phyir 'brug pa gsar pa'i yig cha mang du mthong byung ste mthong ba kun la 'um bsam pa las ni ma shar/ de nas rim pas chas te/ ka brgyad mar lhun rab pa'i zhal ngo rnams kyis mthun rkyen sbyar/ snga sor dpyid ka skyid tshal 'og tu phyin skabs/ slob dpon grub thob pa dang rang stong gzhan stong las brtsams pa'i chos skad brgal brtag mang du byung*/ khong gi de nas rje go ram pa dang*/ rtse thang sangs lhun dang*/ dngos grub dpal 'bar bas mdzad pa sogs gzhan stong 'gog byed kyi dpe mang po la lta rtog mdzad/ 'di skabs khong byon nas/ dogs gcod kyi 'bel gtam la nyin rtser zhig song*/ phyis khong rang yang grub mtha'i babs la dad pa rnyed tsam byung ba'i khungs mdzad kyin gda'/ sang nyin gtsub mo'i brag phug mjal du 'gro ba'i nub te/ cho 'phrul yang shin tu che bar byung zhing nang bar mjal dus/ phug na legs ldan nag po rib rib yod pa snyam byed/ rten rdo gru gsum sku 'ol byi yod tsam yod pa cig kyang rnyed byung ngo*/ / snga sor nas chos brgyud tha dad pa'i ko long khog tu bcug phrag dog gis nged la ngan smras lhur byed pa mi che chung dbus kyi lho kha stod smad 'di kun nas mang po byung ba yos 'brug gnyis la phal cher dengs tshar gda'/ snga sor byi glang stag gsum dang 'di skabs sbrul lo 'di kun la dbus kyi yul so so dang sde rigs so sor rten 'brel legs phyogs sgrig rgyu mang po 'dug ste gegs phyi nang gsang gsum ka yong ba gcig gis phal cher lag tu mi longs/ cung zad bsgrigs pa tsho'ang 'gal rkyen gyis mchugs 'gro ba cig rang yong gin 'dugalar sems can spyi mthun gyi las dang sgos su'ang myong bar nges pa la 'phags mchog rnams kyis kyang mdzad thabs bral tsa na/

rang re phal pas ci byar yang med mod/ 'phral ma nges pa bsgyur du rung ba 'di tsho la mang po zhig la so sor rten 'brel 'grig na phan thogs nges pa ji snyed yod de 'dod pa gegs su song*/ lar rten 'brel legs bya ba bya byed rtsom pa gcig po de legs par yong*/ rten 'brel yang 'dus byas yin pas rtag pa gnas yin/ legs pa'i rgyun de ma mchugs pa'i ring la dga' bar yong*/ phyis 'gal rkyen gyis rten 'brel log mchugs byung na thog ma lan cig 'grig pa cig pos mi chog pa 'di kun gyis go dgos pa'i gal po che rang yin no/ / de nas rim pas 'brang phu dgon par sleb/ nang mi rnams zi nge ba zhig 'dug nas khang pa'i nang du blo ma chags/ nyin mo phal cher phyi la bsdad/ ri phug gang phug ri rtse sogs gang dben dben du mnyam gzhag 'dra dang khang rgyab kyi zhing steng der chos ra tsho gnyis gsum re 'chag med byas/ skya ser sna tshogs 'dus pa la skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dang sems bskyed rab 'byams pa kong phrug dang sbyin pa sogs don gnyer kha shas la/

dgyes pa rdo rje'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa 'dzin chos su btang*/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud la dpe bkram nas rgyas par bshad/ 'di skabs zla gcig zhag po nyi shu tsam bsdad/ de rjes sna dkar rtser zla phyed tsam bsdad pa'i skabs/ zhal ngo rnams su phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i byin rlabs/ gshin rje gshed nag po zhang lugs dang gdong drug ra lugs kyi dbang*/ zlum po bzhi sogs dbang rjes gnang rnam grangs mang tsam phul/ rang dang lhan cig rgyu ba'i slob ma 'ga' shas la/ dpung bzangs kyi bshad pa dang*/ kyai rdor gyi 'dzin chos kyi 'phro rnams btang*/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum la lcam phun tshogs drung gi skra bcad dang*/ chos kyi dga' ston sogs rgyas pa mdzad/ snga sor rgyal rtse nas 'bod mi rim can du byung ba'i 'di skabs kyang de phyogs su 'gro ba gzhir bzhag lta bur yod na yang*/ dus thog tu 'bod mkhan yang ma sleb rmi ltas kyang 'gyur rin spungs nas 'bod mkhan byung ba ltar rong phyogs su 'gro bar chas/ sang nyin 'gro rgyu'i de ring rang de rgyal rtse nas 'bod mkhan sleb kyang de skor la 'gro ma thub rong chen brgyud nas phyin/ grags par zhag mal zhig bsdad/ chos rje 'od mchog pa de na bzhugs kyi 'dug pa'ang nged la 'phrad par phebs byung*/ de nas byams chen du sde pa 'jam grags drung bsu pa la phebs 'dug cing*/ byams sku chen mo la phyag mchod smon lam ci rigs pa btab/ slob dpon 'ga' la chos 'brel tsam byas te/ rin spungs su zhag brgyad bsdad/ tshe dbang rjes gnang 'ga' shas kyis thog drangs/ nai gu'i mgyogs 'khrid dang*/ sde pa 'jam grags drung sku sger du gshed dmar gyi dbang bskur zhig dgos phebs pa ltar phul/ ngur smrig gi sgrol ma dang*/ tsan dan sgrol ma rang byon dang*/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi bris thang yer pa ra ba la sogs rten byin rlabs can rnams mjal/ phyag mchod smon lam rgyas par byas/

de nas rim pas 'ongs te bsam 'grub rtser sleb/ chos bka' ci rigs pa dang rkyen sel gtso bor phul/ shar steng nas jo nang du tshogs la mang ja thon pa'i khro spus gtsang ba gcig gnang byung*/ lcam a mdzes drung byang phyogs su gnyen 'phrang la thegs nas/ rgyal bu 'khrungs sgo yang seng ge lung du byung zhing a mdzes drung rang sa der sku ma 'tsho ba zhig byung 'dugargyal bu sku na phra grag pas lam du nyer 'tshe byung dogs zhal ngo rnams thugs mi bde ba la/ 'dre gdon rnams la nged kyis bar chad ma byed zhig pa'i yi ge zhig kyang byas/ nyes zho med par bsam rtser myur du phebs thub/ zhal ngo rnams la rgyu sde lnga'i dbang dang*/ nai gu chos drug so so'i byin rlabs dang bcas pa cig kyang byas dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ snar thang dang byang chen du yang khor tsam phyin/ slar yang bsam rtser rgyal bu sku na phra ba la bar chad mi 'byung zhing rten 'brel dge mtshan du/ tshe dbang dang gtor dbang 'ga' re phul nas/ khri khang gi klu sdings su rin po che ka bzhi nas phebs 'dug pa dang yang mjal zhing*/ dgongs bzhed ltar khri khang pa'i zhal ngo rnams phyag phyir dkris pa dang bcas pa la/ 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma dang*/ bde mchog bong zhal can gyi dbang zhig byas/ 'di skabs dad gus chen po dpe med mdzad thugs nang gtsang ba'i gsung phebs pa sogs mdzad kyin 'dugapa snam lhun grub rtser sde pa kar bstan drung yang phebs shing*/ gsung phebs ltar zhag gsum bsdad/ nyin gcig dbyar dus kyi chu shin tu ches pas zam pa dang zhing la gnod che bar dogs pa chung la rang res sngags bzlas pa'i nas gtor bas de 'phral rang cung zad bri de nas je chung ngu song sang nyin nas gzung chu'i gnod pa ma byung*/ rdzong gi khang pa shin tu grum pa'i zhig nyen che bar 'dug pa la khrus chu gtor bas 'phral 'phral sa brugs yod pa yang rgyun chad/ phyis kyang lo mang du bcos ma byas kyang rdib choms sogs nyes skyon ma byung*/

bsam sdings su zhag bcu bdun tsam bsdad cing*/ shangs chos than thun dang*/ snying po don gsum sogs chos than thun 'dra bshad/ mdol byung du yang dbang chos sna tshogs pa 'phel bar byung zhing*/ bsam rtse nas 'di bar yan la/ yol pa mkhan chen dang bka' bcu rab 'byams sogs mang dag la/ theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan gyi gzhung bshad pas byang chub kyi le'u rdzogs kyi bar la zhib bshad mtha' chod par byas/ nyan pa po rnams blo gros 'dzings se 'dug pas de man chad la bshad tshom dang lung tsam byas nas re zhig bzhagabasam 'grub rtse dang*/ pa snam dang mdol byung rnams su rgyal rtse nas 'bod mi nan can byung yang 'gro ma 'dod pas khas ma blangs/ de rjes rgyal mkhar dbang ldan du phyin/ gting skyes la 'bod mi nan can yod pa'i don gyi rim gyis 'dos 'drar sleb cing*/ sde pa zhal ngo rnams dag mjal tsam byas/ gam pa nas nan chags mdzad pa ltar/ thog mar gam par 'gro dgos byung zhing zla phyed skor la rkyen sel 'dra phul/ kyai rdor gyi dbang zhig kyang byas/ slar gting skyes su 'byor te zla ba gsum tsam sdod dgos byung ba/ zhal ngo rnams dang chos rje stag sna ba/ dgon gsum gyi grwa rigs drag bsdus dang bcas pa rnams la/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag dbang byin rlabs 'khrid dmigs go don bshad pa yig lung dang bcas pa mtha' rgyas dang*/ dus 'khor gyi dbang zhig kyang sgrubs/ 'di skabs rgyal rtser nang zhig byung gda'/ brag dkar gyi mgon po'i spyan lam du gri che chung 'dres pa shin tu mang bar phul nas mnga' gsol byas skabs/ brag phug la rlung gseng sogs gang yang med cing phyi na'ang yul shin tu 'jam pa rang yin pa la/ lcam bral gyi lder bzo'i bar nas rlung 'tshub shugs chen po zhig byung*/ snyan dar dang dkar me rnams g.yos kun dga' chos dbyings pas zhun mar khur yod pa mnal ba dang*/ phyi ru khyi sob kyi sna nas khrag zags/

dgyes pa dang 'tshub 'gyur spel ma'i nyams su gda'/ de yang nga la dgyes gzhan la ma dgyes pa yin/ yang zhag shas nas dkar lar phyin mgon khang du zhag gcig gsol ba btab/ cho 'phrul chen po dpe med rang dang byang phyogs kyi bla rul 'ga' zhig 'gyel 'gro ba'i ltas gsal bar shar/ de nas zhag 'ga' song nas brag dkar du rgya nag gi ska rags spugs thags ma zhig la/ bka' bsgo dang 'dod gsol bris/ dam rdzas yo byad 'ga' re dang bcas nas kun dga' dpal bzang 'bul du btang bas nyams chags bskang ba'i rtags gsal por byung*/ de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa mjal bar bsam ste/ brag stod phyogs su chas/ pha drug gi tsha nas snga dro langs nas yongs pa'i nyin bde ba can gyi gdod thad der/ bsam gling mkhan chen sngags grwa pa bsu bar sleb byung*/ khong la rgyal 'gong rjes su 'brang pa'i cho 'phrul du ma 'dug nas de la gzir gyin phyin/ khong yang mdog ro sor zhum zhum pa byas song*/ de nas bla ma mchog gi sku drung du sleb/ da res 'phrad pa 'di dga' zhes shin tu dgyes pa rang gnang gin 'dugazla gcig lhag tsam sku drung du bsten rgyu byung*/ gtso bor sngar gyi nyams myong rnams la bogs 'don pa dang*/ gegs bsal ba lam du gtong tshul kho na'i bka' stsal pa rnams bka' drin du thob cing*/ gdams pa'i gnad kyi chos ci rigs pa yang stsal/ rang res ma thob pa'i chos zhu rgyu 'ga' re yod kyang*/ thob rgyu dang thos rgyas chog pa yod snyam pa kho na snying la bzhag ste zhu ba ma byung*/ de skabs bka' las/ 'u cag yang nam 'chi cha mi gda' grwa rigs lag g.yog grul btub tsam yod pa tsho yang phal cher shi da lta ni 'di tsho na sna tshogs las mi 'dug pas 'u cag shi ba byung na'ang shul 'di la khyod kyis blta dgos zhes yang yang gsung*/ lan cig 'di na mno bsam tha dad pa 'ga' re yod pas dgon gnas 'di mi 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel du chos skyong gi rtag gtor zhig tshugs phebs pa ltar bsgrubs yar rgyab nas zhing skyong zer ba'i dpon rigs shig 'das pa'i bsngo zhus 'phran bu skyel ba la/

sde pa'i drung rang gi phyag dam zhig kyang gnang byung*/ yar rgyab sde pas bar skabs der 'brel bcad/ de nas 'brel 'thud pa'i thog ma de mi shi'i sde sbyor de mdzad/ rten 'brel de 'dras yong*/ lan cig mgon po'i gtor chen brag steng du bskyal bas/ lcam dral lam me ba zhig gi gsal snang mthong*/ bskang gso'i thun gtor skyel khan la yang mthong snang mang po byung gda'/ chos rje sngags grwa pas gzhi byas rnams la tshogs 'khor zhig btang*/ tshogs rdzas kham re bsten pa la bla ma dam pa dang nged dang kun dga' dpal bzang dang gzhan yang 'ga' re la yang byung*/ lhag par nged rang grib shin tu na bas 'khrid brgya sogs 'chad 'phro tsho yang 'jog dgos la khad byung*/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas/ kha sang kho ba'i tshogs 'khor de ma dag pa'i grib tu 'dugatshogs kyi grib tshogs kyis sel bya ba yin gsung nas phyag nas tshogs 'khor zhig gnang bas/ tshogs kyi phyed tsam zas zin cing ma dan zhal gang bsten pa'i mod la sangs te grag song*/ 'di skabs 'jags pa sprul pa'i sku glo bur du sku gshegs pa'i bsngo rten dang gnas tshul skyes mkhan 'byor/ khong gshegs rkyen 'jags rang gi chos skyong ma dgyes pas bsrung skyob bral ba'i rnam par byung ba 'dra/ 'phral rkyen rnam gling chos sde par gtogs pa'i bla ma gcig gis 'jags pa'i dgon gzhis 'phran bu de pa mig 'og tu bcug pa la lo re lo gnyis tsam yang rang gis ma thub par dug sbyor byas 'dug pas yid skyo shas che ba cig kyang byung*/ spa lung du chos rje ngag dbang pa'i sku skye yang spyan drangs/ nged la 'bod mi byung ba ltar khor tsam zhig phyin/ sgom chen sems rgyud ma thul ba rnams zings shig kho nas dus 'da' ba de gshis su 'dug pas zir zir ba zhig las ni mi gda'/ slang yang brag stod du 'ongs te tshe dbang zhig rten 'brel du zhus/ phyir 'ongs dus brtan bzhugs shig phul zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba btab dus cang mi gsung*/

spyir rje btsun 'di nged kyi lo bzhi lon pa'i dus su mjal ba nas lo nyer lnga lon pa'i gting skyes su mjal ba'i bar de la/ snga phyir sku la bgres su 'gro ba'i rnam pa 'gyur ba ye med/ de dus phag lo yin/ de rjes kyi yos lo de la gting skyes su mjal dus/ cung zad bgres pa'i rnam 'gyur gyi tshul bstan 'dugade nas rta lo'i skabs kyi bar 'di la bgres tshabs che ba'i tshul bstan 'dug ste sku dbyings su bsdu ba'i dgongs pa brtad pa der gda'/ 'di skabs sku gzhogs nas tshur 'ongs dus chos rje sngags grwa ba blo bzo'i rig rig gras kyi byed pa phugs kyi rten 'brel du 'grol re nas/ nged la skyel ma yang bla brang gi sgo'i them pa'i mtshams su byed pa sogs snying rje zhing gad mo'i rgyu mang po byed/ snga sor rgyang nas thos tshod la khong pa brag stod du yang yang yong zhing bla ma dam pa la mos gus dang zhabs tog che phyag g.yog 'grub po yod zer ba'i grags pa cig kyang 'dug pas blo sems dkar bar yod kyang*/ 'di skabs khong gi mtshan nyid rtogs 'phral bla ma'i phyag nas gnang sbyin zhu ba dang kho pa mi rta mang po la lto chas dgos pa'i phyir du chos zhu ba la khag dkris nas sku gzhogs yang yang yongs par 'dug cing*/ gnang sbyin lkog tu zhus nas mtshan mo rtsibs ri la skyel/ 'bul ba gang yod khrom bsags nas byed/ gang sdod kyi ring la yang skyug bro la sngon slu ba'i spyod ngan kho na byed/ phugs kyi 'dod pa grwa rigs rnams rim pas slad nas kho rang la 'du bar byas/ bla ma la 'chi dgugs dang shul la rngams pa kho nar 'dugasnga sor phyag g.yog cung go chod pa'i khungs 'ga' shas yod pa rnams kyang lo gcig gi khongs su na lugs cig par byung nas thams cad 'das gda' ba yang dogs pa'i gzhir gda'/ spyir khong par ma zad 'di ba'i sde 'di tsho phal cher bsam sbyor shin tu rtsog pa 'di'i rigs kho na yong gin 'duga'on kyang*/

gang phyir 'jig rten skyon la dga'/ / skyon yang yon tan ltar mthong nas/ / zhes pa ltar/ skye dman rlung khyer ma tshos sna drangs pa'i mi nag pa phal dang btsun pa glad med tsho dad pa mi skye dgu skye ci byed las zad la 'gro ba gcig ni gda' lags/ de nas dgon pa bde ba can du sleb cing*/ ya byang mtsho sgo nyi shar rnams brgyud de yongs/ brag stod nas yongs pa gnas brtsams nyin re bzhin rlung chen pos rjes bcad pa bzhin du byung ste/ rang gi sems nyid chos skur ngo sprod pa'i bla ma de dang tshe 'di la phyis mi mjal ba'i rtags su gda'/ mtsho sgor shin tu 'tshub cing rlung nag spyi dang mi 'dra ba byung ba'ang khong rang rnams la 'phral du blta bar 'dugaphug dmar gyi la la mi rta 'khyer ba'i rlung tsam byung*/ ngas dam nyams kyis khengs pa'i lung ba pha gi tsho la 'gro dgos 'dis yin byas pas chos rje dkon blo sogs 'bod mi tsho lce nar byed kyin 'dugagadong dga' bde gling sogs brgyud/ grom pa lha rtse'i rdzong dpon 'phos 'phral gyi drang srong ba dang gro lung pa 'dug pas thab 'dzin btegahor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la ri khrod chen po jo nang du sleb/ de nyid nas ka 'khrid kyang btsugs snga sor nags phug mi dpon la brten pa'i kham mchu'i skabs/ nged myur du 'chi ba'i lung bstan dang bsdigs ri byed mkhan rnams la phal cher khong rang tsho 'dus byas kyi gnas tshul bstan grub/ byang rang gi dbu bla'i khungs gyag gyog de 'dra bzhi lnga zhig btud btud la 'ud tshar 'duga.ang yig pa sangs ma rgyas nye gnas sangs rgyas pa'i dper song*/ mang po zhig ni kha skyengs se ba gzhan las 'dzums gab gcig 'dugakha gcig ni nged la dbang dang drag po'i las mtha' byed do/ / snyam rang ngam rang phyogs rnams mi shes dgu shes mi dran dgu dran lag tu mi 'gel dgu 'gel byed pa'i rigs 'gres gzhan la yang dogs pa byed cing 'phral khyed byin rlabs can yin zhes tshig gi mos mos ltar byed/

nged rang tshang gi mdog smon 'gro ba sogs ni bar skabs der grub mtha' chos brgyud sogs kyang gzhan la ngo log gi khungs dang*/ dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas sna tshogs su smod cing bzlog pa dang ngan byed shes zer ba thams cad gsog par yang 'dug ste thams cad snying re rje snying re rje phaṭa kho bo nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i las tshogs ta thams cad la mkhas kyang*/ las mtha' sgrub pa'i don du rdzas sna cig kyang gsog ma myong*/ / 'khor lo sbar mthil tsam 'bri ma myong*/ ngan sngags 'phreng skor cig bzla ma myong*/ sgrub mtshams gcig sdom ma myong*/ dmyal rgyu skad cig kyang gsog ma myong*/ kho bos bltas na ni sems can rnams skal ba dman pas nga yi 'dod don ma 'grub pa kho nar song snyam gyin gda'/ gzhan gyi blor snang la khyod la dbang drag rgyas pa sogs byas pa'i zhad re mang gda' 'dod don yang 'grub kyin 'dug pa re mtshar snyam na/

rnam par mi rtog pa snying rje'i rang bzhin du shar bas/ ye shes smra ba po rnams la/ / ye shes gcig bus las kun byed/ ces pa de yin te 'ong*/ smras pa/ dbang bsdud mkhan dang drag sngags mkhan/ / bsam ngan po rnams bla tshugs 'dzin/ / rang 'dod dbang gis las tshogs bsgrubs/ / dmyal ba'i sgo che ma lags sam/ snying la nor sgrub sna tshogs bcangs/ / yong ni yi dwags khyu cig yong*/ / nyin mtshan dbang bsdud bsgrubs pa la/ / dbang thang gzhan la shor ba mang*/ / mthu chen 'dod pa'i drag las mkhan/ / dgra rnams tshe ring phyug la btsan/ / rang gi phyogs la god kha mang*/ / bzlog pa byas kyin 'dre gdon gnod/ / dge bshes bla ma shes ldan rnams/ / grong sngags nag po'i ring lugs spong*/ / dad pa brtan pos dge phyogs spel/ / bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa lags/ / bla chen mang tshad 'di 'dra gda'/ / chos kyi lag len lta ci smos/ kha skad tsam yang ye med pa/ / 'jig rten khengs grags kho nas 'da'/ / bden med la bden par 'khrul pa snying re rje/ / bden pa la dogs pa skye ba snying re rje/ / mgo skor la sha tshar nor ba snying re rje/ / drang po la rdzun du 'dzin pa snying re rje/ / a tsa ma a tsa ma snying re rje/ / 'ud gong gi le'u ma lags sam/ / da ni kyus la 'jug par bya ste/ de lo 'khrid gsar ba mang rab dang*/ 'khrid lo 'bring tsam byung*/ chos rje kun blo ba dang*/ grwa tshangs chen mo'i slob dpon rin po che bla ma ba dang*/ yol pa mkhan chen sogs mang rab la/ sbyor drug brgyud pa mi 'dra ba gzhan yang 'ga' re bshad/ sde ba ljang pa chos rje la srog gegs byung ba la gegs sel cig bstan/ sgom pa'i lugs byas kyang bcas bcos gzhan byed mkhan mang ba'i skyon gyis 'das/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu nas kun dga' chos dbyings pa'ang lhag par na ba la/ rim gro sman dpyad sogs gang yod byas na'ang nad 'or du lhung ba'i slar phyir lod la hor zla gsum pa'i nyer gnyis la khams ma 'tsho/

rjes sgrub gang grag rang btang bzang thag chod pa byung yang byung ba de gang yin/ nad gzhi ni spyi babs chang skyon gyi snga sor nas lus zom zhing yang yang na 'ong ba cig gda'/ de skabs kyang smug po byer ba 'dra ba cig 'duga'atsho byed spe bzang pa rdor gyis brtag dpyad byas pa zas ngan du ngos 'dzin byed kyin gda'/ dogs gzhi yang cung zad byung*/ gtso bor ni phan pa'i ngag la mi nyan par 'brel med byung rgyal du bskyangs pas lan song*/ rin po che ka bzhi nas/ 'di skabs kyi snga phyi rnams la/ dgon grwa rigs dang bcas pa thams cad da dgos khyod la blo gtong dgos 'duganged tsho'i cha nas chos nas bshad pa'i bla ma bsten tshul rnam dag zhig dgos rgyur 'dug na'ang khyed la sngar de bzhin la ma grub pa la 'thol bshags 'bul/ skye ba phyi ma bla ma'i dgongs pa sgrub par smon lam 'debs/ grwa pa kun la'ang de mthun gleng ba yod ces snga ma sku snyel ba tsam nas ma gshegs par la btud mar byung*/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum la sku ma 'tsho bar gda'/ de mthun gyi chos lung byang rtse'i phag mo dur khrod du spur bzhu dang*/ nged la yang bsngo rten gnas tshul skyel ba la grwa rigs rnams byon zhing*/ 'on kyang grwa rigs kyi mgo mi dang dgon pa'i khur len nged kyis byed ma dgos yang*/ 'di skabs su 'jags kyi phyogs su tsho gnyis su song ba'i phyogs gcig sngar lugs bzhin gyi rgyud la gnas na sems pa dang*/ bla brang rnying pa pa'i mi ngo shul ma rnams sku skye'i dbon po la brten gzhan phyogs la lhag par mos pa'i zi re ba byung zhing*/ gnyis thad nas yi ge dang zer lugs mi 'dra ba gsor thag 'then yong ba zhig gda'/ bsam mno la 'phral dar rgyas che chung dang kha drag zhan ji ltar byung yang chos lugs rkangs ma 'chugs tsam byung ba shangs lugs kyi chos kyi bstan pa la phan pa yin bsam pa dang*/ chos kyi rkang 'chugs na/

dar rgyas che yang shangs pa bka' brgyud dar bar mi 'gro dgos don stong 'dug bsam pas so so'i dbang du ma btang bar bsam rtser sde pa la yang zhus/ rnam gling chos sde dang dga' gdong sogs kyis snga mo nas sde pa la yang yang zhus gda' na yang*/ dang po'i zhal ngo de tsho shes ldan 'dug cing gzhan/ 'ba' zhig la gros 'dri mi dgos par rang thag chod pa zhig yod pas zhal bzhes ma mdzad gda'/ de kas da lta'i bar du tshugs ma stor tsam byung*/ zhabs drung tre bos kyang 'jags dgon pa phyag tu dgos tshul phebs byung na'ang*/ lan 'debs la spyir gyi 'bul mi 'dod pa min yang 'di kun zhal 'dzin gnang yang khong tsho la yang phan mi thogs shing phyag tu yang phan pa dka' bas da res mi legs zhus/ de ka lung bstan bzhin du song gda'/ de nas lo ma 'gor bar zhabs drung ngang sku 'das/ 'di skabs lhun grub spe'u nas bkod pa mdzad/ rtsad skor glang lung rdzong mdun khram mda' rnams la grwa khral grwa pa gsar ba drug cu lhag tsam byung ba lo bdun lon pa yan chad rab byung bsgrubs/ bsnyen rdzogs pa gnyis byung*/ jo nang gi chos grwar rab byung bsgrubs byas 'phral gyi rten 'brel yang legs/ khong tsho la mi 'khrugs pa sogs chos sna kha yar bsgrubs/ de nas sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes lnga la chos lung byang rtser phyin/ de nyin lam bkra yang legs/ zhag 'ga' shas chos than thun dang*/ lus la phan du re ba'i chu tshan 'dra bsten gyi yong skabs ngam ring nas 'bod mig gnang ba'i nged lhun sdings tsam du sleb dgos pa'i 'phrad 'dod yin nan chags phebs byung na'ang*/ phyogs der 'gro ba ltas la ma chug zer ba byas de don la ltag tshugs bzung ba'ang yin/ ci ste nges par mjal ba'i dgongs bzhed yin na chos lung nyid du phebs pa las thabs gzhan ma mchis shing*/ 'di skor la sku dog bar chad ye med tshul 'bul bar kun dga' dpal bzang pa sku zhogs brdzangs dus rje 'gyur med tsam ma gtogs phebs pa la bshol 'debs byed mkhan kho na byung 'dug na'ang*/

de res skabs nged kyi tshig la thugs bkal nas de 'phral bskyod pa bde bar chos lung nyid du phebs bzhud gnang byung zhing*/ de res nyes skyon cang ma byung ba de kar gda'/ gzhi byas thams cad la dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i skyes dang*/ rnam dkar gyi phun tshogs rgya chen po dang bcas par gyur cing*/ bzhed dgongs ltar dpal 'khor lo chen po'i dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs/ rkyen sel gyi rjes gnang mang rab dang bcas pa phul/ lo de nang du sku dog ltar yod phebs pa la'ang*/ hor zla bdun pa la 'dzer bag che ba tsam du snang*/ de min nyes skyon med tshul 'char sgo ltar zhus/ byang nas zhabs drung nyid kyi 'phral gyi bar chad 'ga' re sel ba dang*/ skye bo mang po la phan pa'i ltas kyang gsal bar shar/ chu chen po gcig nas srog chags kyi phung po lung phung tsam skam sar bton pa dang*/ gser gyi gru gcig las skye bo mang po sgrol snyam na 'jug mkhan mang po ni mi snang*/ las mthun ngo shes pa lnga drug tsam chu'i pha khar bsgral ba sogs rmi/ de rjes sgrub sde rnams la rtsa dbu ma sogs 'khrid chos 'ga' re byas/ 'di skabs zhag nyer bdun bsdad/ bsam rtser shar stengs nas dpon sa rin mo che sku khams ma 'tsho ba'i byang chog byed dgos byung ba gshegs rkyen rgyal po'i gnod pa la brten par 'dug pas gshed 'brel bgegs skrod bungs bskyed pas bltas kyang bzang ba tsam shar/ nged 'brug sbrul rta lo'i stod rnams las smad phyogs la song ba'i bar la smon 'gro ba dang chos lung gi grwa pa kha re khog 'brel/ dpon po kun rdor ba yang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rje rdo rings ba la dad pa logangag bzang pa'i che brjod kyis dus gda'/ dgon khongs dang lung pa'i phu rnams bya bral ming can skya min ser min byi po chom po tshos gang pa gcig byas/ jo nang du'ang smon 'gro ba'i khang par stong rdzus tsho'i 'du 'tshog sogs 'gro 'chams bltas rgyu'i khungs dang blo phyir 'chus mang po rang byung 'jugang yi bsam pa la de ka rang 'dra mo rang bsam pa gcig byung ba slar nga'i bsam pa der song*/

de nas mar lam jo nang brgyud nas byang chen du phyin/ sleb 'phral nas mtshams bsdams zla ba phyed gsum tsam du dge sbyor 'phel bar byung*/ khyad par rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa dkyil 'khor la brten pa cung zad byas skabs kyang*/ spyir yang ltas bzang bar byung zhing*/ khyad par hor zla drug pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin/ sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor las dngos grub blangs pa'i skabs me tog gi char 'bab pa rdzun med mngon sum du byung zhing*/ sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang mchod kyang zhag mang po lo na'ang gsar pa lta bu la dpe gzhan gyi mtshon du med pa'i dri ro bzang po che zhing gsal ba byung ba yang sbyangs pa dang rtogs pa'i cha shas tsam du go / 'di dag kun tu snga phyir yul dus kun gyi 'gyur ba la brten nas rang shugs kyi skyo shas che bar byung*/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la 'tshub dang cho 'phrul gyi rnam pas bla ma yi dam gyi gtor ma la/ o dkar bas gnod pa byed pa dang sdig pa rwa can shin tu che ba shig nam mkha' nas rang gi pang du lhung ba sogs sna tshogs pa byung ba rnams kyang dbyings su bskyal/ 'jags kyi gdan sa 'god dgos byung nas/ rnam gling chos sde pa dang*/ pa snam dga' gdong ba sogs 'jags la su thob ling nge ba la khong tsho'i ham pa rang rtsis su ma song bar/ khu spe bka' bcu ba kun dga' legs grub thugs dam grag pa'i khungs kyis bsko bzhag byas na'ang phyi ni sngar gyi rten 'brel de khar gda' bas nye gnas kyi skyon gyis zi re ba cig ka byung*/ snga sor rang re'i ltas dang mthun par/ 'di skabs ngam ring du sde srid rang sku khams stems par byung ba la sku rim rgya che ba gnang ba dang rje bla ma dam pas bka' dbang gnang ba sogs kyis sku khams bde bar byung yang*/ bla ma dam pa 'phral du sku khams mi bde bar byung nas zla ba de nyid kyi nyer bdun la byang ngam ring gi pho brang nyid du gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdu ba'i tshul bstan tshod du gda'/

nyer lnga'i rmi lam du bla ma dam pa byon/ 'u cag kha sang nas na yin yod zer ba'i skad cha yod par 'dug na'ang de 'dra ye mi bden/ sngar yang na ma myong da dung na ba mi srid ces thugs 'u re yod pa zhig gsal por byung*/ de dag kyang phugs nges pa'i don la dgongs shing*/ gnas skabs su zhig pa la slar 'jig tu med pa'i don sku 'da' ba'i ltas su gda'/ nyer 'dun gyi nyin thog mar spyan gyis mi gzigs pa ltar mdzad pa la slar sku gzhon nu'i rnam pa shin tu mtshar ba mu tig gi rgyan dra phyed khral khrol du gsol ba na bza' spangs pa'i rnam pa can zhig phyogs gzhan zhig la thegs tshul yod pa zhig byung*/ gnam gang gi nyin gnas tshul skyel mi sleb/ don du ni mthong thos dran reg gi gdul bya tha ma 'dul ba la dgongs pa dang snga sor bka' yang yang phebs pa ltar gyi dgon gnas kyi shul rnams bdag la gtod par bzhed pa ste/ de yang rje nyid rang nyid kyi gdan sar sku thim na/ bla brang gi nang ma nang g.yog dang grwa rigs sgom chen gyi ming can blun po rnams dang yon bdag gi khungs rnams 'phral zas gos dang phugs chos rdzu'i zoms la brten te sngags grwa ba rgyam pad rang gis mgo skor zhing bslad zin pas rje sku 'das ma thag par khong gis bdag byed pa zhig yong par 'dugade ltar na ni chos brgyud lag len nyams len yo 'chugs te bla ma dam pa de'i dgongs bzhed kyi log phyogs 'gal zla kho na la 'gyur 'gro ba der gda'/ 'di skabs kyang sku thim pa'i gtam thos ma thagakhong pas brag stod du phyin grwa ba rnams la'ang yi ge the'u tshe len pa dang bla brang gi sku chas nas ja spob rtse nyis sbrel sogs mang dag zhig rgyan bu'i rdzong dpon la rngan par bstabs na bza' bzhugs gdan sogs sku chas mang dag cig mtshan mo bskyed pa sogs zar zir mang po byas gda'/ 'on kyang 'gal rkyen mang pos lo shas bar du dka' se ba'i ngos nas snga srol bla ma nyid kyi dgongs pa la ji ltar yod pa rnams phyogs mthun tsam 'grub par byung ba ni rje nyid yul gzhan du sku thim pa'i rten 'brel las byung bas/

skye bo 'ga' zhig sde dpon gyi rdzong du sku 'das snyam ma dad pa byed kyi 'dug kyang*/ spyir phyogs de kun yang gnas bzang bar rgya gar paṇa chen nags rin sogs kyi rnam thar las shes shing khyad par rgyu mtshan gong du smos pa ltar dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mdzad pa kho nar nges shes skyes so/ / de skabs gdung chog ngam ring du gnang 'dug na'ang sku gdung rin po che sgrub gnas su spyan 'dren pa dang dgongs rdzogs kyi dngos bzhi sgrub par dngos kyis kyang mtshams bkrol te hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer gsum la byang chen nas chas/ yar lam rtsad skor gyi gnas 'di/ ngas pa'i sa gzhi la bgegs skrod tsam byas nas hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gsum la sgrub gnas chen po brag stod du slob/ tshes bcu'i nyin par/ nged rang gi mi sna grwa rigs dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang sku gdung spyan drangs nas 'byor zhing*/ de'i nyin nas dgon lag grwa rigs dang bcas pa/ thams cad 'dzom pa'i tshogs grwa btsugs/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin par grol ba yin zhing*/ rje bya bral du gyur pas sku chas rgya che ba ni lar nas med cing cung zad yod pa rnams ni chags med du gzhan la stsol bar mdzad/ lhag ma cung zad yod pa rnams kyang bar skabs der zegs 'thor du song bas nas cha phran tshegs ma gtogs thams cad nged rang gi lag nas btang*/ rten bzhengs 'phran bu yan chad grub pas de'i byin rlabs la brten nas phyis 'byor pa dang dge ba'i bya ba yang gong 'phel du 'grub pa cig byung*/ 'di skabs kyang sngags grwa rgyam pad pa yang dgongs rdzogs kyi skal ba len par byon yod cing nged kyis kyang khong la rnam gzhag sogs bzang du btang*/ khong pa rang gis ni sgrub sde la thug pa gcig kyang drangs pa med/ gdung la zhal zas gcig kyang ma phul/ dbus pa'i mi ngan khrel por ngo tsha med ltogs la can 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar zangs ma de ka bskyangs nas dgongs rdzogs grol ba'i nang par phyi la dengs song*/

de rjes su sgrub sde rnams la shangs chos dbang byin rlabs dang bcas pa cha tshang ba zhig dang*/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim cha tshang zhig bshad/ ngo sprod zhu mkhan mang du byung bas/ phyag rgya chen po'i nyams 'khrid mang du btab/ hor zla dgu pa'i nyer dgu la rin rdzong pa'i lag nas ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i sku dang*/ gting skyes brag dkar nas bdud mgon chen po lcam dral gyi sku phebs pa/ dus gcig tu 'dzom/ mgon khang gsar du btsugs pas gnyan par byung*/ nub gcig bla ma la gdung dbyangs kyis gsol ba btab pas rmi lam thabs su grub thob brgyad shin tu gsal bar byung de dang mthun pa'i bstod pa yang byas/

de nas zla ba gcig tsam song rjes su cung zad ltas 'tshub pa zhig byung nas mtshams dam por bsdams/ ngam ring la 'phral du 'gro ba'i chad so yod pa la'ang 'gyang cha zhus/ mtshams bsdams nas zhag gsum song dus/ bsam rtse nas sde pa sku 'bring pa'i drung mthu stobs rnam rgyal ba sku khams snyel ba'i stabs kyi 'bod mir stag tsho ba gnang ba'i zhal ngo thams cad kyis shin tu bka' nan che bar byung na'ang*/ sku khams da lam 'di la brten pa'i skyon che ba rang med snyam/ de bas nged rang gzab dgos yin pas dgongs grol rang zhu byas ltas dang bstun nas 'gro ma thub/ phyis sde pa mthu stobs drung rang de la thugs brnyas ma 'khrungs na'ang*/ sde pa kar bstan drung dngos mi dges tsam byung 'dugamatshams zla gcig lhag tsam song ltas kyang 'jam par byung nas ngam ring du chas skabs/ gtsang gi dmag dbus la bteg zer ba'i skad cha byung*/ gzhan la g.yar po mdzad pa'i dus 'khrug de spyir shin tu ma legs/ khyad par sde ba kar bstan drung rang thugs dgongs la rtog rtsing gang byas kyang karma pa yab sras kyi byin rlabs kyis 'khyobs yong snyam pa yod de rang gi las ngan la gzhan gyis skyob thub pa med/ da ni sde ba'i sku tshe yang lhus things snyam pa byung*/ 'di skabs brag stod kyi dgon lag mtsho dbus dgon par chos bros pa mi phal cig byung ba dang brag stod rang du btsun gsar ma gcig rang byung ba la rgyan bu rdzong dpon gyis rtsod pa gtong ba sogs sngar gyi ja spob rtse'i 'bras bu rnams mgo tho re ba smin gda'/ nged kyis gur chung la brgyud de ngam ring du sleb/ nam mkha' legs pa sogs bkra yang legs par byung*/ bde mchog bong zhal can/ sgrol ma bla med kyi dbang*/ bsam mi khyab kyi 'khrid sogs bzhed dgongs kyi chos bka' yang mang rab phul/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nyer lnga la 'gro rgyu yin na'ang*/ nyer gsum gyi nyin nas zhabs drung rang sku khams bsnyel ba rang zhig byung*/

sman dpyad pa rnams kyang 'tshab cha che bar byed kyin 'dug pa la/ spyir sku dog cung zad yod pa rkyen sel gyi dbang byin rlabs sogs kyis lhongs par snang bas da res sku la nyes skyon du mi 'gyur ba thag chod ces khas blangs/ kho tsho la khog gnod 'dra gcig kyang 'dugal la yid ches byed/ phal cher the tshom se byed do/ / sku rim sgyur kha 'dra phul ba ltar chos sde tshogs pa dang yang dus mtshungs te 'phral du bsgrubs zhag lnga'i bar shin tu bsnyel bar byung yang nyer brgyad nas gzung sku dwangs skyed che ba'i tshes gcig nas sangs dwangs 'phral rkyen sel gyis dbang phul ba kun yang phan thogs byin rlabs che bar mngon pa byung*/ phrag dog dang ngan smras la dga' ba rnams kyis snyil ba'i skabs sku mtshams dam po mdzad pa la sku ma bzhugs pa yin yong bsams nas col sgrogs sna tshogs kyis mdog gzhung khengs/ de rjes sku mtshams 'phral du bsangs pas de tsho la snying tshim pa'i mthar thugs pa gcig byung rje 'gyur med kyang phebs pa dang mjal byung zhing tshes bzhi'i dgong mo stod pa'i tshong pa rnams dang 'phrad khong rnams kyis gser sogs mang rab byin pa rnams phyis brag stod kyi rten bzhengs kho na la song*/ tshes lnga'i snga bar btegs mar lam jo bo rjes bzhengs pa'i mchod rten yang mjal/ tshes bdun gyi nyin mo chos lung du sleb/ bar skabs su dgon pa nyis 'dzin gyi tshul gyi sde srid rang gi phyag na yod pa de de skabs slar yang dngos la gtsang mar rtsis spros gnang*/ sngar bstan 'dzin rin po ches btsan phrogs mdzad pa'i mchod gzhis rnams 'di skabs rtsis sprod gnang ma thub gzhan mtha' dag ma tshang ba med pa byung*/ de skabs zhag shas bsdad nas zla ba de'i nyin shu lnga la sngar 'khyud ltar gyi jo nang gi 'khrid btsugs/ lo 'di la 'khrid lo 'bring tsam dang*/ btsun gsar byed mi drag zhan sna tshogs nas shin tu mang bar byung*/

'khrid grol nas zla gcig tu nye ba la/ gsang 'dus/ gshin rje gshed/ rgyu sde lnga sogs dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i yi ge 'ga' re brtsams/ jo mo nang gi sku 'bum chen mo'i lha khang ci rigs pa la dgon pa ba tshos mdzod byed pa cig bar skabs shig tu byung*/ rje grol mchog gi sku thog la de rnams 'don pa gnang 'dug na'ang*/ yos lo byang sku mched kyi nang gzings byung dus rje drung gong ma dpon slob rnams kyis dgongs bzhed mdzad nas/ bang rim gnyis pa'i gdod chen bzhi ma gtogs pa lha khang thams cad grong pa'i bskyas mdzod du song*/ de rnams spo bar 'dod pa cig snga mo nas yod kyang stabs ma bde ba la/ 'di skabs nye ring med par thams cad la skad btang ste zhag grangs 'di tshun chod la thon pa byed dgos tshul bsgrags par nged skyi phug tu mtshams shig byas/ 'di skabs shangs rdo sngon pa mi ngo gnyis 'brum pas 'das byang gcog sogs byed dgos byung*/ yin ni 'jags kyi chos skyong gi 'tshub tu mngon/ lha khang gi mdzod rnams dus thog tu bton cing*/ 'phral du gang byas pa'i dus nyin mo gsum btud mar nyin zangs kyi 'ja' 'od dang nyi thog dang 'ja' sprin gzugs brnyan shin tu ngo mtshar ba dang me tog gi char 'bab pa thams cad kyis mthong bar snyon med du byung zhing rol mo'i sgra snyan po dang dri bzang gi yul phyogs thams cad khyab pa'i rnam pa zhag mang por shin tu gsal ba zhig nged rang la byung na'ang*/ gzhan gyis tshor ba ni cher mi snang*/ 'khrul snang yin las che mod/ mtshams grol nas tshogs khro'i khro lugs cig kyang byas/ rgyud gyi rgyal po ma hā mā ya la ṭī ka chen don lhag par rgyas shing*/ de la bltos te tshig shin tu nyung ba zhig kyang ma brtsams/ chos lung du yang khor tsam phyin/ de rjes gsa' la brgal/ gtsang gzhung la yul tsho so so'i phu'i dgon pa ba rnams kyis lung pa'i mdar bsu ba ser 'phreng re mdzad/

grong tsho so sor bu skyes 'phral spyi pa las mang ba'i ming 'dogs dgos shin tu mang ba zhig byung*/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi ltas shin tu go / rim pas mang mkhar brgyud nas gting skyes su phyin/ dge 'dun mang po la skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim rgyas par bshad cing*/ byang sa'i lugs kyi sems bskyed phog bar 'dir gam pa la yang khor tsam phyin cing*/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur sogs chos bka' mang rab dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ slar yang gting skyes su sleb nas/ rdo rje phur pa sa lugs kyi cho ga las brtsams/ dbang mtha' dag rdzogs par don gnyer mang po la byas/ 'di skabs snga phyi rnams la/ rang res bsgrigs pa'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas kyi mgon po'i skor rnams ma gtogs pa'i gzhan mtha' dag zhal ngo rnams dang don gnyer rnams la byas/ dam rdzas kyi sgrub pa cig byas pa shin tu legs te/ dri bzang gis lung pa khyab pa dang*/ ltas rnams sngar bzhin shar/ de rjes ston ser kha ru yang song shing*/ brag stod kyi rten bzhengs snga sor hor zla gsum pa'i nang du 'go btsugs/ 'di skabs phal cher zin pas brag stod du 'gro ba'i yar lam la smad kyi phyogs la byas/ sgyed kyi ri khrod der yang khor tsam phyin/ byang phug tu jo bo la mchod pa dang gsol btab mang du byas/ skye bo mang pos blun dad la brten pa'i mi'i rgyan cha dri ma can ngan ngon mang po sku la sbron pas mi mdzes par song ba de rnams la rin po che'i dra phyed byed tshul gyi bkod pa yon bdag la zhus shing*/ sku la khrus gsol ba sogs kyang bgyi/ sku ngo bo me thub tu byon kyang*/ phyag g.yas kyi gru mo'i mtshams nas bral ba sogs cha shas la gnod pa mang du byung 'dug pas/ de dag gso bar 'dod pa tsam byung yang*/ mi gnod 'drer 'dzin gyi rnam pa 'dug pas spros pa bskyungs/ nged kyis ni lhag bsams gang dag byas pa'i khungs yin kyang*/

so so skye bo'i skyon gyis sems ngan pa'i mdud kha byung ba yin te 'ong*/ de skabs bsrung ma rnams 'tshub che ba'i rnam par byung zhing*/ de rjes zhag nyi shu tsam nas kho tsho'i mi ngo drag shos de sogs glo bur du shi/ zar dang stag sna'i mi dmangs rnams snga gong 'brel chags shin tu chung ba yin na'ang*/ 'di skabs phal cher dad pa skyes gyur pa'i tshul du byed pa cig byung*/ de nas rim gyis drang song rdzong sogs brgyud nas brag stod du 'byor/ sleb 'phral nas rten bzhengs kyi gzungs bzhugs sogs rim pas bgyis/ gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs yin pa dang*/ der rten bzhugs dgos pa nas/ rab gnas kyis cho ga kyang gza' tshes dang bstun snga bar byas/ sa chog gi sbyin sreg kyang zhi drag gnyis kar bgyis shing*/ hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin mo rab gnas dngos gzhi byung la/ de nyin zhi rgyas gnyis kyi sbyin sreg dang*/ bcu bzhi'i snga dro rjes kyi bya ba dga' ston dang bcas pa song*/ de nyin ka dbang dang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mtha' rten dang bcas pa sgrubs/ de bar du phyi rten byang chub mchod rten zhig brtsigs pa'i phyed tsam yang grub/ de rjes mi ring bar grub nas rab gnas kyang bgyis/ 'di skabs kyi rten dngul gdung dpangs su rtse khru drug pa/ bzo khyad phun sum tshogs shing lhun chags pa/ dbyibs kyang rgya gar dang mthun par bzhengs/ phra rgyan sogs kyang phun sum tshogs pa rang byung zhing*/ rje btsun byams pa'i sku brnyan rgya mtho gsum pa shin tu mtshar ba zhig dang*/ gser tog chung ngu gcig rnams bcos pa la/ yongs bsgril gser rkyang zho brgya dang drug cu song*/ de mthun dngul shas che ba dang*/ zangs sogs rgyu la sbags de yon rdzongs de las lhag dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas nas gser srang bzhis sna drangs te/ gos dar spus gtsang ba la lhus blangs pa'i gser zho nyis brgya'i rin thang gi tshad phul/

de skabs lag na yod pa'i yo byad thams cad dkrugs/ shul na gser se ba gang yang med/ spyir yang 'di yan chad du kho bo yon bdag grwa rigs mi bzang ngan/ 'byor pa che chung dad pa brtan mi brtan gang gi sar yang*/ chos phar gcod dgos pa'i bla ma'i rigs de yin/ tshur la 'bul ba bza' zos pa'i bla ma de 'dra min/ phar la mkhas 'jug gi ster sbyin dang ngo bstod yang byed ma myong*/ chos 'tshong mkhan min/ chos ster mkhan yin/ bla ma rlung zhags pa min/ bla ma rlung sgom mkhan yin/ bla ma bskyed rim pa min/ bla ma rdzogs rim pa yin/ bla ma rang don pa min/ bla ma gzhan phan pa yin/ bla ma las mtha' pa min/ bla ma las dag pa yin/ dge bshes sdig po che de min/ bya bral thos rgya chen po gcig yin/ 'phags pa dmyal ba'i gting rdo de min/ so skyes thar lam gsal byed gcig yin/ zang zing nor la brje bo byas/ / dam pa'i chos ni brdal por btang*/ / ha ha 'di yang lugs gcig yin/ / shi mthas ko mthas byed ri shi / 'di skabs bla ma'i don du rten bzhengs pa'i rten 'brel gyis mi ring bar longs spyod mnga' thang je 'phel du song*/ 'ga' zhig bla ma'i phyir du rten sogs la 'bad kyang*/ mthong chos kyi phan yon 'phral du mi yong ba de/ phal cher bsam pa ma dag pa'i skyon du snang zhing*/ kha cig ni bla ma rang gi yang skyon no snyam mo 'di'i skabs su tshes bcu gsum gyi nub mo bla ma chen po'i sku gdung dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por bsgrubs te/ thabs kyi dbus su zhugs me sgron pa'i tshe/ snga dro me tog gi char dang 'ja' sprin ngo mtshar che ba dang*/ dgong ja tsam nas shar phyogs su dbyar dus kyi 'ja' tshon legs po de kho na 'dra ba gsal bar zug pa yun ring du gnas pa byung*/ dus skabs hor zla dgu pa yin zhing char zim la sogs pa gang gis kyang rkyen med pas/ ya mtshan che bar mngon/ spur khang phye ba'i tshe gdung rus snyim pa gsum tsam las mi snang zhing*/

phal cher cung zi'am zhu dkar gyi rdo 'dra ba'i rnam par 'dugabaskal dus rnyings pa 'di la gdung skal khyab ches pa la'ang dgos pa mi 'dug pas dad can gal che ba 'ga' re la gdung skal gyi dmigs cung zad ma gtogs/ thams cad za ma tog gi nang du 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i sku brnyan dang lhan du mchod rten gyi bum par bzhugs su gsol/ deng sang 'di skad ces gdung rus nang rten du bzhugs pa dang gdung dngos su bcug pa ni lha khang dur khrod du 'gyur bas mi shes shing yul de la yang gnod do zhes zer zhing*/ rus pa'i rang mtshan med par thal bar sbyangs te tsha tshar bsgrubs pa bzhugs par 'dod la/ rgyu mtshan 'phags pa yin na rus bu bzhugs pa mchog yin kyang*/ bla ma rnams so so skye bo yin pa'i phyir ro zhes deng sang gi dpyod ldan du re ba phal che ba 'dod kyin 'dug ste/ gsang sngags pa'i bla ma de dkon mchog gi gra nas phud pa kha phyi zod zad kyi gtam yin mkhas pa 'di tsho rang kha nang gi lpags pa 'thug grags pas dga' mo yod gin yod 'duga'u cag ni rtsa ba'i bla ma so so skye bo yin zer ba kha shin tu rang tsha'am sems/ mi mkhas pa phal cher ni/ blun dad nyid kyi sgo nas gdung rus nang rten du byed pa la dga' bar yang byed do/ / de nas slob mas bla ma la so so skye bo yin zhes kha gdangs nas ngo mthon du brjod par mi spobs la/ 'on kyang the tshom za na tsha tshar bsgrubs te bzhugs pa sogs los kyang 'thad/ gang zag de nyid la phan gnod ni sangs rgyas kyis dngos su gsal bar ma gsungs pas rig gras kyis lung bstan byed dka' la gnod par ngais na ni ba so dang rus pa la lha sku brkos pa la yang sems can de la gnod par thal bar ni 'gyur/ dur khrod skyon du 'gyur na ni/ 'phags pa yin yang skyon de yod par mngon/ 'phags pa'i spur skyel sa de yang dur khrod ka yin mod/ dur khrod du gyur kyang gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa la ni bkra mi shis pa yang ma yin/
