der ma zad 'dul ba las kyang grang khang du dur khrod 'bri bar gsungs pa kun la yang skyon 'dogs sam ci/ 'dir ni dam pa la 'di phal pa'i sa las 'das pa'i nges shes brtan po yod cing gdung rus rin po che dang mtshungs par gyur pa de/ slar yang phye mar bgyid pa'i blo ngan ci zhig byed/ de rjes su gzhung chu la gtor ma btang bas chu mig zhig kyang gsar du brdol/ 'tshams thung tsam byas pas ltas kyang bzang bar byung*/ gtsang nas sde pa kar bstan drung la shin tu mdzer pa'i rtags gsal po yang yang byung yang de lo thugs 'gyur re 'dug pas sku rim sogs snyan 'bul ma byas/ bal po bzo bo rnams slar ngam ring la 'gro skabs brgyan bu gnyer pa bshes gnyen pas ci lod lod byas shing*/ spyor brtod kyi yi ge rten bcas mi len par ma zad sa la rdebs pa sogs shin tu 'ur bar 'dug na'ang*/ zla gcig tsam nas khong rang btegargyu tshang ba las 'bras bu yong ba chos nyid du gad spa lung la'ang mi 'dod bzhin du khor tsam phyin/ de rjes cig nyo'i nang brgyud nas ding ri nas lung dang dgon pa rgya lung sogs su khor tsam phyin chos 'brel mang rab byas/

ding ri phyogs su nas ster mkhan byung ba 'dra la cha rkyen byas/ rgya lung du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod gtsugs/ 'di dgon chung yin yang bar chad byed mkhan med pas btsun gsar byed mkhan yang mang du byung*/ brag stod phyogs su ni spyi babs snga gong yul phyogs de kun na lo nyes sogs bar skabs su mi 'dod pa du ma yod kyang*/ rten bzhengs rnams bkra shis pa'i de nas da lta'i bar shin tu bde bar byung ba 'di yin na'ang*/ rgyan bu rdzong dpon chos dgon pa la snyen bkur byed mi yang 'gegs shing btsun gsar byed sa med pa dang*/ tha na gnas skor rten mjal sogs kyang byed sa med pa'i nag yig 'grems shing sgrog par byed do/ / de stabs nas 'di skabs btsun gsar byed mi ni ma byung*/ 'on kyang da ni dgon pa stangs zhan du ni mi 'gro las che snyam ste da dung rim pas rtags mngon du 'gyur ro/ / brag stod du tshogs chos kyang ci rigs bshad/ lcags zam pa sger pa chos rje ngag dbang pa la shangs chos gang zhib cig byas/ slar 'du khang bzheng rgyu'i shing bzo gal che ba rnams kyang grub/ bya lo'i nang du 'du khang bzheng rgyu'i bkod pa sogs kyang bgyis/ snga sor lug lo'i dgun chos kyi skabs/ ngam ring sde srid du mu tig chen mo mang rab dang*/ g.yu gos dar sogs zhu rten bzang ba rang phul/ bla ma dam pa de nyid ched kyis spyan 'dren gnang ba dang*/ gnas skabs su rkyen des sku 'das pa'ang yin/ sku 'da' sa tshun thams cad nas thugs khur bzhes pa'i bka' babs 'dug bsam bstan pa'i rgyun la dgongs pa'i chos gzhis tsam zhus pa yin na'ang gnang ma thub/ nyin gcig 'khar lung yong gsung na'ang*/ de'i sang rang 'gyur nas mi yong gsung*/ de kha'i dod du spyi dang bla brang yongs sdoms la nas khal stong phrag gcig spyi sa'i rnams bstan pa nam gnas par dang*/ bla brang gi rnams nged rang gis 'dzin bdag byed rin gnang ba'i zhal bzhes yod pa ltar gyi 'di lo'i yong sgo rnams rtsis blangs/

sde srid nas dngul gdung la dkar me khor yug gcig kyang 'dzugs pa gnang*/ 'di skabs ngam ring du yong dgos tshul nan chags phebs na'ang dus 'khrid chag dogs nas ma phyin zhing*/ ya byang sogs lam zhor la yong dgos zer ba rnams la khyag khyog ma byas par lam bsrangs te jo nang du dus chos la sleb par byas/ 'di lo 'khrid gsar ba shin tu mang zhing 'khrid lo yang legs/ bla brang gi mkhar las dang rten bzhengs sogs 'di ltar byed dgos pa 'dug snyam pa glo bur du blo la shar/ hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu'i nyin/ dngos gzhi'i dam po'i mtshams kyi sgang zhig la/ bsam rtse nas nged la 'bod mi gro mo che ba byung 'ar 'ur 'dra byed kyin 'dugakhong yang dus sde pa kar bstan drung snyel ba rang med pa 'dug na'ang*/ khong pa 'dir de ring sleb rgyu'i mdang nub de snyel yod par gda'/ ltas kyang 'tshub pa nas khong la re zhig khas ma blangs/ yang sku ltem pa yin zer nas mgron gnyer 'jam dbyangs sogs tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin mo sleb/ snga sor dbus dmag rting ma mdzad pas sku tshe la gnod cing snga phyir ltas kyang shin tu ngan pas sku khams mthar thon mi yong nges snyam/ mtshams 'og tu khong tsho la ngag 'phrad tsam byas/ nam yong nges can ni khas ma blangs byin rlabs rten dang dung rdzas sogs bskur de 'byor pa'i nyin mo sku khams bde tsam byung 'dug na'ang tshes bcu drug gi nyin mo sku ma 'tsho/ mgyogs bsngo'i rten yang 'phral du sleb/ de mthun gang myur 'gro dgos shar te/ 'khrid 'phro mgyogs po byas/ nyer gsum gyi nyin mo thon pa'i snga dro yong khar bla brang gsar rgyag gi sa chog rnams byas shing der yang lam bkra yang bzang tsam dang*/ lcags kha bkra shis rtse'i gdong der gnas brtan bcu drug dang*/ rnam thos sras kyi sku la rab gnas zhu mkhan zhig kyang byung ba'ang shin tu bzang*/ ri klungs thams cad kha ba babs pa'i skya lam me 'dug pas yid spro ba zhig kyang shar/

spyi de skabs kyi kha ba de khro phu'i dgon pa gsar 'debs la sde pa gser ma nas rang la 'tshub kyi rnam pa yin par 'dug na'ang*/ nged la rten 'brel legs pa cig byung*/ rting sor jo nang bla brang gsar 'debs kyi 'gram 'dings pa'i nyin/ gtsang sa nas nged la 'phags pa sa'i snying po'i li sku legs pa cig gnang byung ba 'grig pa sogs ltas bzang po yang rim pas byung*/ de skabs rtse ru sleb nas re shig gsang sgo'i tshul dang bstun pa'i phyi ltar du dbang 'bul gyin yod pa'i tshul byas nas/ mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga re btang*/ mtshan brjod pa sogs dge 'dun mang po la 'tshom chen du tshogs bdag dkar po sogs chos 'brel 'dra byas/ sleb nas zla phyed skor nas gsangs brdol/ chog grwa che ba 'dzugs pa mdzad/ zhal ngo snga ma 'das grongs byung ba rnams la kar lugs kyi ser gsogs las gzhan pa'i chog grwa rgya che ba yang ma byung zhing*/ cung zad yod pa yang phyogs ris can kho na yin 'dug na'ang*/ 'di skabs grub mtha' phyogs med kyi chog grwa 'dzugs par mdzad/ mthar spung bzhu sogs thams cad rjes gtsang bar bsgrubs/ dgongs rdzogs rgya khyon che ba sdig dang ma 'dres par byung*/ de yang sku 'bring pa'i drung dang zhabs drung rgyal bu yab sras gnyis kar la ngas chog grwa 'di phyogs med ris med rgya chai ba rang gnang dgos zhus pas de 'phral zhal bkod gnang song*/ sngar srol med pa'i ngaur zha lu sogs 'di nas gzung nas chug pa yin/ kho rang tshos pho skyes nas byung ba ye med/ 'di skabs skyed ru ba sde pa rgyal las brgyud yar rgyab nas 'phral du yong dgos tshul nan can rang gsung gin 'dugalo 'di'i nang du 'bod mi yang yang dang gtsang sa'i ngo spron sogs byung na'ang ltas bzang po lar mi 'dug pas blo thag bcad/ der sku tshigs zhe dgu grol nas nged kyis shangs phyogs su phyin/ sgrub gnas 'jug tu shangs chos than thun mang du bshad/

don gnyer 'ga' la gcod khrid sogs nyer mkho 'ga' yang byas/ stag sna'i dgon par 'bod mi byung ba bzhin phyin/ pha rin po che tre bo sprul pa'i sku'i dngul gdung la rab gnas dang*/ tshogs pa rnams la chos 'brel tsam bshad/ mi shangs chos 'khor gling du khor tsam phyin de mi dmangs la khrom dbang zhig kyang byas/ slar yang 'jag tu khor tsam 'ongs nas grwa tshang chen mo sogs lam du yang 'gro don ci rigs pa dang bcas te/ nyug rgyal khang du phyin zhag gsum bsdad/ nang so zhal ngo sogs so so la don gnyer gyi chos than thun bsgrubs shing*/ de rjes gser mdog can du zhag brgyad tsam gyi ring la tshogs pa thams cad la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyas pa dang*/ sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang sogs tshogs spyi dang*/ sgos so sor dbang byin rlabs sogs sngags chos mang ba dang*/ bla brang dang shangs pa grwa tshang gnyis su bsnyen rdzogs sgrub pa yang shin tu mang bar byung*/ mkhan chen 'jam mgon lhun grub kyis rten bzhengs mdzad pa'i thub pa jo tshad ma de la/ dus 'khor gyi cho ga'i steng nas rab gnas kyang byas/ brag dkar chos rje drung dang yang de dus thog mar 'phrad pa yin/ sgrub gnas bsam gtan sdings su yang zla phyed tsam la gzhir bzhugs pa rnams la chos thang thung ci rigs pa dang*/ shangs pa slob dpon pa sogs 'ga' shas la phag mo lha so bdun ma'i dbang dang sgrub dkyil gyi gzhung sogs bshad cing*/ de nas 'dol byung du zla phyed tsam bsdad pa la yang zhal ngo rnams la dbang chos ci rigs pa dang*/ chos zhu ba rnams la rdo rje gtum po'i dbang dang*/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa dang rang re'i brtsams chos mang dag sogs chos bshad rem par byas/ yar lam 'brong rtse brgyud nas rtse chen du 'byor zhing*/ snga sor rtsa chen chos sde'i gdan sa mkhan chen rab mdzes pa sku gshegs 'phral nas/ slar yang nged la byed dgos tshul gyi gsung bris rim can du yod pa dang*/

'di skabs kyang byed dgos tshul nan chags che che skad yang yang mdzad kyi 'dug kyang zhal kho na las snying nas min par yang 'dugachos sde pa phal cher blo 'dun par yang 'dug mod/ phyogs de kun sngar las rnam par 'gyur ba'i bun ne pa zhig las mi 'dug pas byed 'dod kyang ye ma skyes/ dbu mdzad mkhar thog pa la he ru ka'i 'du shes rang mdzad kyin 'dug pa la bzang rabs dma' 'bebs rang byed pa'i skabs de yin/ 'dir yang chos zhu ba rnams la chos sna ma nges pa than thun sna tshogs dang*/ zhal ngo sogs la yang bzhed pa dang mthun pa'i dbang chos ci rigs bshad/ gsung rab dang rten gsar bzhengs rnams la rab gnas kyang bgyis/ zhal ngo rnam dag mang mkhar gnas pa'i chos mdzad da lta mkhas pa sangs rdaur bar grags pa 'di sogs la zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid cig dgos gsung ba ltar rgyud ci 'khul gyi khungs su bshad pas/ chos mdzad khong res bya bral gyi khungs byas kyi rting la/ lhun rtser zhu log phul khong rang tshang gi grwa pa mang po khrims la sbyar ba sogs rang gi bya byed kyi mnong la phogs ste chos zhu 'phro la sleb ma byung bas ngo mtshar zhing rgod bro bar byung*/ rgyal rtser yang phyin cing sdod sa zil gnon gyi gzims khang gsar pa der byas/ zhal ngo rnams su tshe bka' sogs rkyen sel mang dag dang*/ dbang cha gcig la bde mchog lū hi pa'i dbang*/ sa dge zha lu ba sogs sna tshogs 'dres pa'i bla ma slob dpon dge bshes mang dag la/ dpal gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid mar 'gos gnyis kyi lugs cha tshang ba dmigs pa rnams spungs kyin bshad/ yang mar lam rtse chen klu sdings su zhag gcig bsdad/ 'di dus rtse chen du snga phyi gnyis car la chos bdag bzang ra babs nas/ chos sde'i 'dzin bdag byed dgos tshul nan chags byed/ phyis kyi rten 'brel 'ga' la bsams khong rang gi mngon du cung zad tsam khas blangs/ de rjes skye mkhar gyi chu tshan zhag shas bsten pas lus la yang 'phrod rab byung*/

'dol byung du sleb dus 'brang phu nas a ma lags dpon g.yog kyang phebs byung*/ snga sor rtse chen du sleb dus nas 'byor rgyas pa 'bod mi la gnang ba ltar rim pas bsam 'grub rtser sleb/ yab sras rnams su phyag chen ga'u ma'i khrid dang*/ dbang rjes gnang mang dag phul/ 'di skabs khro phur rdib bcom byung 'u lag pa sum cu skor shi pa'i skabs de yin/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig la slar yang khri khang du sleb bzhed dgongs dang mthun pa'i chos than thun phul/ mgon khang gsar pa la rab gnas dang rten gtor 'dzugs pa sogs byas de khang pa kha phyir bltas bag ma phebs po cig 'dugachos rje gnas gsar pa yang 'phrad du phebs byung*/ tshe dbang zhig dgos gsung ba ltar byas/ gnas gsar nas sde pa'i phyag nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil thang rgya gar ma dus zhabs pa chung ngu'i thugs dam rten yin zer ba/ sngon jo nang pa rang gi yin nam zer/ gang ltar rje sgo rum pas rin po che mkhyen brtse ba la gnang ba de/ rta chas gser chas shig byung na nged la cis kyang ster ba yin zer gyin 'dug pas/ sde pa kar bstan drung gi dgongs rdzogs skabs byung ba'i gser chas sga 'khor tshang ma dang ral gri mgo shubs legs pa dang bcas pa gzhan yang ja gos dar sogs bslu yon gyis thugs tshim par byas de thang ka blangs/ khong rang yang lhag par mgu zhal bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi bris thang zhig kyang rting nas bskur byung*/ de nas snar thar gyi phun tshogs gling du yum sras rnams kyi gsung nan can byung ba ltar zhag bdun tsam bsdad/ byang chen du zhag nyi shu skor bsdad cing mtshams zhag bdun ma zhig grol nas/ sngar ma thob pa 'ga' shas la mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs/ spyi khyab tu thig le bcu drug gi dbang sogs chos bka' ci rigs byas/ 'di skabs gnas srin po ri nas drung yig bal du ba gnang ba'i yar lam gnas dang khro phur yang rab gnas dgos tshul sogs phebs sgo byung ba la/

gnas su ni dgongs bzhed ltar yong ba gzhir bcas/ khro phur 'brug pa'i grwa tshang gsar 'debs gnang ba la/ nged kyi rab gnas de rang mtshal rang la byas btsag mi'i dper yang 'gro las che zheng*/ khong bla ma tsho yang ma dgyes pa cig yong*/ rab gnas legs pa'i yon mchod rnams bkra shis pa ji tsam byung rung*/ 'brug pa'i thugs rje yin zer ba cig las mi yong*/ de las ma byung kyang khyad mi 'dug ste/ ci ste sku dog dang byur chags thug pa 'dra byung na/ thog ma rab gnas byed mkhan des nyes zer ba cig yong bas/ khro phu'i rab gnas la cis kyang dgongs grol dgos zhes kha gsal nas zhus/ de mthun gnas su khor tsam 'byor skabs gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i dbang sogs dgongs bzhed kyi chos rnams phul/ nub re bzhin ser bas sna drangs pa'i drag char yun ring ba 'bab cing*/ nub gcig rdzong gi 'khris su thog babs pa sogs phyi nang gi ltas thams cad rtsub tsam byung*/ de rjes jo nang du sgrub sde rnams bsod snyoms lam gyis tsam la sleb/ zhag nyi shu skor zhig bsdad pa babs nas don med sog dal du las se ba cig byung na'ang*/ ston dus bzang zhig rig pa dwangs la skyid par byung*/ bla brang dam chos gling gsar du btab pa'i 'og thog thams cad khel ba dang*/ bar thog kyang ci rigs khel ba la rab gnas kyang mdor bsdus shig byas/ las ka grub che zhing phyi nang du 'tshub dang nyes skyon gyi rnam pa ye ma byung ba'i gtang rag gi tshul du gzhong stod kyi dur khrod du gtor ma rgya che ba zhig btang*/ grub thob 'dar phyar gyi sgrub phug steng 'og gnyis kyi 'og ma bdag med ma dang bde mchog sogs zhal gzigs sa dang*/ steng ma slob dpon pad+ma dang mjal sa yin par snang zhing*/ 'og mar phyin dus brag gi phug nas chu dri bzang che ba zhig gsar du brdol ba sogs ltas mtshar ba cung zad byung*/ jo nang sku 'bum nang gi sman sku chag grugs byung ba la zhig gsos byas pa phal cher 'di skabs grub/

rnam sras kyi 'cham sku gcig kyang bzhengs/ snga sor lo 'di'i dpyid gsos ngam ring du 'gro rtsis kyi khongs yin na'ang*/ gtsang la 'gro dgos stabs nas ma thub pas/ bsam sdings su yod dus nas gzung 'jad nas khang pa 'bod mi car sdod gnang ba ltar/ 'di skabs ngam ring du chas pa'i lam rtsad skor du dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi sa chog dang phyogs gtor sogs rgyas par byas/ phyogs gtor tsho skyel sa nor ba'i zing nge ba gcig byung*/ phyis yon bdag 'pho ba'i ltas su gda'/ rim pa'i ngam ring du 'byor/ sngon ma rgyang tsam sdod rtsis yod na'ang gting skyes la 'gro dgos stabs nas zla gcig las sdod long ma byung*/ de bar du gtso bor sde srid kyi bzhed dgongs dang*/ gzhan bla ma slob dpon sogs chos thob don gnyer dang bcas pa la chos ni 'phel bar byung*/ sa grang zhing dgun nyi ma thung ba'i dus yin na'ang chos thob rtsi ba'i rigs la chos 'gro yang che rab byung*/

de yang sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba rang res bsgrigs pa'i go rim ji lta ba bzhin du nor lha'i skor yan chad yongs su rdzogs pa la rjes gnang gi ngo bo nyis brgya tsam yod pa phal cher dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen mo dang*/ phur bu sa lugs kyi dbang drag po sgrol dbang dang bcas pa/ ras chung lugs kyi tshe dpag med lha mang*/ gzhan yang phyag rdor sogs dbang dang khrid kyang mang du byas/ chags sdang sna tshogs la brten pa'i rtsub zing nge ba zur rong nge ba yang dgos par byung*/ gting skyes la mgyogs po 'gro dgos yin na'ang*/ a ma drung rten mjal sogs gnang dgos kyi khyad nas/ chos lung du yong dgos byung ba'i rten mjal zhi brgyas 'bul ba dang*/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang tshe dbang sogs rkyen sel gyi dbang yang mang du 'bul dgos stabs chos lung du zhag bdun bsdad dgos byung*/ snga sor bstan 'dzin rin po ches bzhes spyod mdzad pa'i mi sde grong rnams phal cher skabs 'dir sde srid lcam sring so so nas chos lung du sbyor 'jags kyi rtsis sprod gnang*/ grong pa kha shas smon 'gro nas kha snga bang mgyogs kyis zhus grub nas gnang ma thub/ mdog smon 'gro ba 'di dang po rje btsun grol mchog chos lung du thog ma phebs dus/ mdze po thar pa dang mjal ba'i rten 'brel las chos lung du dam sel chen po yod par lung bstan mdzad pa rnam thar na yang thebs pa'i dam sel chen po'i mtshan gzhi de smon 'gro ba kho nar gda'/ dang po rang rje dam pa'i sku skye mang por nye gnas su gyur pa/ dge slong dpal 'byor la dpon drung 'phan ne rang gis dug sbyor byas bden mi mang po'i rgyas yod dbang po can dang yin 'dugarje bla mas dgon pa'i khur bzhes gnang dgos rgyu la yang*/ 'phan gyi dus chos gsung rgyu yod tsam ma gtogs lar ma phul/ khong 'das rjes lo lnga khur bzhengs mdzad pa la rtse ba rnams rbud pa'i dam 'gal mngon gyur dang byas/

snga mo khong tshos gang cir mi rigs pa byas pa la grangs med par 'dugaphyis kyang nged tshor gzhob rdog gnon rang gang shes byas pa dang bla ma rin po che byams pa'i drung sku gshegs pa la dar 'phyar byed pa sogs ji snyed cig yod/ sngon rje grol mchog gi rten bzhengs skabs/ phyogs kyi dad 'bul la tshad bzung du med skabs dngul sde yangs gang dang gser g.yu dre'u rgyab mang po smon 'gro rang gis zos zer ba'i kha skad grags chen yod pa yang don la bab nges yin/ rjes su'ang snyan dar mchod rdzas dgon pa'i yongs 'bab za kham lung med rgyun du byas pas/ dang bo kho rang tsho dga' tshad yod pa yin kyang dkor zug nas phyis kha lag mthil la thug pa yin/ dgon pa'i sgrigs bshig pa'i yang gtso bo rang de khong tsho lags na'ang*/ nged kyi cha nas 'khon bsangs ba cig ka byung na legs bsam pa dang*/ chos lung sgrub pa ba 'ga' res nan chags res byas pa la brten lug lo dpon sa la bshags pa blangs/ rim pas dpon drung la yang len rtsis yin kyang bshags pa byed zer ba kha tsam tshig tsam kho na yin pa'i rtags lo gcig tsam yang ngang sring mi thub par kha dang don thams cad nas mi rigs pa kho na byung ba dang*/ spyir khong tsho mna' dam bzhag dam tshig thams cad spangs dug sbyor ngan byed slus mgo g.yogs sogs dran tshad lag tu 'gel mkhan du gda' bas 'di skabs nas slar yang 'brel ba spangs/ de snga'i bya byed la brten rje byams pa'i mtshan can sogs bla ma gong ma'i dam tshig bsrung ba la yang de dngos legs par byung*/ de nas rim gyis chas de lam 'gor gang yang ma byas par gting skyes su 'byor/ khong tsho la dpon mo phebs pa'i bgegs skrod dang*/ thog mar chos bka' than thun ci rigs phul/ gam bar yang zhag bcu skor zhig song*/ gsang 'dus dang kyai rdor gyi dbang dang rkyen sel mang rab phul/ slar yang gting skyes la rgyang tsam bsdad/

gsang ri ru sdod gnas kyi mkhar las byas pa la lta bar phyin khang bkod blo dang mthun pa ni ye ma byung 'dugazhag gsum bsdad skabs dus 'khor thugs dkyil ras bris la brten nas khang ba rab gnas dang*/ rang gi g.yog rnams la chos sna mi gcig pa bcu gsum gyi 'go btsugs/ nyi ma rting ma la gting skyes nas sde pa yab sras kyang phebs/ tshe mdo'i bshad pa yongs rdzogs shig kyang byas/ gting skyes su snga phyir ma hā mā ya dang*/ sam pu ṭi'i dbang dang rang re'i bde mchog gi bstod pa'i 'grail chen dang*/ ma gcig gi gcod khrid tshar gcig sogs chos 'phel rab yang byung*/ de nas jo nang gi dus chos kyang ran pa las 'phyis pa tsam du song bas/ gting skyes nas yongs ba'i nyin rlung 'tshub che se ba gcig la de dgongs gangs babs pas sang nyin lung pa thams cad skya lam me ba byung*/ byams gling dgon par khrom dbang zhig kyang byas/ dpal rtse nas sngar sku drung sdig po che rang yod dus 'brel chags dga' rab yod rung*/ khong pa 'das nas ngor mkhan drung gi bslab ston la brten de nas 'di'i bar la 'brel rgyun bcad/ thag thug chang chung yang yong ba cig ka byung song na'ang*/ 'di skabs nan chags kyis 'bod mi byung nas/ dpal ldan rtser bcags mal zhig bsdad/ gdong dgar yang zhag po bzhi pa zhig sdod dgos byung*/ jo nang du hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu bzhi la sleb/ bco lnga nas dus 'khrid kyang 'go btsugs/ 'dzam thang pa'i grwa ba sog po'i bla ma byed mkhan sangs rgyas dpal zer ba khong dpon slob rnams sleb/ khong pa la sog po'i rgyal po zhig gis rnying pa tsho bzhi'i bla ma so so la 'bul ba bskur ba ni mang dag yod par 'dugagazhan khong rang rnams kyi blo gtad jo nang rang la gtso bor dad mos kyis zhabs tog byed par yong ba yin 'dug kyang*/ dbus gtsang du sleb nas mar phyogs na 'brel cung zad yod pa'i nā len+d+ra/

rtse gdong*/ ngor/ rta nag rnam rgyal sogs khams dgon rnams su tshogs gsog gi rnyed bkur zhu ru phyin dus thams cad mgrin gcig tu chos zhus dang*/ zhabs tog byed sa nged kyi 'di kho na yin/ jo nang ni sngon gyi skad cha tsam min/ pa da lta stong pa bzhin song sku 'bum gcig yod kyang zhabs tog med/ chos 'chad mkhan yang med/ btsun ma nyung shas shig sdod mkhan yod pa de kun yang lto mi 'byor bar dka' thub la snyad pa'i kar gong za ba las med zer/ khong tsho'i rgyu nor 'phran bu rnams la hams pa'i kha bslus 'ba' zhig brjod 'dug cing*/ khong tsho yang de bzhin bden pa yin 'ong snyam khams phyogs na jo nang pa dang 'brel med kyis nges med mang po la rnyed bkur byas/ nor phal cher zad pa na gnas tshul cung zad rtsad chod de jo nang du sleb/ bsnyen bkur rgya cher med na'ang mang ja skol ba sogs mchog tu dga' bas bsgrubs/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dgos zer ba ltar gzhi byes sngar dus 'khor gyi dbang ma thob pa rnams dang lhan cig dbang bskur rgyas par bsgrubs/ mgon po che chung gi rjes gnang yang byas/ dbus gtsang gi grwa sa mang po zhig rdzun dang ltogs la che ba la nges shes rnyed do/ / 'di skabs gangs chen po rang babs/ byang nas lhun grub spel ba kun dga' gnang nas gtsang pa 'di la byus ci 'dra yong*/ zhabs drung rang so bdun pa'i skeg la dog gam mi dog gsung ba la/ gtsang gi srid 'di ni da dung gong 'phel 'gro shas ka 'dugazhabs drung rang so bdun gyi skeg la cung gragade las so brgyad pa dogade bas kyang so dgu pa ches dogade las thar na re shig yangs te de ni skyon che/ bzlog thabs dge ba rgya che tsam 'di lta bu dgos zer ba zhus te/ thugs ma ches shing bzlog thabs ma mdzad song*/ de rjes hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin chos grol te/ bla brang gong du phyi mtshams me byas nas de khog nas skyid phug tu phyin mtshams dam par bsdams/

dge sbyor 'phel zhing skyid par byung*/ dgon gnas yas mar so so la brten pa'i kham mchu sad sud mang po dus gcig tu langs pa lta bu zhig byung kyang blo la g.yo mgul spu tsam yang med/ ngam ring nas drang srong ba lha ri rtse ba/ chu 'og pa ste mi sna gsum sbrel byon/ cha rgyus che che mo dang gar gar mo dang tshod che che mo dang 'jigs 'jigs mo sogs nges med sna tshogs zer ba la rtsis gdab byed mkhan ni ye ma byung ngo*/ / spyir ni sems can gyi bde skyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las/ de yang dgon gnas dang bshad sgrub kyi sde 'phel ba la rag las zer ba 'di byis pa mdang skyes tshun chad kyi kha nas ta yongs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar gyur cigadakon mchog gi dbu 'phang mtho bar gyur cig zer ba'i kha tsam tshig tsam gyi smon lam dang*/ chos skyong la 'phrin bcol 'di skya ser mkhas rmongs dge ba la dkar mi dkar thams cad byed par gda'/ lag yod du ni blo dang ldan pa dang mkhas su re ba kun yang bstan pa dar bar mi 'dod de/ btsun pa byed mkhan mang ba bas dmag khral rgyug mkhan mang ba la dga'/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang mtho bar mi 'dod de chos pa dbang thang che ba mi 'dod/ mi nag pa rang shugs che ba 'dod/ dkon mchog dbu 'phang mtho ba ga la zer ram rtsad gcod dgos/ dge bshes kyi ming can phal che ba zhig la yang 'di ka gda'/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas la zhen byas pas chog pa'i dod yul dpon re la mdzad/ thos bsam sgom gsum la zhen byas pas chog pa'i dod bsam ngan dang sbyor rtsub dang kha ngan rnams la mdzad/ dge 'dun la zhen mdzad pas chog pa'i dod nye du'am 'brel chags can mi nag pho mo rnams la mdzad par 'dug go / sngon rgyal po mya ngan med kyis rgyal srid dge 'dun la phul ba dang*/ rgyal po khri ral pa can gyis bla sgo dang po dge 'dun la phul gnyis pa ni rgyal po gsum pa ni blon po zhes gsung ba yang mi rgan smyo ba rang min te mchi/

dkon mchog gi mnga' thang nas bcad de skye bo phal pa'i lto gos dang bu smad kyi don du bsgyur ba la sems can la phan btags pa'i ming yang med de/ mkhas rmongs thams cad kyis mi go bar gda'/ bod shes ldan tsho sems can gyi don gyi ngos 'dzin mthar gtugs na grong pa'i lung gsog la ngos 'dzin mdzad pa 'di rang de e mi yin he he/ bla ma 'phags pas khri skor bcu gsum las la bkol nas gtsugs lag khang bzhengs dus las mi thams cad kyis skur pa zhus 'chi smon btab ste/ khong pa'i de sdig pa'i las ye min/ ma 'os pa yang min las che/ chen po byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi yul mi kha log dogs 'jig rten pa'i shing ra la shing gcod ma byas par gtsug lag khang rnying pa thams cad shus nas rdzong la bkab pa la ma 'os zer nas kha btang mkhan ma byung*/ 'jig rten mi dmangs rnams smon po byung ste khong pa'i de chos ye min/ rgyal khams thams cad dmyal bar btang ba yin/ da lta dper na dge las kyi phyir du grong pa re la nas bre re bsdus kyang blos mi longs sdug skad 'don te/ de bas lhag pa'i longs spyod thams cad bsdus nas dge ba la sbyar na yang sdig pa med kyi steng du phan yon ches 'phel ba lags/ glegs bam gser ma bzhu nas gser byas/ gser sku rdzogs nas zangs su byas/ dngul sku rtib nas ja nyos/ gser kong bshig nas spyi khab 'tsho/ de tsho grong pa'i skye bo blun po rnams la byin nam tha na 'tshong du phyin kyang 'dzum mu le dga' nas yong ste/ de la dge ba ye med kyi steng du rang gzhan tshang ma dmyal rgyu zangs ma'i sdig pa la sbyar bar mi gda' 'am/ 'on kyang kho bo cag tshe 'di pa yin pas de 'dra blor mi chud snyam na/ blun po blun nag tsho cis kyang bden mod mkhas pa dang dpyod ldan gyi nga rgyal ma byed cigalar btsun pa 'di tsho yang*/ khog de 'dra byed mkhan tsho la dga' ba la/ 'phral nyams snang med pa 'dra ba cig 'dugakho bo ni sngon rang nyid zhi bde don gnyer dang 'dzin chags spangs pa'i bya bral la smon/

gzhan gyi sdig rkyen du song dogs 'dzem bag lhur byed pa zhig yin na'ang*/ rang nyid gcig pu phar skyong dgos med/ tshur 'khur dgos med na de bzhin rang legs par gda' yang*/ bya ba las kyi 'khor lo la brten te bstan pa'i khur 'khur dgos phyin 'os pa dang*/ mi 'os pa rang gi rig pas dpyad nas 'os pa'i las la tsham tshom med par 'jug pa las gzhan ma dga'i dogs pa'am kha zer du dogs pa'i rtsis btab ma byas/ ji skad du/ sdug bsngal yin yang gang phan dang*/ phan dang bde ba rnams bya ste/ / bde yang mi phan mi bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar theg chen gyi lam gnad nas ni mi 'chugagazhan ngor rtsub zeng nge 'jug pa 'di 'gro don byed lugs kyi 'jug sgo gcig tu gda'/ rgyud rnams las kyang*/ mchod phyir mi yi bdag po dang*/ phyug po rnams kyi nor 'phrog go / zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje gsang ba 'di lta bus/ sems can thams cad bsad na ni/ / mi bskyod sangs rgyas zhing dag tu/ / rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs mi gda' 'am phaṭa/ de tsam stong shob la lags te/ thugs la mi 'thad na bzod pa bzhes par zhu/ bzod pa mdzad na mdzad mkhan rang la dga'/ nged la ni bzod pa byas ma byas la khyad med do/ / hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum la lung gshing sogs rten bzhengs byed ma'i bal po rnams kyang 'byor/ mi ring bar bzo grwa tshugs/ mkhar las kyang thams cad la bar thog khel zhing*/ lha khang gi thog kyang khel ba'i skabs sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la snga dro mtshams sengs te/ bgegs mi 'jug pa'i byin rlabs tsam byas/ de nub nas ka bla brang gong du mtshams bsdangs/ zla gcig tsam song skabs rgyal khams gyi 'gyur zlog chen po cig 'phral du yong ba'i ltas byung nas/ chos dang dge ba la mi 'khod pa mnyam po la rang re la ni rgyal khams lha sbyin gyi kha la bstab pa dang*/ mchod sbyin gyi kha la bstab pa la khyad med zhe sun pa dang mgo na ba gang nas yong mi shes pas mtshams shin tu dam pa zhig byed dgos snyam/

hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la shug pa gnam 'phyang du mtshams dam por bsdams/ de kha'i tshes bcu drug la lhun po rtse pa'i 'gyur zlog de byung bar gda'/ snga lo khro phu'i rdig bcom gyi lo dus yin/ de nas 'gyur zlog chen po tsho mu la byung ba de lags/ de nas kyang mtshams dam por bsdams pas dge sbyor 'phel bar byung*/ gsal snang gi rim pa yang ches cher mched pa'i re 'ga' rgya che rab byung na'ang 'dir mi 'bri/ ra sa'i skos ru rnams skyabs 'tshol ba'i phyir jo nang gi phu ru sleb/ de la ja sbyo re la yang snga phyi yod pa tsam du lha rtse gnyer khang nas gtser rtsod byed pa dang*/ 'brog pa rnams song bstun gser ma nas rang gi 'bri g.yag rnams spyi mchod du bros pa'i dgos par 'dug pas khong pa rang gi phyag tu thebs na bsam nas jo nang du bsdad pa la yang bskor rgyag tsab tsob mang po byung ste/ phyis gser ma nas rang gi phyag tu 'phrod pa byas/

de skabs bcu pa ba rnams bar skabs 'di la jo nang pas dar 'dzugs byas pa'i tshes gzhis su rtsis len par shog zer ba lan mang du byung na'ang*/ gnas skabs 'di rigs kyis chas dgos pa ni yang med snyam thag bcad pas rang re brling po byung*/ de skor la dar 'dzugs pa bzhi lnga byung gda' na'ang thog tu khel ba gcig kyang ma byung*/ 'di dag tu snga phyir byang nas bde srid kyis nas khal stong phrag gcig rten bzhengs kyi cha rkyen tu gnang*/ de rjes rgyang tsam song ba na bsam 'grub rtse nas nan chags 'bod mi gnang ba'i sde pa mthu stobs drung sku ltem nas yun ring rab song ba phyir lod du gyur pa zhig 'dug pas/ slar sku 'tsho mi 'tsho ji ltar byung yang gal che skabs rang du 'dug pas yong dgos zhes yab sras gnyis car gyis nan chags gnang byung bas/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu la jo nang nas bteg srad bkod du bsdad pa'i nub nam gshis 'tshub pa sogs phyi nang gi ltas rtsub pa tsam byung*/ rtse ru sleb dus mthu stobs drung sku shin tu ltem pa rang 'dug dbang rjes gnang sogs phul bas/ bar skabs zhag shas shig thugs rig dwangs pa tsam byung na'ang*/ sku zungs ni nyin re bzhin bri 'gro ba de khar gda'/ nyer lnga nas gzung lhag par yang 'byung ba sdud pa'i tshul 'dug cing*/ gnam gang gi thor 'go ltas pa tsam la sku ma 'tsho song*/ 'di skabs sgrub grwa chen po 'jag tu chos rje sdings kha sku skye gdan sar bsko bzhag byas/ yol thang legs pa gcig dang tshogs khro dga' ba gcig spyi rdzas su phul/ 'di nas gzung legs lam yang gong 'phel du shar ro/ / sde pa mthu stobs rnam rgyal de nyid bzhugs dus kyang sku sgrib sbyang ba'i thabs dbang byin rlabs dang gshegs skabs kyang 'pho ba dmigs gtad sogs dang de rjes kyang sku tshigs grol gyi bar nyin re bzhin mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga tshar re bzlas pa mang rab dang bcas pa re dang mtshan byang bzhu ba sogs thams cad byed dgos byung zhing bdun tshigs kyi mtshams su rmi lam lta bu'i gsal snang du nges par yong zhing*/

bsnyung gzhi sogs rim pas dwangs pa dang na bza' chos gos sogs kyang je bzang je bzang du 'gro ba sogs rang res gshin don gyi cho ga byed dgos gcig la 'di rang ltas bzang bar byung*/ snga gong ni yon mchod kyi 'brel pa dang thugs mos kyang dkyus 'gro tsam ka yin na/ rting la mos gus kyi lhag bsam cung zad dag tu dag tu 'gro ba tsam ni byung*/ de min gzhan rang med na'ang 'grongs kha'i mtshams sbyor dang sngaun gyi las 'brel zhig kyang yin pa 'dra'o/ / 'di skabs kyang bstan pa ris med kyi chog grwa mdzad cing kar bstan drung gi dgongs rdzogs las kyang 'di rgya che zhing dmigs su 'gro ba dang*/ rting gi mtshams gcod tshun 'phral gyi rten 'brel kyang legs par byung*/ bstan pa sgo thams cad nas mchod pas chab srid gong 'phel du rgyas pa'i rgyur song*/ dgongs rdzogs 'di skabs ngor mkhan drung shar chen kun bkras pa byon pa'i nub gcig rkang dung rang yang bzhi tsam sdebs la 'bud bskang gso rol mo 'ur ding rang btang ba la nang zan rnams kyi kha btang bas sang dgongs nas bzhagadabus gtsang khams gsum gshegs pa yin zer de gdags pa ma chags pa rang 'dug go / 'di'i ring la gtsang sa'i sde srid zhabs drung ni bla ma la chos zhu ba la rtog dpyad mi dgos pa 'dug phebs pa ltar snga phyir bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil zangs gri can lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang sogs dbang rjes gnang rnam grangs mang bar 'bul dgos byung*/ jo nang gi rten bzhengs la gser zho nyis brgya skor gnang*/ phar ched kyis zhus pa min pa la dgongs pas dpyad pa'i dbus kyi sbu sde lha rgyal gling yong sgo dang g.yog ris sogs thams cad rtsis sprod gnang*/ zhe dgu'i tshogs pa rnams kyis nas dgongs phyogs rtse nas thon nas snar thang gi thad nas mun sros rin chen gling du srod la sleb tsam byung*/ sang snga bar byang chen du phyin zhag gsum bsdad/

snar thang nas dpon sa yum sras gsum kyang phebs chos bka' sad sud 'dra phul/ slar yang 'gor med du ri khrod chen por sleb/ bal po rnams kyi bzo yang thams cad grub mtshams yin zhing*/ sleb pa'i gnangs nyin nas gzungs bzhugs sogs kyi 'go brtsams/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel nas gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i bar gzugs ril byin rlabs rten sku gsung thugs kyi rten byin rlabs can dang bcas pa rnams ma 'khrugs par bzhugs su gsol/ hor zla bcu pa'i tshes lnga gza' skar bzang ba la rab gnas kyi sta gon byas/ de rjes rim pa bzhin snga dro cho ga snga ma'i dngos gzhi re dang*/ dgongs mo nang par dang 'brel pa'i sta gon re byas nas 'khor lo chen po gshin rje gshed gsang 'dus kyai rdor bde mchog dus 'khor thugs dkyil rnams la brten nas/ rab gnas rgyas pa tshar drug de skabs byas shing*/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan mchod rdzas sogs kyang rgyas par gra 'grigadangos gzhi chen mo de tshes bcu gcig gza' skar dge bya'i snga gro'i cha la shis brjod yan chad tshang bar byas/ jo nang gzhir bzhugs dang dgon lag so so rnams kyi chog grwa yang che rab mdzad cing*/ so sor 'jam mang ja tshar bur ston phye mar 'gyed pa/ skam 'gyed nas 'gyed sogs gang bzang gi lugs su bsgrubs/ dge 'dun so so rnams dang chos gzhis sogs mi skya 'dus pa rnams kyang legs par tshim/ yul chos dang mthun pa'i byang zhabs drung gi bka' bkod dang bstun lha rtse nas dpal po btsugs/ rab gnas grol mtshams kyi nyin mo dga' ston rgya chen po'i dus/ byang nas sde srid nyid kyang phebs/ sku 'bum thang du bzo bo sogs gzhi byes kun 'dus kyi bzhugs gral thog tu bzo bo rnams la yon rdzongs/ kha ti dang jus 'dres pa yug sgril ma bcu/ ja mngar hang dang dpe yag sa nag rtse 'dres pa sigs bcu/ gser srang bzhi sogs yongs bsgril nor sna mang rab yod/

byams pa'i sku la gser zho lnga brgya lhag gcig song ba/ de bas gser srang bzhi lnga tsam gyi rin thang lhag pa'i rtsis su bcad/ bzo ras dang gos bzas cha tshang sogs la rtsis btab med/ spyi rgyal ba'i sku bzhengs pa'i yon la tshad med kyang*/ yul dang dus dang skye bo rnams kyi longs spyod che chung dang mig ltos sogs dang bstun pas chos nas bshad pa bzhin 'grub dka' ba gda' na'ang*/ deng sang la bltos pa'i legs rab grub pas kho tsho yang mgu bar gyur/ dga' ston grub mtshams sde pa'i dpal po de 'gyed pa'i skabs*/ rlung 'tshub shin tu che ba glo bur du langs cung zad 'tshub pa'i rnam pa byung*/ bsam grub rtse mdol byung gting skyes sogs 'brel can che phra phal cher gyis kyang dga' ston che 'byor chung 'byor mang du byung zhing*/ sde srid dpon g.yog gis kyang zhag drug bzhugs/ 'di dus brda' gtong sogs tsab tsob ye ma byas kyang skye bo mang po dus gcig tu 'dus pa sogs phyi rtags kyang rten 'brel legs par byung*/ de nas sde srid dang dge bshes 'ga' la gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dbang sogs chos bka' yang 'ga' shas byas/ nges don gyi bstan pa la phan pa'i chos gzhis mchod thes shig gnang ba'i zhal bzhes kyang gnang*/ de rjes sgrub sde rnams la sku 'bum thang gi chos khri nas/ dpal ldan a ti sha'i thugs kyi nying khu theg mchog lam rim rgyas pa bshad/ byang sa chen mo'i lung zhig kyang byas/ byams pa'i sku gzugs lha khang dang bcas pa la snga sor rab gnas lan drugahor zla bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes bzang ba zhig la slar yang rab gnas gcig ste kun dril rab gnas lan bdun byas pa la/ slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi gzhung bzhin du tshar lnga/ don gsal gyi lugs gcigadus 'khor lugs gcig rnams byas/ yar lung nas slob bu dam tshig can chos rje byams rin pa gshegs pa'i bsngo rten skyel ba dang*/

byang stag lung nas dpon sku rdzi 'das pa'i mang ja bsngo rten skyel mkhan yang byung*/ de rjes dus chos kyi khrid kyang sngar lugs bzhin du bsgrubs/ gting skyes nas lcam chos 'bum lags kyang 'di skabs dam po mdzad/ bya lo dang khyi lo'i khrid lan gnyis po 'di la 'khrid gsar ba mang rab byung na'ang*/ 'khrid lo ha cang legs rgyu ma byung*/ 'khrid grol nas jo nang chos lung gnyis kyi chos gzhis kyi bu tsha dbang po cung dwangs pa rnams la grwa khral bskul/ btsun gsar bdun cu lhag tsam gyi skra phud bcad/ klog sogs phra mo slob pa'i 'go btsugs/ de rjes bla brang dam chos gling du mtshams bsdams/ zla gcig tsam song skabs 'dol byung nas sde pa'i drung sku tshe'i 'phen pa btang ba zhig byung 'dug pas 'bod mi byung*/ 'gro ba la mngon du phyogs pa'i skabs dbus nas lha bris pa rnams sleb cing*/ de mthun gyi bkod pa cung zad byas/ sgrub sder tshogs la mang ja ja 'gyed bkra shis khra ring gsar du bcos pa gnyis/ ras nam thang brgya bud la bcos pa'i char khebs sku 'bum gyi chos 'khor bcu gsum yongs rdzogs khebs pa gcig dang*/ sngags thang bcu gsum dang rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dkyil thang phal cher tshang ba gcigaganas bcu'i yol thang legs pa gcigazangs sbug che ba gcig rnams spyi thes su phul/ hor zla gnyis pa'i nyer dgu la lam du zhugs/ gsum pa'i tshes gnyis la 'dol byung du sleb/ dgongs rdzogs kyi cho ga'i rim pa rnams dang khrus chog byang bu bzhu ba sogs mtha' dag bsgrubs/ sde pa de thun mong ma yin pa'i yon bdag dad zhen can yin pas snying thag pa nas blos longs par byas/ gtsang sa nas dbus dmag gi sgar gra bsgrigs pa'i dpon g.yog rnams nor khyung du byon skabs yin pas 'bod mi gnang byung ba bzhin khor tsam phyin/ zhag gcig klu sdings lho ma der sdod yul byas/ sde srid zhabs drung rang du tshe dbang dang rkyen sel gyi rjes gnang mang rab dang*/

dpon rigs so sos kyang tshe dbang dang rjes gnang tsam re zhu ba mang du byung*/ dpon g.yog rnams kyi bar chad sel ba sogs rten 'brel legs pa'i dge mtshan yang shar/ gzhan gyis bskul ba dang bcol gnyer med kyang rgyal khams dang chos kyi bstan pa la ma gnod pa zhig byung na sems/ dmag dbus la dngos su 'jug dgos pa mi yong ba'i thabs cig rang gnang dgos tshul nan chags dang*/ thabs gzhan med par dmag rang mdzad dgos shar na'ang*/ dgon gnas che phra thams cad la gnod pa ye med pa gcig mi gnang ba'i thabs med cing*/ yar rgyab dpon g.yog thams cad kyi sar yang thugs rje gang che gnang dgos tshul nan chags rang zhus pas dgon gnas rnams la de skabs kyi dmag res la gnod pa ye ma byung*/ de rjes 'dol byung gi sku rjes grol nas lha sdings su phyin zhag gnyis bsdad/ gnod sbyin zha 'on kyi rjes gnang dang khrom dbang sogs than thun bgyi shing*/ rin po che ka bzhi nas kyi sku skye'i brtag zhus pa sleb kyang 'di skabs gsal ni ma thub/ slar yang 'dol byung du zhal bzhugs rnams la sku khrus tshe dbang 'bul bar zhag lnga tsam bsdad/ de mtshams bsam sdings su sleb pa'i zhag bcu gcig tsam phyi mtsham me ba byas/ 'dol byung dang lha sdings sogs su 'cham pa byung ba 'khrugs pa'i rnam pas khams kyang bde mo min pa cig byung*/ hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gsum la bsam sdings nas chas te gong 'dzin gyi la la 'gro rgyu yin na'ang*/ lha 'phreng gi rnam pas de nub rang gangs babs nas sad la la ma thar bar gzhung la phyin pas lhun grub brtse'i gdong der gtam snyan yod zer dar 'phyar byed pa dang 'griganged rang dgon pa nas dgon par 'gro ba la rten 'brel legs shing*/ yon bdag la'ang legs snyam pa byung*/ rkang bzhi dang dge sdings su bar zhag re byas/ de nas nam zi la chas gangs chen po babs pas yul phyogs 'gyur ba'i snang ba 'gyur re ba'i ngang nas nyi ma snga phyed la jo nang du sleb/

gzhir sdod rnams nged nam sleb yong snyam pa tsam yang med pa la sgo drung du thob rgyag 'byor/ ri mo ba rnams kyis gtso bo dus kyi 'khor lo'i skya ris 'go tshugs tsam dang sangs rgyas rab byung gnyis la tshon gyi 'go tshugs tsam bde dgyes gnyis la skya ris tshugs tsam gzhan gang yang ma grub par 'dugade rjes zhag shas mtshams byas/ de grol nas sa ga'i nya la sgrub sde rnams kyis tsha tsha 'debs pa'i bkod pa byas shing*/ dang thog snga mo dge tsha zhig yod 'dug na'ang rje drung gong mas gcog par mdzad gda'/ slar de gsar du btsugs pa'i rten 'brel yin nam de'i nyin mo nam mkha' dwangs pa la nyi ma thog phub dang*/ sna cha gnyis rim dang khyad par rta sga gong dang chu byang gi dga' po'i thad tsam dang nags rgyal gyi rtse'i thad gsum du 'ja' sprin ma yin pa'i dbyar dus kyi 'ja' tshon gug po de ka 'dra ba yun ring du sdod pa sogs phyi ltas legs shing*/ sku 'bum thang nas tshogs pa rnams kyis yan lag bdun pa byed pa'i tshe/ ston pa sangs rgyas mngon sum du 'di na bzhugs yod pa 'dug snyam pa tsam gyi yid 'khrul ba yang byung*/ de nub nas phyi mtshams tsam byas/ nyi shu lnga la skyid phug tu phyin mtshams dam par bsdams/ cung zad 'tshub cha che zhing dge sbyor yang 'phel bar byung*/ sngar bca' lung gi chu de shin tu lod par grags shing chu mig de yang ja skol mi nyan pa lta bu yin na'ang gtor ma btang bas chu skye rtsal yang che ru song chu'i ngo bo shin tu bzang bar song*/ hor zla lnga pa'i tshe bco lnga la nyin gung gnyid yur ba zhig gi dus sham bha la sogs rmi lam gyi yul snang ngo mtshar can mang du byung*/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes gsum nas bzung tshes bcu gcig gi bar nub re bzhin phyi ltas nam mkha' rgod pa'i rnam pas ser ba cung zad 'bab cing thog kyang 'bab tshad pa dang*/ nang ltas su yang mtshan ma rtsub tsam re nub re bzhin rtag par byung nas tho rangs cho 'phrul de zhi 'gro ba'i rnam pa yang rtag par yod/

khyad par tshes bcu gcig gi srod khyer la thog 'brug drag po re dang bstun glog 'od mi bzad pas nang khengs yod pa gdong tsha tshub tshub pa dang rwa gzhob thul le yong ba de lan sum cu so grangs zhig byung ba dang*/ nang ltas su yang sems nyams dang cho 'phrul skyi g.ya' sogs mang du byung*/ 'on kyang dbyings su bzhag pa'i tshes snyems 'khrigs rdul tsam med pas cho 'phrul zhi nas nam phyed phan la mnyam gzhag la shin tu bogs che bar byung*/ cho 'phrul de tsho yang gzhan gyi byad kha gnyis gsum 'dzom pa'i ltas su 'dugasngar sor bya lo'i nang du snga phyir ngaid rang la gtad dang mnan pa dang zor kha sogs byad kha rbod gtong rigs mi gcig pa dgu tsam 'dzom pa'i ltas dang*/ gcig tsam rang gi slob ma'i khungs gcig gis byas pa dang*/ gzhan gcig nus pa yang dga' rab yod pa'i ltas byung*/ de skabs dang 'di skabs kun tu stong nyid snying rje las gzhan pa'i bsrung bzlog spangs te de kas don 'grub par gda'/ de ka'i tshes bco lnga la khang pa'i byang zur nas rdo 'ga' re 'dzags shing*/

bcom rdib yong la khad kyi rtsig pa 'phral du gas byung bas thog mar de 'phral gnas spo'am snyam pa la rang re rkyen thog tu bzlog sgom byed par la gnas spos pas ga na 'ong*/ zhig 'os nam zhig zhig gang du yang mi 'gro snyam ste de nub bsdad pas thor mgo zin tsam la sgra chen po dang bcas te byang skya de thams cad 'ur song 'gyel 'gro ba'i dus na mtshan mo char mun 'thibs pa dang ber langs pa'i rnam pas phyogs gang nas 'jig cha med cing sdod sa rang gi thad kyang rdib 'gro ba lta bu'i ber ba byung kyang gces 'dzin gyi snyems ye ma byung*/ sdod sa rang yang g.yabs kyi byang ngos 'gyel 'gro sa de dang nye bar byed kyin yod pa ma spos par de rang du bsdad/ de rjes sang nyin ltas dus 'gyel 'os tshang ma 'grel grub/ gzhan rnams mi 'gyel bar 'dug pas de khar bsdad kyang yod bar 'dug na'ang*/ char zhod chen po la brag thigs ches pas sun par 'dug nas shug pa gnam 'phyang du spos/ 'di skabs ngam ring nas sde srid kyis lhun grub spre'u ba kun dga' lags gnang ba'i phug gsum gyi lung pa phu mda' chos gzhis su sbyor 'jags gnang rgyu'i rtsis sprod la cher gtad byon/ slar yang phyag dam gsar du phebs pa'i zhag shas 'gyangs/ sgrub sde dbyar mtshams kyi sgang yin pas mang ja zhig gnang byung ba tshes bco lnga'i nyin mo dug skyel byas/ de nub khang pa 'gyel ba yin de dang stabs bstun chos lung du zhon rta zhig kyang glo bur du shi/ dam sel gyi ltas 'tshub bo zhig kyang byung bas/ de dus mang ja de la the tshom za ba cig byung na'ang*/ phyis brtags dus chos lung gi mgon khang du sgo'i sna lcags kyi zung bcus nas dam sel can gyi gtor yan dang snyan dar dang yo byad 'ga' re phul 'dug pas de'i cho 'phrul du gda'/ 'di skabs dam chos gling du gser sku lha khang bsgrigs pa yin/ / hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bdun gyi nyin mo phug gsum rtsis len byed skabs gnyid kyis ma bslad pa'i rdzun med mngon sum gyi snang ba la gnas bdag ma'i cho 'phrul mang po zhig byung*/

nags rgyal gyi rtse na phug gsum du 'ja' dkar zug pa sogs phyi ltas kyang bzang po byung yod pa gda'/ chos gzhis phug gsum 'brel chags pa dang khyad par jo nang gi grwa tshang la bstan pa nam gnas par sbyor 'jags gtsang spras chod pa gnang*/ de rjes skabs shig tu rin po che ka bzhi nas kyi sku skye brtag par chug mi chug lung bstan zhu zer/ khri lcags sogs yon mchod phyogs gtogs kun gyi mi sna byung*/ mtshams dam pas 'phrad ni ma thub/ de na yang kho tsho gnyis su song ba'i sku skye yin rung min rung*/ yin par lung bstan na gdan sa pa mkhan chen sogs phyogs gcig mi dga'/ ma yin par lung bstan na grwa rigs rnying pa zhen can sogs gcig gshos mi dga' ba zhig 'dug pas lha sa'am chos lung byang rtse lta bur brtag bsgril gyis zhes nan gyis smras kyang*/ nged la byed dgos tshul rang zer ba ltas brtag pa byas kyang khyed rnams yid mi ches/ brtag yig la mi sna rnams kyis thel tshe rgyob la/ 'dir brtag par bsgril ba las 'os med byas nas de bzhin byas pas brtag par ni thon yod par gda'/ dbus dmag 'khor 'phral nas brtsams pas ma grub rtse nas 'bod mi phyag dam rim can du byung ba dang*/ de rjes mi ring ba na zhabs drung sde srid rang sku khams cung ltem par byung 'dug pas shangs pa rab 'byams pa dkon mchog dpal bzang 'bod mir gnang pa'i bka' nan chags pa rang 'dug pa la brten/ sku rim snga khyad dang dpyad bshal sbyongs sogs gnang ba la gegs mi 'byung ba'i bsrung skud dang dud rdzas sogs 'phral du phul/ rang yang 'gor med chas pa'i hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer gsum la shel dkar zhol du sleb tsam byas/ nyer drug la rtse 'byor/ rdzong thog gi nam mkha' la dga' 'khyil gsum dang dpal be'u 'khor lo sogs rnam pa shin tu gsal ba'i 'ja' sprin ya mtshan byung*/ sku khams kyi lam pa sor chud 'dug cing*/

slar zhag gnyis gsum nas bde dwangs rtags thub par byung*/ de ka'i sang nyin nas brtsams zla gzhug de la gtor dbang 'ga' shas dang sku grib sel ba'i rim pa 'dra byas/ zla ba dkar nas tshe dbang sogs rnam grangs mang rab phul/ de nas tshes bcu skor la chos rje shangs pa sogs kyang byon/ khong la bde mchog 'khrul spong gi dbang zhig byas/ de'i rjes nas zhabs drung yab sras sogs la 'khor los bsgyur drug gur rigs bsdus sam+bu ṭa rdor dbyings sogs kyi dbang dang*/ gcod yul gyi khrid phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po'i khrid sogs dang*/ rjes gnang byin rlabs sogs mang du byas/ tshes nyi shu skor la dgongs grol zhus kyang*/ / sde pa sku 'bring ba'i drung gi lo mchod kyi tshogs dpon la sdod dgos tshul nan chags phebs kyin 'dug pa bzhin de ltar byed dgos byung*/ lcang ra slob dpon pa ār+ya ba la yang sum pa lo tsā ba'i snyan brgyud sogs dbang khrid than thun bshad/ gnam gang gi nyin nas tshes bzhi'i bar sku mchod la dor zha lu dkar po brag byang chen pa rnams tshogs pa'i chog grwa rgya che ba bsnyen bkur/ phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa mdzad/ 'di'i bar du zhabs drung sde srid rang sku phyi mtshams dam po de ka mdzad yod cing*/ tshes bzhi'i nyin sku mtshams grol tshogs su phebs bsngo rten dang dge 'dun rnams la yon bla lhag tu gnang*/ grub mtha' sna tshogs 'dus pa'i dge 'dun gyi dbus su song bas/ nged kyis kyang yas gtam bstan pa sgo mtha' dag dang 'brel ba'i tshul du byas/ yas gtam dang bsngo ba mtha' rgyas su byas pas phal cher dgyes/ ko long can mang po de tsam la yang tshig pa za bar 'dug ste g.yas chung ya cha/ de nas kyang bka' nan gnang ba la brten zhag shas bsdad/ snar thang byang chen gyi chos gzhis rin chen gling gi dmag srung cha 'chag pa dang*/ khyi lo dbus su gnang ba'i chos gzhis rnams la yang g.yul rgyal rdzong dang legs bshad gling pa shed po che de tshe'i 'dres yong yod pa rnams khad gtsang bar gcod pa dang*/

'brang gi mdar ma de thung gis cha yod 'bab sa ri sa skor dang bcas pa rnams kyang chos gzhis su gsar du sbyor ba dang*/ 'brang phu dgon pa sngar khral dgon yin pa spyi mchod thar pa gling du 'don pa sogs sku drin tshad med du mdzad cing*/ snga sor stag lo gong dkar du zhu rten phul chos gzhis gang 'os cig gnang ba'i zhal bzhes mdzad rung*/ lag thog tu cang ma byung ba la gtsang nas 'di kun gnang ba 'di dbus pa tsho la ngoms chog pa'i mi sdun du mgo thon pa rang byung*/ ri khrod jo nang du bstan pa'i rgyun la phan par dgongs nas g.yu rtse sa khongs dang bcas pa chos gzhis su sbyor 'jags gnang*/ 'dir sdod ring la ngo chen zhu dgos rnam grangs mang po rnams la yang dgong pa mtho sbraun re mdzad cing*/ khyad par dpon sa snar thang nas la lo bstar gyi nas khal sum brgya re dang*/ gser ma nas la yang drung pa rin po che'i sku ngo'i steng du 'phar cha gnang*/ gdong dga' nas la bka' bkyon tshan chen mngon du gyur pa yin na'ang*/ rag rdzong skor bcas tsam byang du nang bzhes yod tsam gnang ba'i tshul bstan pa tsam las gzhan skyon med du byung ba sogs gzhan la phan 'dogs kyang dga' rab byung*/ gdong dga' nas rang snga sor khong ra'i cha zhabs nas 'thon pa'i stag sna ba sogs la byang gtsang du ngo chen byas na mi yong tshul dbu tshugs mdzad pa la nged kyis kyang blo dang bstun pa yin/ 'di skor la ni dbyar gung nas rang brtsams zhu ngo dgos pa'i nan chags bsam las 'das pa mdzad kyin 'dug ste rang thog dang mi thog la bsam mno gtong ba cig ni dgos rgyur 'dug lags/ hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu bdun la nya ri dga' tshal du yon mchod lhan cig tu phebs/ nged kyis de'i sang nyin u rgyan rdzong gi gru la thon/ rug ma dang khro ru zhag mal re byas/ phug gsum du zhag gsum bsdad/ nyer gsum la jo nang du sleb/ 'di skabs gtsug lag khang gi ri mo'i bya ba phal cher zin zla ba dkar 'phral rab gnas byas pa yin sleb 'phral nas bla brang 'gag pa sogs la nai gu'i gser chos chung ba rnams bshad/

khong gis de skabs dam po byed ma nyan/ chos drug la dus chos kyang btsugs/ sbyor drug gi sngon 'gro'i ring la nai gu chos drug sogs kyang btsugs shing*/ phug gsum pa rnam la'ang grwa khral byas/ / sngar sor mgron gnyen tshe rnam gy-is sbyar zhing byang nas bka' shog gis chod pa'i chos gzhis de lo legs nyes 'bring gi dbang du byas na nas khal phyed drug brgya tsam 'bab pa cig 'dugajo nang du sngon dus chos rje yab sras rnams kyi dus mchod nges can re yod 'dug na'ang chos gzhis rnams rim pas bshor ba'i kun mkhyen chen po la yang lo dus mchod pa tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams chag nas bla rabs kyang 'ga' re song rigs su 'duga'adi skabs chos gzhis de yab sras bzhi'i dus mchod thes la sbyar/ kun mkhyen chen po la zla mchod dang gong ma yab sras gsum la lo mchod bzang bar btsugs/ phyogs pa'i thugs dam dus 'khor gyi dkyil thang rgyal po mya ngan med kyis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten gcigarwa lo'i phyag dril mai tri ba'i rgyan drug grub thob 'dar phyar gyi phyag phur/ slob dpon shān+ti pa dang*/ rgyal ba dpal ye shes dang*/ paṇa chen zla ba mgon po'i rgya dpe sna re sogs byin rlabs rten bzang ba rnam grangs mang tsam bstan pa nam gnas par jo nang gi spyi thes su bzhugs su gsol/ de rting 'phags pa rin po che'i phyag mkhar dang gsol lcog yin zer ba mu tig ljon shing gcig kyang lha khang du bzhagasngon byin rlabs rten bzang la mang ba rang yod par gda' na'ang*/ bar skabs su phal cher gyag 'dug pa'i kun bso ba tsam yin/ dam po'i bdun snga phyi gnyis la shug pa gnam 'phyang du bsdad pas dge sbyor 'phel zhing skyid par byung*/ bdun snga rting gi bar la sde pa gdong dga' nas kyang dril bzo mdzes lam mtshon byed tsam la phebs/ dus khrid 'di khrid lo shin tu legs shing phag lo'i ston nas 'di bar la btsun gsar phyed pa yang mang du byung*/

khrid gtor yan chad mtha' rgyas bsgrubs/ snga sor nas nags phug gi mi dpon rim can phal cher jo nang pa la dgra kho na byed/ de khas lo re re la mi dpon re re la skyon re yang bstud mar byung*/ 'di skabs khrom dbang byed skabs rlung po che grags pa la nags phug gnyer pa kun ṛn dmigs phud nas brdzangs pas yul gshis 'jam thing ba byung nas khrom dbang thub tsam byung*/ de nas khams pa mi nyag chos zhu ba gsar sleb dang*/ rang re'i lag g.yog pa 'ga' re la gcod khrid cig kyang bshad/ de rjes don gnyer 'ga' la lam 'bras dang*/ 'dzam thang gi grwa rigs 'ga' la sbyor drug gcig gtsugs/ 'di kha'i snga phyi la sa cha yas mas kyi zlos pa rnams kyang chod/ g.yu rtse'i chos gzhis de lha khyung rdzong gnyis kyi lag g.yog la mkho ba rang yod pas sa brjes byed dgos phebs par ltar hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu byang sems rgyal ba ye shes kyi dus chen gsar du 'go btsugs pa'i nyi ma la g.yu rtse'i sa tshab tu bkra shis 'dzoms rtsis sprod byung*/ tshes bcu gsum la chos lung byang rtser phyin zla gcig zhag po bdun tsam bsdad cing*/ grwa gsar grwa tshang rnams dang gzhi byas rnams la snga phyir skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang ka ri ka lnga bcu pa'i gzhung la brten nas dge tshul gyi bslab bya zhib mo dang byang sdom gyi bslab bya dang*/ bla ma lnga bcu pa dang rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa dang sgom pa bsgrags bzung gi gzhung la brten nas sngags kyi bslab bya zhib mo dang bde gshegs snying po'i mdo rnams tshogs la bshad/ mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang*/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang*/ nag po pa'i dbang rnams chos lung rang du cho ga byed dgos dang bstun pa'i ma thob pa ci rigs ci rigs la bsgrubs/ dgon pa dang lung pa la phan pa'i phyir phyogs bzhir gtor ma chen po re yang btang*/ drag pa'i sbyin sreg chen po gcig byas pas rang re'i 'gro don gyi bar chad mang po sangs pa'i ltas shar bkra shis 'dzom gyi grong pa tsho la'ang grwa gsar bkal ba rnams skra bcad kyang byas/

mig mdas dang dgon pa'i ltag nas rang gi rmis ltas kyis mthong ba bzhin du sa la brkos pas nged yon mchod dang dgon pa la ngan byed byas pa'i 'khor lo gsar rnying re re gnyis kyang thon/ de dag sbyin sreg gi cho gas bsregs des dgon pa la cung zad phan nam yang sems pa mngon rtags kyang byung*/ snga sor ngam ring la yong dgos tshul nan chags yod na'ang ltas la ma chug pas da res la mi yong bar thag chod zhus pa des/ lhar rtser mjal ba'i dgongs gtad 'dug pa ltar de kha'i rtsis kyi jo nang du phyin/ mkha' spyod bde ldan gyi las ka byed rgyu 'di zhig gsos yin na'ang*/ zhig nas yun ring lon pa'i stabs sa chog cig byas/ chos rgyal phyogs las rnam rgyal la yang yab sras gsum dang 'dra bar lo dus kyi dus chen mchod pa'i thes sbyar/ hor zla gsum pa'i nyer lnga rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku kun spangs chen po kun du bzang po mtshan brjod par dka' ba thugs rje brtson 'grus kyi dus chen gsar du btsugs pa'i thog bkra shis 'dzom du sleb par byas so/ / de rjes nyer bdun gyi nyin gza' skar bzang ba'i thog la sde srid nyid kyang bsu bar phebs shing gzhan yang ser bsgreng sogs 'du 'tshogs che ba dang bcas lha rtse'i pho brang du sleb/ de nyin nyi phyed yan nyi ma shin tu 'jam pa la phebs bsu'i sar nged kyis rta babs 'phral rlung yam tsam zhig langs/ gur nang du sleb 'phral rlung chen po gur stib pa tsam byung*/ de nas ser bsgreng sogs kyang rlung 'tshub shin tu che ba'i 'khris nas 'khris su mi mthong ba tsam la slar rdzong nang du sleb tsam na rlung de yang sangs song*/ zla gzhug de la drag po'i bka' ci rigs phul/ gnam gang gi nyin sa chog byas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags skor gyi dkyil 'khor rdul tshon las bzhengs/ zhabs drung rang dag phyag g.yog dpon skya gcig gnyis tsam yod/ gzhan phal cher bla ma slob dpon bka' bcu rab 'byams sogs shas che ba la nyi shu rtsa lngar bcad pa'i dbang cha gnyis pa zhig byas/

de rjes dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rim lnga dang rjes su 'brel par bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid lam rim zhib mo dang bcas pa rgyab rten 'phags pa yab sras lnga'i gzhung rnams dang rtsa rgyud dang sgron gsal sogs kyi lung gzhan yang chos kyi rnam grangs mang rab don gnyer so so la legs par bsgrubs shing*/ ngam ring chos sde'i mkhan chen la rnal 'byor ma'i khrid lwa ba pa'i ngo sprod tshigs bcad gcig ma sogs sger gyi bzhed chos kyang kha re bsgrubs shing*/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro he ru ka lha drug cu rtsa gnyis ma'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i steng nas/ yon mchod sogs la dbang cha gcig bgyis pa la/ chos 'khor lhun po'i mkhan po byams rdor ba dang*/

'jad yangs pa can pa'i mkhan slob rnams kyang byon/ sa ga'i tshes bco lnga dus tshes bzang po la rdzong gi mdun du chos khri gsar pa brtsigs pa'i steng nas gtsang gzhung gi skye bo phal cher 'dus pa la ma ṇi'i lung dang tshe dbang bsgrubs shing*/ de rjes su rdzong gi tshom chen du yon mchod dang dge bshes gtso bor gyur pa'i skya ser 'dres pa 'tshom chen khengs pa tsam la sems bskyed chen mor grags pa mkhas mchog sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung gi yi ge gzhir bzhag pa'i steng nas sgom don ngo gang 'phrod kyi lugs su byas/ de ltar na yul phyogs bzang por chos dang 'byor ba phun sum tshogs shing*/ gzhan phan rgya che ba'i skabs 'di nyid do/ / de la spyir lo rgyus 'di thog ma'i tshig tu smos pa bzhin du 'di la gzigs pa po thams cad kyi dgongs pa bzhugs pa zhu/ des na kha cig 'di snyam du khyed kyi 'di la ngo mtshar ba'i chos yi ger 'god rin chog pa ni/ gang yang mi snang*/ de las gzhan du phyogs ris su bcad pa dang chags sdang la sogs pa chos bzhin ma yin pa yang du ma snang la/ mtho dman 'byor rgud sna tshogs kyi gtam yang snang bas mchog tu mdzes pa ma yin pa'i gtam ci'i phyir 'bri bar byed ce na/ kho bo ni 'di 'bri ba la mchog tu spro ba yang ma yin la/ chags sdang la sogs pa'i nyes pa spangs pa yang ga la zhig ste/ bde sdug gi khyad par dang dgra dang bshes kyi 'gyur ba sogs sna tshogs 'byung ba ni 'khor ba'i chos nyid yin la/ 'on kyang gzhan gyis nan tan du bskul ba'i phyir na/ don chen po ma yin kyang sug ris 'di bris pa yin pa dang*/ sems la chags sdang drag po 'chang bzhin du tshigs 'jam pos brid nas gzhan bslu ba'i thabs kyang ngas ni mi shes la/ bde ba dang 'byor ba dang mthun pa'i gtam legs po dag bris nas/ sdug bsngal ba dang rgud pa dang mi mthun pa'i gtam sbed pa la yang spro ba med do/

/ yang bdag gang zag bzang po ma yin pa la rnam thar bzang po 'byung du re ba yang ma mdzad cigarang nyon mongs me ltar 'bar ba cig byas nas rgyud dul ba'i dul lugs dang nyes skyon nyon mongs med pa'i med lugs bshad pas ni skye bo bslu ba'i ham gtam du 'gro ba yin no/ 'on kyang ston pa de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ mkhas grub rnams kyis bsgom zhing bshad/ da lta'i bar du bka' ma chad par bzhugs pa'i chos/ rnams la zhu ba dang lta ba dang nyan pa dang gzhan la 'dri ba dang the tshom gcod pa rnams kyang byas/ de yang rang mkhas su re ba dang gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa zhig 'dod pa'i dang ltos tsam ma yin par/ sems can 'khor ba las sgrol ba chos la rag las/ de la yang tshig don ma nor zhing rgyun ma chad pa zhig dgos par shes nas/ zab cing rgya che ba la skrag cing zhum par ma byas/ / nyung zhing gsal ba la brnyas shing khyad du ma gsad par nan tan du bslabs te gzhan la ston par byed pa 'di ni kho bo'i rnam pa thar pa ste dang po yin no/ / / / mdo sngags kyi gsung rab rgya mtsho rnams las rgyal tshab 'phags pa byams pa'i gzhung rnams dang 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub du ma'i nges don gyi gzhung rnam pa mang po dang*/ de bzhin du 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dpon slob dang*/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha dang*/ lū dril nag gsum dang*/ la li ta dang*/ dpal 'dzin dang*/ bir+wa pa dang*/ ku ku rī pa la sogs pa grub thob rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sngags kyi gzhung rnams dang*/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'grel pa dang*/ khyad par du grub chen zhi ba sbas pa la sogs pa'i man ngag la rang byan chud cing dgongs pa longs par byas pas sgo phyed de/ mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mthong ba dang thos pa tsam gyis go zhing zab mo'i don gyi snying po len par byed pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste gnyis pa yin no/

/ / / bod du byon pa'i lo paṇa sprul pa'i skyes mchog rnams dang*/ de dag gi rjes su 'brang ba sngon byon mang po dang*/ bar skabs su byon pa'i mkhas grub chen po dam pa'i spyod pa can du ma byon pa rnams las phyogs ris su bcad pa'i chags sdang gi blo spangs te/ 'braug 'gos mar gsum/ rwa skyo zhang gsum/ sa rngog dpyal gsum sogs yongs su grags pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po thams cad kyi man ngag dang bshad sgros dang thugs kyi gsang ba phal cher byang chub cing*/ bskyed rdzogs cho ga 'phrin las kyi lag len khrigs bkod thams cad kyang blo la ma mdzings par 'char nus pa dang*/ byin rlabs dang nyams myong cung zad shar ba 'di yang kho bo'i rnam pa thar pa ste gsum pa'o/ / / / bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi mthu las gnas lugs kyi don spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i dbyings dang*/ de rtogs par byed pa'i thabs mdo dang sngags las gsungs pa ji snyed pa thams cad la yid ches rnam pa gsum la brten te nges shes dang dad pa thob pas de dag ston byed kyi gsung rab rnams dang gnas lugs de gzigs shing thabs de mngon du gyur pa'i skyes bu dam pa kun la yang rkyen gzhan gyis gzhig tu med pa'i dad pa mi phyed pa thob pas/ dam pa mchog rnams kyi rnam par thar pa thos pa'am de'i dpe ris mthong ba tsam gyis kyang*/ ba spu ldang zhing mchi ma 'khrug pa'i dang ba skye ste/ chos dang gang zag la dad pa phun sum tshogs pa skye ba 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste bzhi pa'o/ / / / gzhan yang mkhas pa kha cig kun rdzob kyi snang ba 'di la a 'thas ko 'thas shi 'thas ro 'thas su song*/ blo lhan skyes kyi a 'thas dang bstun nas grub mtha' 'joga'akhrul snang tshang mar byas nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la bcad gras byed par gda' na'ang*/ chos 'di kun sgyu ma lta bur go myong brtan po yod cing*/

sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang sangs rgyas kyi gsung la 'khrul ba dang 'dzol so ye med par nges nas/ 'phags pa rnams kyi mnyam gzhag dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i lung la snying thag pa nas yid brtan 'cha' bar byed pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste lnga pa'o/ / / / mkhas pa kha cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'am skyes bu dam pa 'ga' re la phyogs 'dzin gyi zhen ngo bstod 'gas pa tsam byed cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las shes bya thams cad la khyab par yang ma shes/ theg pa chen po'i thabs la mkhas pa yang ma go nas/ rang nyid lta ba mchog tu 'dzin/ sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' gzhan rnams la dgrar lta/ mu stegs la sogs pa'i ming yang thos su mi rung pa skad byed de/ blo chung shes rab can du re ba ya re cha/ rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par ston pa'i phyir/ grub mtha' dang theg pa gong ma gong ma thams cad la 'og ma 'og ma rnams dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lta sgom spyod pa khyad 'phags re yod cing*/ skyon spang tshul dang yon tan lhag tshul re yang yod/ che ba du ma dang ldan mod/ 'on kyang rgyang phan pa'i grub mtha' tshun chad ma rig pa 'joms byed kyi phyogs su gtogs shing*/ rtsa'i bu gar nyal ba'i srin bu phra mo'i kha zas tshun chad kyang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi smon lam gyi stobs las yin par shes nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang dam pa chos kyi sgo rnams la gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob kyang gzhan rnams la yang brnyas sems dang khong nas 'khrugs pa'i 'dam rdzab du ma byings pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste drug pa'o/ / / / rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bcas pa las mi 'da' ba'i phyir/ sngags kyi chos bshad pa la sogs pa'i don du dkyil 'khor tha dad pa phal cher gyi grangs bsnyen re yang bgyis mod/ gtso bor lhag pa'i lha thams cad kyang ro gcigasngags thams cad kyang ro mnyam/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor tha dad pa rnams kyang rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid du gyur pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste bdun pa'o/

/ / / gzhan yang bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mang pos rjes su bzung ba snyam byed kyang dngos grub ster ba po la dga' ba dang re ba med/ bar chad byed pa po la 'jigs pa dang dogs pa yang med/ lha dang bdud ro mnyam du gyur pas bar du gcad bya gcod byed dbyings su dgabyin gyis brlab bya rlob byed sems su shes/ dngos grub ster bya ster byed thams cad kyang rig pa'i rang rtsal tsam du nyams su myong ba 'di yang kho bo'i rnam pa thar pa ste brgyad pa'o/ / / / btsun por rlom pa gzhan rnams mgu ba'i spyod pa bzang po med kyang*/ chos las ji skad bshad pa'i blang dor rnams la bden zhen dang mngon zhen drag po yang med cing*/ spang blang gi tshul rnams spyir btang gi gnas skabs su spyir btang dang mthun pa dang dmigs gsal dgos pa'i gnas skabs su dgag bya dgos pa bstun te blang dor ma 'khrul par byed pa la chos dang rang sems zhu dag pher tsam yod pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam pa thar pa ste dgu pa'o/ / / / bzang por rlom pa rnams mnyes par 'gyur ba'i rgyal sras kyi rnam thar ma mchis shing*/ 'jig rten gyi skye bo phal cher dga' zhing 'dun pa'i thabs ma byas mod/ lag len du sems can bslu ba'i thabs ma byas mi byed par mi 'gyur la/ skye bo mang po la phyi ma'i tshe la mi gnod cing phan pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba mthong na rang gi grags 'dod dang bzang 'dod dang chos dang mthun mthun mor gzhan gyis ma mthong yang khyad med snyam pa'i blo brtan pos spyod pa gzhung lam drang por bsrangs te 'gro ba 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste bcu'o/ / / / grub par mngon par rlom pa dag mgu bar 'gyur ba'i rtags dang mtshan ma med kyang sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba dang las tshogs rab 'byams rnams dang*/ thun mong kyi dngos grub thams cad kyang sgyu ma'i rnam rol tsam du go bas sred pa log cing*/ / phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub zhes pa'i sgra bo che de yang don dam de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po las logs su mi 'dug pas/

spyir thob 'dod drag po yod kyang gzhan don du yin mod kyi/ rang gi ngo bo la thob bya thob byed thams cad dang bral bas thob 'dod kyi sred pa phal cher zad pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam pa thar pa ste bcu gcig pa'o/ / / / lta ba dang grub mtha' tha dad pa rnams las nor pa rnams kyi 'tshang rig gnas gzhan phal cher gyi blo la ma shar ba'i sun 'byin dang thal 'gyur gyi rig pa gsar pa mang po dang*/ grub mtha' ma nor ba rnams la nges pa'i gtan tshigs la zhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang dag pa mang po zhig gzhan phal cher gyis ma shes pa gsar du rtogs kyang rang shugs la rlom sems mi skye la/ sgra dang snyan ngag dang rtog ge rnams la mkhas 'dod kyi sred pa las grol zhing*/ don la mi sbyor na mkhas pa'i khur chen pos brjid pa las kyang tshigs bcad gcig kho na 'dzin pas dad pa 'ba' zhig gis chos don dang mthun pa'i lag len sna re byed pa la yang gding mthong che ba zhig sems la 'chang bar gda'/ 'di yang ston pa'i bka' dang mthun pa'i chos kyi go tshul cig yin nam sems te/ deng sang phal cher gzhan rnams dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par thar pa ste bcu gnyis pa'o/ / / / gzhan yang 'dus byas mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin la re dogs byed don med de/ tshe ring bar smon pa yang med/ thung gi dogs pa yang med/ 'chi ba la 'jigs pa yang med/ nyi ma de ring nyid 'chi bdag gi rgyal po 'ongs kyang rang sems skad cig gi don 'chi rgyu 'chi bar byed pa po ji ltar 'chi ba'i tshul gang yang grub pa med cing*/ 'chi ba'i rang bzhin gang yin pa de yang bde chen lhan cig skyes pa nges par rnyed la/ de las gzhan shul ma'ang grwa rigs sam gzhan don nam bya ba byed 'phro 'di lta bu'o zhes lhag ma la yongs su chags pa'am rjes su 'di lta bu zhig dgos par 'dug ces blo la bcags pa yang med la/ ci ste lus sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor ma zhig pa de srid du rang gzhan la phan pa mang du sgrub nus pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste bcu gsum pa'o/

/ 'khor ba yin phyin chad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas bdag la na rgas 'chi rgud 'pho 'gyur mi yong ba ma yin kyang*/ gang zhig thog tu bab pa de ka chos nyid yin pa'i yi chad dang blos ma longs pa dang sems sdug yong ba'i gnas mi 'dug cing*/ de thams cad glo bur ba tsam du shes pas spang blang la rtsal 'don yang mi byed la/ chos kyi don dang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir khro chags kyi rnam 'gyur du ma 'byung ba yang grib ma'i skyes bu'am chu nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin du 'khrul pa'i rang 'tshang rdib pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste bcu bzhi pa'o/ / / / yang khyed cag 'di na ngas 'jig rten gyi phan 'dogs 'dra yod du re ba'i ngos 'dzin gyis chos zhu ba dang yon mchod kyi 'brel byed pa 'dra 'dug ste/ nga ni mkhos mi shes par ma zad snying shin tu ring bas de 'dra'i re ba ma che zhig lkog rngan blangs pa'i ngo yang ngas mi yong nyin mtshan shad pa'i 'grul yang nges mi pher/ gson gshin gyi rnyed bkur la hor rgyug rgyug kyang ngas mi lcogs/ zhi drag thabs skyog sna tshogs kyis dgra 'dul ni nga mi byed/ snying ring ba 'di yin pa skyon yin te slob ma brtag pa zhor la yong*/ yon bdag gi dad pa brtan mi brtan brtag pa la yang 'di dgos/ rang dge sbyor rang cig byed na rang dgos par 'dugasnying thag nye nye mo'i sred pas dge sbyor rlung la bskur/ de'i rgyu mtshan da lta 'gro ba'i don ni cung zad tsam yin gyi/ rgyu mos pa'i dge ba phun sum tshogs pa 'di las brtsams nas rnam par mi rtog pa lhun gyis grub pa'i spyod yul nam mkhas gar khyab gyi yul rnams su/ 'khor ba ji srid pa'i dus thams cad la don med du 'gyur ba nam yang mi srid par gang la gang 'dul gyi 'gro ba'i don sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa ji bzhin du 'jug par 'gyur ba srid zhi thams cad kyi snang brnyan can de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgya mtshor 'jug par 'gyur te/

mos pa'i dge ba phun sum tshogs pa la rnal 'byor du byed pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar pa ste bco lnga pa'o/ / / / bco lnga po 'di nga rang la yod nges pa'i rnam thar rang de yin pa dgongs zhu/ gzhan yang rnam par thar pa mang po yod pa rnams 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ / sde tshan bar pa 'di rang lo so brgyad pa'i steng du bris pa yin/ phyis cung zad bsnan pa yod/ bkra shis/ / / / oṃ swā sti/ yang sngar gyi 'phros las brtsams te/ rang gi gnas tshul cung zad brjod na grom pa lha rtse'i phyogs de nyid du/ sngar gyi chos bshad pa'i 'phros de las/ dbang rjes gnang lung bka' than thun mang rab dang*/ khyad par byang zhabs drung rang gi dgongs brtad dang bstun/ zhabs drung rang dang*/ / ngam ring mkhan chen tshul khrims pa dang*/ gzhan dge bshes brgyad dgu tsam/ ser chags 'ga' re dang bcas pa la/ dbu ma gzhan stong gi bshad 'doms rags pa dang*/ rang res brtsams pa'i gzhan stong gi gzhung than thun dang bcas pa yang bshad/

slob dpon byams bkras pa sogs grub mtha' de la phyogs zhen bag tsam gda' na'ang*/ nges po ni ma byung ba 'dra/ gzhan dge bshes kyi khungs rnams nged ci 'dra zhig smra'am bsam tshod bgam pa'i phyir/ bdag cag kyang grub mtha' 'di la mos pa yin pas/ chos grwa 'di la zhugs pas chog pa dgos zer yang yang nan bcags byas de yongs mod kyang*/ sngar gyi bag chags rnying pa blo la zhen pa de kha ma gtogs chos la go nas dad pa skye ba lta ci smos/ go ba rang sngon ma nas mi skye ba 'dugasngar gyi go ba ro thed ngan pa rab ri ba des bsgrubs nas/ rang res zhib po bshad kyang go ba gtsang sang nge ba 'char thub mkhan mi gcig kyang mi 'dugarang nyid gang mos pa'i rtsa ba'i grub mtha' de/ phyogs zhen gyi sgo nas 'dzin pa dam po byed pa ni/ deng sang phal cher gyi lugs su gda' na'ang*/ gzhung lugs shes gyu'i khungs kyis chos nyan phyin/ so so'i 'dod tshul tha dad pa'i go babs kyis mtshams byed pa tsam mam/ nged kyis bshad pa de phyogs snga yin du bcug na'ang*/ phyogs snga go ba cig ka yong thang ba la/ man ne mun ne cig min pa 'di yin med pa'i steng nas/ rgyu mtshan ma yin pa la rgyu mtshan du 'dzin/ rgyu mtshan rang de ye mi go gnad don ma yin pa la gnad du 'dzin/ gnad rang de mtha' la yal/ go chog sa nas mi go ma go chog sa nas go ba sha stag yong gin 'dug pas/ rgod kyang bro la yi yang mug par byung*/ phal cher ma go zhing cung zad go ba la yang blo ma song bas shes par 'dod pa'i dogs gcod byed pa yang med/ mi 'thad pa go ba'i rgal brtag 'bel gtam byed pa gang yang med par/ kha skyengs bsu ba byed la khyed la mdo phyogs kyi bslab shes 'di tsam yod snyam pa sngar ma byung*/ 'di ltar yod phyin/ mdo lugs kyi bshad grwa zhig bskyangs na bstan pa la phan pa 'dug zer ba'i ngo bstod gcam bu de mi re ngo res gtong du gyur/

dge bshes 'di rnams kyis mi go ba'i rgyu yang 'dir 'dug ste/ gzhan stong 'di sems tsam rnam rdzun pa'i lugs yin no zhes zer ba dang*/ gzhan stong pa rnams ni byams chos bar pa gsum gyi dgongs pa/ rang lugs kyi dbu mar 'dod pa yin zer ba'i gtam tsam zhig rna ba lhungs pa des/ rang rang gi grwa sa na rnam 'grel gyi sems tsam rnam rdzun gyi skabs dang*/ byams chos bar pa gsum gyi don yin gyu ba sems tsam du 'dod pa'i grub mtha'i khul zhig 'dug pa de/ dbu ma gzhan stong du ming bsgyur ba ma gtogs/ de kha rang yin yong snyam nas/ gzhan stong dang sems tsam gyi khyad par shin tu che ba rnams ye mi go bar/ khyad chos de dag khong rang tsho'i 'dod tshul rnying pa'i sems tsam gyi lugs de la ka yod pa e mi yin nam/ sngar gyi de dang ni 'dra la 'dra min zhig byung snyam pa'i mgo bo spos pa de khar 'dug go / 'di skabs sa ga'i tshes bco lnga la/ rang yul du pha sku mdun rnam rgyal phun tshogs de sku gshegs pa 'dugadagongs rdzogs dngos kyi skor la ni mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan pa spyan drangs gda'/ skabs 'dir gnas tshul skyes mi byung bas/ dgon stod smad thams cad du mang ja nas 'gyed sogs dgongs pa rdzogs thabs gang grag bgyis pa yin/ cung zad skyo shas che ba cig kyang byung*/ byis pa'i dus su rtse mo'i rnam pas/ ku re kyal ka'i sgo nas/ pha la ma gus pa'i rnam 'gyur byas pa'i mthong chos kyi 'bras bu la/ da ltar yang rlung khams kyis rtag tu gtses pa'i khams mi bde ba yong bar 'dugades na phra zhing phra ba la spang blang byed pa gal che bar gda'/ de skabs zhig zhabs drung dang byams bkras pa gnyis kyis/ shin tu nan bcags ches pa'i ngo ma chogs par/ khong dpon g.yog gnyis la grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs nas brgyud pa'i sbyor drug gsar ma de bshad dgos par byung*/ sor sdud la mun khrid kyi rnam pa tsam gcig kyang mdzad/

'di'i dbang man ngag bshad pa rnams tshar gcig tshar bar byas/ de skabs bka' cung zad ltas 'tshub par byung na'ang skyon tsam med dam snyam cher cher ma byas/ yig brgya bshags pa tshogs mchod sogs byed pa yang ma byung*/ 'di skabs rtsis gnas gsar ba'i rje drung khong mdar nas yar lung phyogs la thogs pa'i zhor lam du/ khong pa'i dpon sras chos rje chung chung de dang bcas nged yon mchod rnams mjal bar byung*/ brag sna stod dang po zhig brag sna chos rje pas bdag po kun rin pa la dgongs pa zhus nas chos lung byang rtser phul bar 'dugade la 'phan ne bas mgo skor gyi rnam pa byas 'dug kyang*/ phyis brag sna chos rje smyon pa la khas chad yod pa'i dgos cha rnams ma byung ba yun ring pas snga sor cig nged la byin pa yin kyang*/ gzings gzhi la dgos pa mi 'dug snyam lo mang dag cig bzhag pa yin/ 'di skabs chos lung dgon par ngan byed btsun pa kun yang*/ smon 'gro ba rang rtogs ldan dang bcas pas btsud pa yin nges su 'dug pa dang*/ chos rje smyon pas kyang nan gyis phul ba 'dzom nas/ rang res kyang khams gshis langs te khas blangs pas/ 'di skabs brag sna stod lag tu byung ba yin/ smon 'gro ba gtan zhal gyis sdigs ris lung pa bkang yang*/ rjes la 'di yin rang ni cang ma byung*/ de nas hor zla lnga pa tshes 'phral la yar chas te/ sde pa dpon g.yog gis skyal ma cung zad mdzad/ rags rdzong gzhol gyi gdong der gdong dga' bas sna len byung*/ mdar rdzong gsar gyi mdun du sde pa dgra 'dul ba dang mjal/ de yang dgra 'dul ba la rgyal po'i gnod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i nad gdon gnyis 'dzom zhig gis yun ring bsnyung*/ thabs rten 'brel gyi rigs la ma mdzad pa'i sna med par 'dugaganas gsar rje drung gis rngas bsrungs rgyang tsam mdzad/ dbang bskur rim gro dpag med mdzad zer/ khong pa'i gsang chab kyang chu 'jo 'jo mchod gda' na'ang*/

phan skyed ni cher ma byung bar 'dugamos zhen ni de phyogs rang la che mod/ nad gdon phan du re nas nged la'ang de skabs/ dngos brgyud du ma nas nan bcags mdzad pa'i stabs/ 'dre la srung yig dang byin rlabs sogs nged kyis kyang byas/ phan thogs che rab kyang byung ni byung*/ nam phan pa nas gsung thugs brjed ngas kyi dbang du song yod pa ni gzhir bcas/ de nas nges cag lus la 'phrod du re pas/ mang mkhar phu'i chu tshan cung zad bsten/ nyi ma snga ma gnyis la/ byang zhabs drung gi gsung nan chags chen po yod pa ltar/ sbyor drug nye brgyud kyi 'khrid dmigs yi ger bkod nas phul/ zhag gnyis song ba'i nyin mo be snabs 'dres pa'i khrag sla nga do gsum tsam skyugs/ de thog ma chu tshan gyis bad khrag pa phan pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig yin nam snyam pa byung yang*/ chos rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngaga'aphags yul grub pa'i thugs bcud de nyid skabs su ma bab pa la bshad cing yi ger bkod pa'i gnyan cha rang gtso che ba'i rigs su 'dugade ma thag ma nas gnyid shin tu che/ khams nyogalus shin tu ma bde ba zhig byung ba'i ngang nas/ rgya tsho la dang*/ che la sogs brgyud nas rim pas/ bla ma'i bzhugs gnas ri khrod chen po brag stod du 'byor/ gtsang khang*/ 'du khang*/ logs bris dang bcas pa sogs ri khrod nyid la bltos pa'i rgya dpangs mi chung tsam rang res snga sor du rgyang nas bkod pa byas pa yang*/ de skabs mthar phyin pa'i skabs yin pas/ slebs 'phral nas khams ma bde bzhin du de rnams la rab gnas rgyas par byas/ dngos gzhi tshes bco lnga la yin/ de rjes tshes bcu bdun bco brgyad gnyis la/ ya phyang ba drung chen brtan pa mi ngo sogs la kyai rdor gyi dbang zhig kyang byas pa dngos gzhi la dbang rdzas 'grim pa mi lcogs la khad la thub tsam byung*/ de bar du khams shin tu mi bde ba de je lod du song nas/ de'i nang par nas gang yang ma lcogs par sdod dgos byung*/

de yang nyin mtshan kun tu khams nyog cing gnyid la 'gro ba/ mgo lus rus tshigs thams cad mi na ba'i sa gcig kyang med pa la/ lus zungs chung zhing kha yang 'gag pa/ rtag tu mgo 'khor ba'i rnam pa yod pa/ mig dang rna ba dbang po'i sgo rnams kyang 'grib pa sogs shin tu nad tshabs che ba dos drag par byung na'ang*/ 'tsho byed sman pa sogs gang la'ang ma bstan/ nang la thog 'gel dang*/ blos btang gi lam khyer cung zad re bsgom/ lar bla ma'i sku drin yin/ 'chi ba la 'tsher ba de sangs nas ni/ de gong nas lo mang po zhig kyang thal/ gal te dus la bab pa yin na/ spyir 'chi ba'i sa cha la khyad mi 'dug kyang*/ bla ma'i gdan sar sleb pa 'di shin tu stabs legs 'dug snyam pa tsam ni byung*/ de ka la zhag mang rab cig song*/ de skabs su nyer mkho'i kha zas dang yo byad 'ga' zhig dkon par byung nas/ blo bcos ma ma yin par rang gis rang la snying tshim mang po bgrong bar byung ste/ khyod dgos cha gang 'dod yod pa'i skabs/ dkon mchog la mi mchod/ dge ba mi byed par rang gis yog zas dang yog 'thung kho na byas/ da rang la dgos dus med thabs med pa'i yo byad rnams mi 'dzom pa 'di/ dkon mchog gi sku yogs 'go ma rnams kyi brda gtong yin/ snying re tshim/ da dung 'di bas kyang ches che ba'i na tsha sdug bsngal thams cad spungs shig snyam pa kho na yang yang rang zhugs la byung*/ de nas snga dro zhigame tog char pa spos chu dang 'dres 'bab pa yis/ /dmyal ba'i me mdag chil chil gsod pa mthong gyur nas/ /glo bur bde bas tshim pa 'di ci bsams pa dang*/ /sems dmyal rnams kyi phyag na pad+ma mthong bar shog/ ces pa spyod 'jug gi tshig 'di yang yang dran pas rkyen byas nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 'ba' zhig yid la dran zhing*/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po mchi ma rang dbang med par 'chor ba de ka zhag po gnyis gsum zhig shugs 'byung la byung*/

de ka'i ngang la nyin gcig gnyid chogs te/ gnyid du 'phri tsam song ba na/ 'phags pa sems nyid ngal gso 'dra rung ba'i sku'i rnam pa gsal po zhig khra lam gyis byung*/ gnyid sad pa na/ de 'phral rang du khams cung zad bder song 'dugade nas zhag po gnyis gsum na nad rags pa de gragasngar rab gnas kyi skabs nas/ rang gi grwa rigs su gtogs pa dgon tha dad nas 'dus pa/ chos thob 'dod can mang po yod pa la/ sgom chen bya bral snyom chung gi rigs 'di dad pa che bas 'tsho ba rang rgyags la brten zhing*/ chos kyi dgug sdod byed mkhan kho nas mtha' 'khor nas yod pas/ khams tsho zin tsam nas gzung*/ grwa rigs pho mo kho na lnga brgya tsam dang*/ yon bdag skye bo ci rigs pa dang bcas mang po la tshogs chos su dbang bskur rjes gnang grangs mang ba dang*/ nai gu chos drug gis sna drangs shangs chos cha tshang sogs 'khrid sna mang du byas/ snying po don rgyud rang sems ngo sprod pa yin pas/ 'khrid gsar pa'i rigs ngo sprod zhu 'dod shin tu mang ba 'dug pa rnams la'ang*/ so sor ngo sprod 'thems rgyas su byas pa rnams/ 'khrid thebs tshul yang legs rab byung*/ grwa rigs yon bdag so sos rang la gang yod che 'byor chung 'byor du byin pa'i rnam grangs kyang shin tu mang*/ lar bka' brgyud pa'i sgom chen 'di rnams la/ sngon gyi spyan ltos bzang po'i rgyun 'di kha ngo mtshar che bar gda'/ lus longs spyod bla ma'i phyogs su btang nas/ ngas byas dang drin bgrang bar mi byed/ bla ma'i dkor la shin tu 'dzem zhing rang la lan gyi re ba mi byed pas/ so sor yang rten 'brel cung zad re 'grig nas/ rang rang la yang mdun ma tha shal rang min tsam re dang*/ sde de la'ang dge mtshan 'phran bu re dang*/ dus dang dbang po la bltos pa'i dge sbyor skye tshul 'phran du re yang 'phral du yod kyin 'dugasngon sger sgom zhig pos/ bla ma ka ba can pa'i rtsar byon pa'i dpe bzhin yin/
