chos phar bshad dgos/ zhabs tog phar byed dgos/ phyag phar la stob dgos/ drin tshur la 'ded du 'ong*/ nga la ni btsun pa'i slob mas dgos pa med zer nas/ yun ring du mjal kha ma btang skad/ cha cig nas de yang bden por gda'o/ / de skabs bo dong dang sher dkar gyi mkhan po rje 'phags chen pa gshegs pas gshegs rdzong gi gral dbu la blon po dgon par yong dgos tshul gyi nan chags la/ chos rje nam mkha' rdo rje ba rang phebs byung na'ang*/ khams mi bde ba'i 'phros kyang yod/ yun ring sdod long yang med nas 'gro ba ma thub pas skal ba tshur skyel bar mdzad/ rgya lung du'ang 'du khang gi logs bris gsar bzhengs kyi rab gnas la 'gro dgos yin yang 'gro ma thub/ de skabs phyogs de kun tu'ang phyi nang gi rten 'brel sgrig rgyu 'ga' re 'dug pa nas/ g.yas g.yon stod smad kyi ri rnams la gtor ma mang po btang*/ rten 'brel phyogs re tsam nas 'grig pa yar byung*/ rgyan bu rdzong dpon gnyis dang phrad pa'i tshe/ dam tshig shin tu mi gtsang zhing*/ khog nang sol ba ltar byas pa la phan tshun gnyis thad nas kha mdzes mdzes ltar byed dgos pa de don shin tu chung zhing*/ khyad par phyogs de na rtsub 'gyur mang du mthong*/ kho tshos phar lam gzhi len byed pa'i rtsis kyang byas/ brag stod du mi mtho sogs 'dug kyang*/ de thams cad kyis rig tshor med par thog rgyag tu bteg nas phyin/ rgyan bu'i gdong thad rang la phyin kyang su yang gis rig tshor ma byung*/ de nub sngo ma lung du bsdad de cung zad 'tshub pa zhig ka byung*/ nang par rgyan bu rdzong dpon tshe legs pa/ byang phyogs la 'gro rgyu yin 'dug pas/ la de la 'phrang yod dam zer mkhan 'dug kyang 'phrad ma byung*/ khong de nas zla gcig lhag tsam nas ngam ring du thog phog pa'i rkyen gyis shi 'dugade nas mtsho sgo'i thad kyi chu byang kha der mtsho sgo grwa tshang gi slob dpon ar ba chen po yin zer ba'i srad pa de sogs mtsho sgo'i skya ser rags rim rnams 'phrad par byung*/

khong de lo kham mchu rgyal ba yin zer nas pho bzo che ba'i skabs su 'duganged rnams de la brten pa'i phyogs las rgyal gyi tha snyad byed pa sogs bzhad gad che bar byung ba de ka rten 'brel shin tu mi legs pa'i rnam par 'dug go / skabs der dgra thangs nas bla chen chos rje de sku gshegs pa'i bsngo rten skyel mkhan sleb/ khong bstan pa la phan pa'i dge bshes cig yod pas shin tu phangs pa byung*/ de nas sngar gyi 'bod mi nan chags kyi rgyun yod pa ltar rim pas gting skyes su sleb/ zla gcig lhag pa zhig bsdad/ zhal ngo rnams la dgongs bzhed ltar dbang chos sngar khyud ltar phul/ khyad par dge bshes 'ga' re dang bcas pa la/ sngags kyi lam rim tshigs bcad bcu pa'i bshad pa chos thun bdun la rdzogs pa cig bshad/ de bzhin du dbus mtha' rnam 'byed kyi bshad pa zhib pa zhig byas pa phyed lhag tsam song*/ 'di rnams thog khar rab 'byams pa bkra shis phun tshogs kyis kyang nges por nyan/ mang rab zhig la gcod kyi 'khrid dang lung bka' zhib cig kyang byas/ brag dkar mgon khang mjal ba dang*/

gsang sngags ri bor yang khor tsam byin/ brag dkar ltag ri dang*/ gsang ri'i ltag ri gnyis kar du gtor ma rgya che tsam re yang btang*/ phyogs der yon bdag gi bar chad rags rim sel ba'i ltas kyang byung*/ rgyal bu dbang gi rgyal po ba chos la thugs 'dun che bar yod pa ltar/ phyag thog tu longs pa'i dbu skra bsil/ mtshan kun dga' ye shes rgya mtshor btags/ dge mtshan khyad par can sbyar bas legs po byung*/ dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ sde ba ma chen gyis kyang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa len par mdzad/ sngar yod res kyis byed pa ltar mi 'tshogs 'dus che ba la khrom dbang yang byas shing*/ dbyar kha de rang shugs kyis 'khru sbyongs yang yang byung bas sngar na ba'i nad kyi gzhug de yangs sangs te grag nas re zhig lus rnal du gnas par byung*/ gam pa nas bdag po dgra 'dul drung snga sor nas spyi spyi nang gi sgos sgos thugs nyer ba'i khungs rang yin zhing*/ jo nang dang brag stod sogs thams cad du mi yang yang gnang ba zhig yod kyang*/ bla ma'i tshul can mi nag pa 'ga' zhig gi thugs bsgyur ba yin nam/ dus gzengs gra sgrig gis yin snyam pa'i rtog ngan ni shar/ gang ltar yang thugs 'gyur ba'i 'di skabs yig 'brel tsam yang ma byung*/ de nas tshur lam gzhong rma bya rdzong du zhag gcig bsdad cing*/ snga sor byang nas gsung bkod yod pa ltar/ rma bya'i chos sde 'di rdo rings kun spangs chos rje dang*/ bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa de kun gyis zhal bdag mdzad pa'i rgyun yin pa bzhin/ nged rang gis kyang 'dzin skyong gi khul du byas pas da lta'i bar du legs par yang byung*/ tshur lam 'bod mi nan chags ltar gdong dga' phyogs su chas/ rdzong la ni 'di res ye ma phyin/ klu sdings der zhag gnyis bsdad/ dril bu pa'i dbang zhig byas/ ltas kyang bzang rgyu med tsam byung*/ 'dam la la 'ongs nas rtsad skor du sleb/

de nyin lam la 'brog pa 'dra byin rlabs zhu bar byung*/ skad cha dris pas nged tsho rgya rgan nang so'i g.yog yin gyin 'dugakhrol le ma'i gdong der lo chen dbon po mkhas btsun bsu ba la byung ba 'dred thag byung nas 'gyel/ phyis dgon pa nged la yong ba'i rten 'brel du 'dugade nas rtsad skor rang gi rdzong dang dgon pa gnyis kar na su yang ma bsdad pa'i stong seng seng ba cig dang*/ sang zhogs de rdzong dpon yang sleb nas/ phyir 'ongs dus skyel thag shin tu ring ba dang*/ gzhan yang tshig bkra sogs nas 'pho 'jug yod pa'i rten 'brel rnams shar/ jo nang du sleb nas mkha' spyod bde ldan gyi khang pa la/ zhal dro'i phyir du zhag gcig bsdad/ khang bkod rnams bkod pa bzhin ma byung ba'i blo khengs pa rang ma byung na'ang*/ re zhig de khas chog pa'i lugs su byas/ gzhong stod du gtor ma rgya che ba zhig btang*/ de nas 'bring bu phyogs su myur du sleb dgos yod pas mgyogs po 'gro grabs yin pa la/ ngam ring nas lhun grub spe'u ba kun dga' dang*/ byams bkras pa sogs mi sna snga phyi mang po bstud mar gnang ba'i dgun tsam gyi bar 'gro ba bshol 'then nan bcags rang mdzad/ de tsam 'then mi thub pa rang zhus pas/ 'phral du 'phral dgos pa yin pas rgyang tsam 'then dgos tshul gyi nan bcags lung med mdzad pas zla gcig tsam 'gyangs/ de'i dgug stod stabs mtshams thung tsam gcig kyang byas/ de grol nas shangs chos kyi dbang byin rlabs gal che ba 'dra byed tshul gsal bar bkod pa gcig kyang brtsams/ de rjes mi ring bar byang zhabs drung rang lha dbang rtser phebs zhor la/ mar lam jo nang du phebs dus kyang nam mkha' dngas po yod 'phro la/ 'phral rang du dus min gyi rlung chen po langs pa dang*/ mdzod pa sogs phebs bsu byed rgyu'i khungs la rta rnams smyo ba sogs dang*/ gzhan yang 'tshub cha che ba rang byung zhag gcig bzhugs/

zhang gro sgrub sde pa rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs zhig zhur byung ba la yang byas/ lha dbang rtse 'gro rgyu'i dus thog snga ma de la glo bur du khams ma bde ba zhig byung nas cung zad cig 'gyangs/ de rjes lha dbang rtser byin dus kyang*/ zla rgyab kyi bsu ba'i sar yang cung zad 'tshub pa'i rnam pa rang byung zhing*/ rdzong rtser sleb pa dang nyi ma bzhud pa dus mnyam pa 'dra ba'i rten 'brel la yang rtog dpyod shar/ sngar lha rtser yongs skabs dang*/ 'di res gnyis kar du dpon g.yog drung skor gzigs chung ba sogs thams cad/ 'brug pa'i bu chen rje mog pa lha rtse ba ngag dbang bzang po slob ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i bsngags brjod kho na'i 'phyar rgyag dang*/ bem po lcags nag po 'gro 'ong 'du 'tshog mgur ma dbyangs rta rkang dung gi brda skad nyin re bzhin khor mor yong ba zhig ka 'dug pa/ 'jig rten phyogs kyi phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgo thams cad ni bzhad gad kyi rgyu kho nar 'dugarten 'brel ni mi legs pa rang yin par snang na'ang*/ drung skor nang gzan tsho ni nged tsho'i rtsar yang ngom ngom byed kyin 'dugang yi bsam pa la ni g.ya' g.ya' dang*/ pha pha'i dang*/ tha'i tha'i/ 'um 'um ste bzhi po de kho na byung*/ spyir chos su bzang ta cha gcig nas mi shes te/ skabs su bab pa gcig byed dgos/ bya byed gang dga' ta mi shes te/ dus dang bstun pa cig byed dgos/ tshad pa'i sman la ga bur las bzang ba med kyang*/ tshad pa ma smin pa la dug tu 'gro'o/ / yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ rgyal khams gzhan gyi gling brjod re zhig bzhagabod yul 'di na nged grub mtha' tha dad yin/ lta ba tha dad yin zer nas ko long mgo gas gas dang*/ ske 'phreng wa ba ras ras byed kyin 'dug ste/ spyir nang pa yin/ sgos su theg chen pa/ yang sgos su dbu ma par khas blangs byin/ grub mtha' tha dad yong don ni mi 'dugayod rang yod na ni so so tha dad nas su bzang su ngan yang*/

nang 'thab dme 'khrug shor ba'i mi ngan grib can rkyang par 'gro nyen yod lar bod 'dir sngon chos kyi bka' srol rkang 'dzin so so du ma zhig byung 'dug kyang dge 'dun shas cher rigs su ma chad spyi la bzhugs/ da lta chos kyi bka' srol mang po zhig ni nub/ ma nub pa tsho la'ang gzhan rnams la rkang 'dzin cher mi gda'/ dge 'dun ni spyi la bzhugs mkhan su yang med/ thams cad a ma kha zhags la song*/ sa dge bka' gsum dang rnying ma bar grags pa ste bzhi po 'di sgra che bar gda'/ de dag tu ma gtogs ci rigs pa deng sang yang yod mod zhen 'then mkhan skya ser nyung*/ bar skabs lan cig dge ldan pa'i lugs dar rgyas che grags pa snying du ma sdug nas sa bka' rnying gsum grub mtha' gcig zer gyin dpung pa phyogs su gzhibs/ mdun ma gcig tu sgril rgyu'i khungs byas/ dge ldan pa la phyir 'bud kyi 'char ka brjod 'dogs yid la dran tshad kha nas bton/ de'i lan du khong tshos kyang tshur la khyed rnams thams cad la thar pa thob pa'i chos yod ri shi byas pas/ bod yul gyi bstan pa'i thed ro cung zad yod pa de'ang rnam pa du mar gyes/ phan tshun thams cad bya rog dang 'ug pa'i tshul du song ba der gda'/ sa bka' rnying gsum ni grub mtha' gcig rung mi gcig rung gcig go zhes khas blangs pa de yin/ rje btsun tsong kha pa chen pos mdo sngags thams cad du chos skad sngar gyi bod rnying pa dang mi 'dra tsam ci rigs pa mdzad pa ni bden te/ 'on kyang khong gi bzhed pa thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyi nang nas/ kha cig gis sum cha tsam/ la las phyed tsam/ 'ga' zhig gis sum gnyis tsam/ gzhan rags thams cad byas te grub mtha' rnying par 'dod pa phal cher yang de'i grub mtha' khas len par 'dugader ma zad sgom pa la khyad yod srid/ go yul gyi lta ba rang la tshig tsam min pa khyad che rang he he/ de'i lugs de nag po yin rang yin na/

gzhan phal cher yang nag khra ru ka yong nye gda'/ des na ming btags so sor 'dzin pa tsam ma gtogs/ grub mtha' gsar rnying gi dbye ba rang cig yod yod mi 'dra/ phyis deng sang bka' rgyud du grags pa'i rkang 'dzin gyi gtso bo gnam dbrol ba de/ kar 'brug gnyis su gda' na'ang*/ de'i nang tshan rje btsun mi la'i lugs yin zer ba'i dbu ma bsgom tshul na shing rta'i dpyad pa bdun gyi sgo nas bsgom tshul dpyad sgom gsal bor bris pa dang*/ yang chen po gzhan zhig gis/ dbu ma 'jug pa dang phyag chen don gcig gsungs shing*/ lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi man ngag gi nang du dbu ma'i gtan tshigs chen po bzhi bsgom dgos skad pa'i/ mdor na phyis kyi bka' rgyud pa skad chen rgyang grags kyi bshes gnyen tsho yang*/ dge lugs dang 'dra min la de'i lugs kyi gnad kyang ma longs/ de las khungs kyang chung ngu song ba cig byas/ rang lugs su 'dod pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams dang 'gal khyab tu song ba de dpa' lor khyair nas ngo so 'phyar mkhan kho nar 'dugades na lta spyod sgom gsum kun phan tshun 'dra se ba rkyang pa la/ 'khrug long mang po yod pa 'di rnyed bkur dang kha drag snying la bzhag pas lan/ ji skad du/ rgyud las/ 'dzin cing mchod pa byed pa ni/ / 'tsho ba'i thabs kyi rgyu phyir ro/ / zhes gsungs pa der gda'/ 'phros don gyi cal col la zad pa med/ dgos nges kyi gnad don la sgril pa zhu/ mi shes rab can kun 'o re rgyal/ 'phral dbyings su bcad na dga' ba yin/ / da sngar gyi 'phros bshad na/ de skabs bya mchu ba rnam rgyal rtogs ldan byas pa la dpon g.yog thams cad smon pa'i gnas su mdzad kyin 'dug ste/ slar khong pas 'phral nyid du rang rtags bstan pa de gsar 'grogs chen po rnams la snying re tshim mo/ / 'di'i rigs ka yang yang yod par 'dug kyang*/ 'jungs med tsho la sun rgyu med/ dpag bsam 'khri shing las/

phal cher yongs su 'dris la sdad/ / rtag tu gsar pa gsar pa 'tshol/ / ring na gnas pa thams cad ni/ / kun gyi yid du 'ong ba yin/ / zhes 'byung ba de don la gnas pa zhig go / der 'phral du 'gro 'dod yin yang*/ gsung nan che ba'i mthar thug pa nas rgyang tsam sdod dgos shar/ sgrol ma bla med kyi chos skor cha tshang dang*/ gcod khrid sogs bzhed dgongs ltar phul/ chos gzhug ma de'i ming bkra la rtog pa cung zad byung*/ phyir yong dus snga dro'i dus dar sdings nas lcam gcig skra bcad la byon/ gzhon nu ma rgyan gyis brgyan pa chos kyi sgor 'jug pa sogs rang re la lam bkra de thog ma rang nas legs/ rkyang la'i la thog par zhabs drung dpon g.yog rnams kyis skyel ma la phebs/ ming bkra de la'ang rten 'brel gyi rtog dpyad cung zad byung zhing*/ lha rtse nas yar 'gro dus kyi skyel ma'i skabs dang*/ 'di skabs gnyis ka ru zhabs drung rang gis nan bcags mdzad de/ mi dmangs kyi dkyil der zhabs dbang re byed dgos byung ba la'ang*/ phyag g.yas phal cher bzhin 'gyur/ mun sros ba bzhin du nag thom thom par 'dugadapon g.yog rang la shin tu mi legs pa'i rten 'brel du go / brag ram dang e 'brog pa'i rtswa mtshams kyi kham mchu'i thad nas/ lha ri rtse pa rgyal chen gyis rngan pa chen po zos pa'i zhus stabs nas/ zhabs drung rang gi thugs kyang 'phral 'phral 'gyur 'gro ba'i da lta rang khrims drang po 'di dang 'di lta bu mdzad gsung ba'i zhal len yod 'phro la/ phra ma la khong tshos gang zhus 'dri pa dang*/ nags phug pa dang rtsod gzhi'i thad la yang*/ nged tsho'i mi gtor sku rgyal chad sgrub sogs 'gel ba ltar mdzad cing*/ lkog tu chad pa'i dngos po blangs grub grub pa de/ slar khong tsho la sprod pa sogs nged la phyi ma nang gi lugs yin pa la/ rang yang por gtong ba de 'dra mdzad kyin gda' 'o/ / skyel ma'i sa de nas rta thog khel nas yongs dus/

snod khengs pa thogs pa sum brgya tsam 'phreng du bsgrigs pa dang phrad pa sogs nged rang la ni lam bkra shin tu dge zhing bkra shis pa'i ngang nas/ lam bar du yang longs spyod chen po dang bcas te/ rim pas bkra shis sgang gi gru la 'thon de bsam grub rtser sleb/ de nyin phebs bsu'i sar/ thog mar rlung che zhing rjes la 'jam pa dang*/ rgya gar lho phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i bhā ḍa zhig gis skad gsangs mthon pos shis brjod byed pa sogs/ rtsub kyang rtsub la bzang yang bzang ba'i ltas su byung*/ 'di skabs zhag bcu lhag zhig bsdad/ rkyen sel gyi chos bka' 'bul dgos dkyus mthun du phul zhing*/ khyad par bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gsar bzhengs su mdzad pa rnams dang*/ nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi lugs sku sogs rten gsar bzhengs mang po la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas rab gnas zab rgyas su bgyis/ dkyil 'khor de kha'i steng nas zhabs drung yab sras rang dang*/ gzhan bla ma dge bshes gcig gnyis dang bcas pa la dbang bskur yang byas/ rab gnas kyi mnga' dbul grub mtshams der/ shing 'bras shin tu ser ba ka to ra gang mchod shoms kyi drung du 'bul mkhan byung*/ de yang phyogs nas glo bur du byung ba yin/ ched kyi sgrigs pa ma yin rang 'grigs byung ba/ phyi rtags kyi rten 'brel yang legs par go / dkyil 'khor sgrub dang*/ rten gyi ye shes spyan 'dren sogs kyi skabs nang rtags kyang legs te/ rab gnas shin tu zhal gro bar byung*/ de nas byang chen brgyud de/ tshong 'dus klu sdengs su 'byor/ tshong 'dus pa'i sde pa sku gzhon pa de chu nad kyis bsnyung bar 'dug pas rdzong rtse la phyin te/ tshe dbang dang gtor dbang zhig byas de phan thogs ni cang ma byung*/ de skabs nyang stod rtse chen rdzong la haṃ pa thebs/ dus zing chen po langs te/ rgyal khams gyi 'gyur ldog chen po de'i 'go tshugs so/

/ lar rgyal khams kyi 'gyur ldog chen po 'di 'dra cig yod pa'i ltas tsam lo mang po'i snga rol nas yang yang shar/ de stabs kyis snga mo'i dus yang yang 'gro dgos pa'i dpon rigs so so'i sar yang*/ mi dgos kha med rnams ma gtogs 'grau ba nyung ngu btang nas lo 'ga' shas song ba kun la gsal ba de ga yin/ dang po snga sor gzhon dus nas kyang 'grul shad pher ba rang cig med/ dge ldan pa dang karma'i bla ma slob dpon yod pa'i rigs dang po nas min/ 'gro ba la dga' shos de min pas/ lo star gyis dbus gtsang bskor nus pa cig kyang min/ de stabs nas rang re la nye zhing sha tsha bar rlom pa 'ga' res kyang*/ rje grol mchog de gcig tu yun ring mi bzhugs par thams cad du skor zhing gshegs pa yin/ khyed rang yang de bzhin rang byed dgos/ yon bdag so so'i dus dbang sogs la lo gcig ma sleb/ lo gnyis kyang ma sleb na rim pas 'gyur 'gro ba yin zer ba dang*/ khyad par 'di skabs kyi lo snga ma rnams la'ang*/ de 'dra'i rigs kyi gros 'debs byed pa mang du byung na 'ang*/ 'gyur 'gro ba'i rigs kyi slob ma dang yon bdag de/ re zhig ngo gang zin byas kyang phugs rtag thub pa cig mi yong*/

'gyur mkhan tsho rang 'gyur/ mi 'gyur mkhan tsho rang ma 'gyur snyam zhe med byas nas bzhag pa yin/ de khas la la ni ma 'gyur te/ ma 'gyur ba tshong lta'i bar du bde bar yod pa de yin/ re mang zhig 'gyur song ste/ nged kyi las stabs la ni ma gnod pa'i steng du gong 'phel la song*/ 'gyur ba cig la de tsholas 'gyur go bcad pa ma byung*/ khong rang rnams so sor khungs stongs pa'i dus su khur yang ba'i khe byung*/ lar nas dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob ma ni shin tu dkon/ 'jig rten 'phral dpe tsam gyi dpon slob dang*/ 'jig rten 'phral dpe tsam gyi yon mchod la skyag brtad cing yod/ phaṭa/ de nas bsam sdings su phyin/ zhag shas bsdad gtsang nas zhabs drung nyang sdod 'khor nas pa snam du phebs/ byang phyogs la dmag 'degs pa'i dpung gra sgrig pa'i skabs su 'dugadamag bshol ba'i zhu ba nan bcags bstud mar phul na'ang*/ da res 'di nyid byang lho brag dbus pa sogs khog 'grig pa'i nged tsho shul med la gtong rtsis kyi tshur bgegs kho na yin pas/ dmag bshol mi thub gsung yig rigs tsho ston pa mdzad pa'i rbad gcod kho na byung ba nas/ dmag bshol ni ma thub/ rim pa zhu ba gang legs byed pa'i lugs su byas de nas 'dol byung du zhag shas cig bsdad/ dbus la 'gro ba'i khungs kyi chas kha rnams der bzhag nas slar yang yongs/ yar lam rin chen gling du zhag gcig bsdad/ bar skabs lo 'ga' shas cigasde pa snar thang nas yig 'grul sogs kyang bcad/ 'brel thams cad spangs kyang*/ nged la gnod rgyu ni cang ma byung*/ 'di skabs sngar phar lam tshong 'dus su sleb skabs kyang ja 'dren dang*/ 'di ras kyang de'i sang nyin lam du thab 'dzin sogs gtong ba mdzad/ byang zhabs drung du snga sor bsam sdings nas snyan 'bul gyi zhu yig zhig kyang phul ba yin na'ang*/ thugs yid ma ches pa'i dgongs pa log pa zhig shar 'dugaskabs 'dir tshor yang*/

'jad shar phyogs pa sogs byang rang gi spyan lam du rgyug pa'i dpon rigs ci rigs pas kyang*/ kha 'don dang lag len gyi spyod pa sna tshogs zhig byed du byung na'ang*/ de 'dra la ma ltas par yang yongs jo nang du sleb mtshams khams ma bde bar zhag shas lus/ lhun grub spe'u pa kun dga' bskul ma car sdod byas shing*/ gzhan yang nyin re bzhin lha rtse nas byang zhabs drung gi phyag rtags bang chen sogs la/ bka' bkod 'phyar rgyag sna tshogs dang bcas pa'i nges nges rang med pa sha stag byung*/ khams mi bde bzhin du dings su phyin/ der yang khams shin tu mi bde bas zhag 'ga' shas 'gor zhing*/ 'di dang bde chen du rgyal rtse nas bdag po mthu stobs pa'i drung sogs kyi dkar yang byas chog pa'i zhu ngo dgos tshul byung ba ltar gtsang sar nan bcags zhus kyang don 'grub pa zhig ni ma byung*/ lar rang dus rgyun du mthong ye med pa la dgos gal 'di 'dra re byung dus khyod shes zer shor bar gda' 'o/ / sngar ni nged dang dge slong srad pa gnyis la phyi mthong 'dra 'dra yin/ sding mthong khong la che lags/ khong gis phan 'dogs gang byung ba de ngas kyang yod ba lags/ de rjes gtsang zhabs drung gi dgongs pa yang yang zhus/ cung zad tsam dgongs bzhes yod pa'i skabs/ nged kyis bde chen du sleb par byas/ snga sor nas ngam ring mkhan chen sogs mkhan slob spyi chos khrims gtso bor gyur pa mang dag gis/ dmag rnams sha ba lung nag tu sleb pa tsam nas gzung*/ skor g.yang 'dra byed tshul dang*/ khyad par byang pa rang gi phyag gi rten mchod snang che ba thams cad gtsang sa'i phyag tu song ni grub/ gser mang po bskyal yang ni zer/ bka' gsal ni tshig gcig kyang ma byung 'dugagal te byang par phan thogs cig byung na/ ngo so gzhan su la yang ma shor ba'i khong rang tshos byed bsams pa yang 'dugabyang zhabs drung rang nas kyang phar phyogs su de skabs dngos po 'bul sprod snga phyir gang dgos ci yin thams cad ngam ring chos sde pa kho na brgyud nas mdzad pa sogs/

byang pa rang la phan thogs sus byung kyang*/ ngo so de ngam ring chos sde pa sogs ngam ring rang gi gzhi sdod rtsa ba'i g.yog po'i rigs cig la yod pa byed dgongs pa dang*/ phyag g.yog phal cher yang de kho na snying la bzhag pa der 'dugangam ring mkhan slob sogs de dag ni byang pa la phan thogs byung na/ ngo so gang thub dang yus chen pos/ byang pa'i sa na gzhan su yang med pa'i chos srid gnyis ka kho rang tshos 'dzin/ gal te byang pa la phan thogs ma byung na byang pa'i nor phar sprad nas/ khong rang tsho pha rol gyi dpon rigs kha drag can re la sngon ma nas sgos dpon btsal nas 'ju thub pa byas pa'i phyis khas drag pa re byed snyam pa'i zar zir g.yo sgyu de ka ma gtogs mi 'dug na'ang*/ de mi dgongs pa dbu sbos 'dugangs nas snga ma nas de ltar go zhib shes kyang*/ byang rang du phan thogs gang drag zhi e yong bsam/ rang re'i mdzod pa kun dga' dpal bzang gis yang yang skor g.yang zhus zhing*/ sgo du ma nas nan bcags phul bas/ thog ma'i sa 'jags rags rim la yang phan thogs cher byung zhing*/ khyad par phra ma btang grub pa'i rjes su yang*/ zhu nan gang che zhus pas mus lung nang dang*/ bung chu 'khor sogs nged kyi ngo chen kho na la rten nas 'phar cha byung*/ byung zhabs drung rang nas snga sor lha dbang rtse nas nged 'gro dus/ stod smad kyi sde dpon gzhan so so ji ltar yin rung*/ byang nas gtsang sar log par 'gro ba sngar yang ma byas shing phyis kyang mi byed pas/ thugs yid ches shing blo brtan pas chog tshul dang*/ khyed kyis kyang de'i khag theg pas yod tshul zhu dgos gsungs pa'i nan bcags yod pa ltar/ bsam rtser phyin dus snyan du yang phul mod/ 'di skabs nyang byang lho dbus sogs sbrel pa'i yig tshang dang*/ byang rang gi phyag rtags dang yig ris mngon tshan can thams cad gtsang ba'i phyag tu thebs pa'i nged kyi mig lam du yang 'byor pa dang*/

byang zhabs drung rang la'ang slar ston pa gnang dus/ spyir zhu thes kyang med pa'i byed dka' ba dang*/ sgos su snga sor lha dbang rtse'i gsung dgos des nged kyang bslus shing khyi zan du bskyur bar song 'duga'adi skabs rang yang zhabs drung rang chos tshul mdzad/ lo gsum gyi bar la rdzong gzhis 'gangs che ba rnams nyis 'dzin du byas/ sa cha rnams rang mos pa la sbyar chog pa zhus/ de rjes thugs dam la sgril ba yin/ de'i ngo chen byed dgos gsung ba sogs phebs byung ba'ang zhib tu zhus ni zhus/ rgya zhing de tsam la thug nas byis pa'i gsung des mgo skor thongs ris min pa 'dug cing*/ de rjes lha rtse nas phar phebs dus kyang*/ nged kyi mi ma sleb pa la mkhan chen khyi gu ba dang*/ ngor pa mkhan drung sogs su yang yong ma nus/ dpon g.yog tsho rang shin tu skrag pas phebs mi nus pa'i gang drag ci drag tu 'dug pa la/ dgon bsam bar du kun dga' dpal bzang gis phebs skyel zhus/ dmag mi sna tshogs kha gtong 'dod nas ltad mo blta bar byung ba rnams kyang bsrungs/ snying thag pa nas zhabs tog tu gang 'gro byas/ bya ba'i 'gros dang gshis la dpags pa'i phan thogs kyang dga' tshad rang byung ba lags/ phar 'byon dus rngod pa'i rtogs ldan pas chibs sna byed pa sogs ya cha la bkra mi shis pa de 'dra'ang gda'/ 'di skabs lhun grub spe'u ba la'ang*/ sa 'jags sogs ye mi yong ba'i bka' bkyon gyi sgo 'dug kyang nan cher zhus pas sa cha phal cher skyon med du 'jags/ drang srong ba la srog la 'bab pa'i khrims gcod kyi bka' bkyon 'dug kyang*/ srog la skyon med par ma zad/ nor rnams ci bder thon cing*/ gter rgyus 'bras gshongs lto skal du byung ba dang*/ ya byang ba drung chen grags pa la yang*/ snga sor nas 'bul sprod 'bul dgos rnams 'gro mtshams ltas pa'i lo shas ma phul ba dang*/ dmag gi dus kyang sgyogs gcog gi gdams ngag byas pa sogs/

srog la bab pa'i bka' bkyon yod kyang*/ srog dang nor la skyon med cing*/ mchod gzhis brten nas rngo ma lung tsam 'jags pa dang*/ gdong dga' nas snga song nas gnyis ka mi 'gal ba yin yang*/ rjes la byang tshor mkhas nyams ngo so rnam grangs mang po de gtsang sar 'phog thug ches pa dang rgod pa skyon du song ba cig byung na'ang nan bcags zhus pas/ da lta'i sa cha 'di rnams rting la gnang ba yin/ gzhan yang dpon rigs mang po la bka' bkyon yod pa rnams la'ang ci rigs ci rigs su phan pa mang du byung*/ de bzhin du rgyan gnyer pa rnams gong du smos pa ltar/ brag stod la mig gi rwa las ma bde ba de yin kyang*/ de skabs chas kha thams cad brag stod du skyed dgos pa byung*/ gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa de ka la zer/ gzhan yang skabs 'dir/ gtsang gzhung chu lho byang mdog smad phal cher la/ nged kyi yul bsrung re btang bas/ dmag gis gnod pa ye ma byung*/ phyi nor nang nor khang zhing gang la yang ma skyon/ bdag po 'pho 'chug byung yang gnas khang skyon med du bsdad chog pa'ang nged kyi drin yin/ gzhan shag tshal yan chad dang*/ 'phyos ma yan chad la nged kyis bsrung mi btang ba rnams ma gtogs ji ltar gyur pa ni kun la gsal/ de skabs nged kyi dgon chos gzhis kun tu/ gzhan thams cad kyi nor skyed sa byas pas/ rgyal khams phal cher la nor gong ma byung ba yin/ nged kyi dgon gzhis 'di dag med pa'am yul bsrung ma btang ba zhig yin na/ gtsang mdog gi gzhung 'di dag kyang stong gog tsam lus pa'i lung stong zhig 'ong ba yod/ phan ni shin tu che ste drin shes pa ni phal cher la mi gda'/ mdo bshad pa dang*/ dril sna pa dang*/ khams rings pa la sogs pas 'brel ni che ste/ dang por sor gnas kyi dus na chos lung jo nang gnyis la/ dbang che'i ras gcod dang*/ bla ma dang chos lugs kyi sgo nas kyang*/ gzhan rnams khungs ma dang sangs rgyas mngon sum pa/

zhabs tog kyang ri ltar spungs/ 'di phyogs la bka' bkyon dang khyad gsod kho na byed/ 'brel pa chu thigs gcig kyang byung gi dogs byed mkhan mang po zhig par skabs der 'di phyogs su 'jigs skyob byed dgos byung zhing yang yul log gi skabs dgra'i dang mal sleb byung kyang*/ de ma thag kham tshul 'di bzhin song dus/ yang nged la yus chen po yod pa ltar/ re chen pos sleb byung ba na gnod lan ma byas par/ phan cung zad btags pa 'di bzhin yin pas/ chos pa'i tha ma rang zhig byed bsam pa med/ bden mi bden ji ltar yin so so nas bsam mno thong*/ rgyal khams la dris pas gsal/ gtsang nas sde srid kyang bde chen la nyin 'khor zhig dngos la 'phrad par phebs shing*/ nged kyis ri khrod chen por slar 'khor zhag shas song ba na/ sde srid dpon g.yog chibs rags rnams mar lam ri khrod chen po mjal ba'i dgongs pas phebs/ rnyed bkur zhabs tog bzang la rgya che ba yang mdzad/ zhag gsum bzhugs/ 'di dag gi snga phyir dgon mchod gzhis kyi rigs sbyor 'jags gnang ba/ bkra shis gling*/ rdzong mdun/ khram mda'/ khram phu/ chon brag sna mthil/ bo dong nas bkra shis sgang shar ba sogs them pa 'ga' shas dang*/ mdog nas 'dam bu bkra shis sgang rnams dang*/ la stod pha drug tu bkra shis 'dzom sogs mchod gzhis su sbyor 'jags gnang zhing*/ nags phug 'di sngar sa 'brel la brten nas sel cung zad yod pas ming bsgyur na phugs kyi rten 'brel legs par shes nas ming bkra shis gling du bsgyur ba yin/ de dag so so na yod pa'i dgon gnas ci rigs pa dang*/ mchod dgon gnas/ dgye bsu/ spru mche bsu/ gling sngon/ g.yag po/ bkra shis dge 'phel/ bkra shis rtse sogs dang bcas pa yang sbyor 'jags dang*/ de rjes mi ring bar mdog lho dgon gnas dang bcas pa'ang byung*/ dgon bsam 'bras spungs 'di lha rtse'i dmag gi skabs 'jigs skyob tu byang zhabs drung rang gis kyang bslab ston mdzad cing*/

chos brgyud kyang gcig pa'i dbang du byas/ nged kyi mi skyong gi khongs byas pas/ dgon gnas thams cad la dmag gi 'jigs pa sogs ma byung*/ de mthun sde srid kyis kyang nged la sbyor 'jags gnang*/ mus mda' dril sna cha lag dang bcas pa dang*/ lho pha drug gi mkhar lung gnyis thog mar kun dga' dpal bzang la gnang ba yin kyang*/ dge rgyun mchod thes su phul bas de mthun mchod gzhis nyid la sbyor 'jags gnang ba yin/ nang pa bod mkhar pa'i brgyud pa nang so rgya tsho ba rgyal chen gyis mdog gi gces dang*/ 'jad srug mo gnyis dge rgyun mchos thes su phul ba la yang*/ de rgyun la gnas pa'i 'jags gnas gnang*/ 'jad kyi dgon pa dngul chu chos rdzong*/ spo mthon sngags pa chos rje tshe ring bas nged la phul ba'ang sbyor 'jags rgyab gnod zhus shing gnang ba sogs/ mdor na mchod gzhis mchod thes nged tsho rang la bltos pa'i rgya che ba dge rgyun du sbyor ba mdzad/ de 'phral nyid dbus phyogs su dmag langs pa'i dpung chen dbus phyogs su 'gyogs pa mdzad song*/ de lo dgun 'khrid ni dus skabs yol bas bshol/ byang zhabs drung la bsnyel ja zhu bar bstan 'dzin sogs btang*/ khag drug ma gnyis dang*/ spob rtse bzhi/ kha thi yug sogs 'bul tshan bzang ba rang phul mod/ 'phral gyi ltar dgyes dgyes tsam yang med pa'i thugs khros se ba yod 'dugangam ring chos sde la mang ja re snga sor nas kyang gtong gin yod pas de mthun zhur btang yang*/ mkhan chen pas gtso mdzad las 'dzin phal cher zhig mang ja mi 'thung ba yin zer lkog shub dir dir byed kyin yod 'dug pas/ de phyin chad nas ngam ring la mang ja ma btang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun mngon sum du gyur pa cig ni deng sang gang byas mi rnyed/ rtags cha lugs tsam gyi dge 'dun ni gang du'ang rnyed par gda' 'o snyam mo/ / nged kyis 'dir sgrub sde grwa pa dang bcas pa la blo sbyong zhib pa cig byas/

dgun mtshams dam zhing thugs dam 'phel bar byung*/ bar skabs der dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'khyer bde ba 'di brtsams pa yin/ de nas 'phral du dbus phyogs su 'gro bar 'dod kyang*/ nye skor 'di kun na zi re ba zhig 'dug pa dang*/ rang re la sde srid kyis mchod gzhis gnang ba la/ don med phrag dog langs pa'i mig ma shong byed mkhan sna tshogs zhig 'dug pas/ re zhig 'di skor rang du bsdad/ dge sbyor 'phel bar byung zhing*/ gtor ma 'ga' re yang btang*/ rmi lam gyi ltas ngo mtshar che ba shas cig kyang byung*/ skabs cig khrol le ma nas lo chen sprul sku'i dbon po mkhas btsun pa nyug tsam phrad par byung dus khong gi rngam 'dre chen pos ja dang zho chang thams cad nyes/ bgegs skrod cig btang bas de 'phral khugs byung*/ skabs der phyag 'tshal la mo nas rdzong mdo'i bar gyi ri 'di dag gang rung cig la sdod gnas bya'am snyam pa'i blau yang yang skye ba zhig byung ste/ phyis dgon gnas 'di 'dings pa'i rten 'brel du 'dugahor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin rgyab ri jo 'bor skyong gi rtser gtor ma rgya che ba zhig gtong ba la phyin dus/

yar lam ri'i rtse 'og nas phar shin tu ngal zhing thang chad pa dang*/ rkang pa g.yas la rdo zur gyis gnod pa'i rma chen po byung ba sogs lhongs che se ba cig gi ngang nas gtor bsngo phyed tsam song ba na/ rtsub 'gyur dang khams nyog pa sangs rig pa dwangs shing dmigs pa gsal la zil che ba/ dam can chos skyong srungs ma rnams dngos su phang phung du 'dus pa'i nyams snang dang*/ khyod kyi 'dod don 'phrin las bdag gis bsgrub par bya'o/ / ze ba'i rnam pa byung zhing*/ 'jug tu bar chad zhi ba'i phyir phyogs mtshams brgyad la zor re 'phangs pas/ 'ur sgra dang*/ thug chom chen po dang*/ sde brgyad rnams rlung nag 'tshubs pa bzhin du phyogs bcur 'gro ba'i rnam pa byung*/ 'di skabs rtse chen chos sde'i chos bdag dge bsnyen bzang ra ba de/ lus g.yas bskul nas 'dir sleb byung pas/ spyir dpal jo nang pa'i bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs/ khong rang gi 'dod don la/ rtse chen gyi mkhan po la yongs dgos tshul du 'jug cing*/ gnas skabs su 'phrin las sgrub pa la gtor ma gsher ba'i tshul yang byed/ de skabs yar klungs kyi dus 'khrug la phyogs gtam sna tshogs smra ba zhig yod pa/ lus g.yar de mi rnams zer ba'i gtam sna tshogs de kha lab par 'dugabazang ra rang khog tu zhugs nas dmag gi gtam smra ba de/ de dang mi mthun par zhib rgyas mang po zer ba 'dug pa/ rting la de ka bden cig thigs par byung*/ de nas chad mdo mang po zhig byas nas log song*/ 'di skabs snga phyir rang re'i grwa pa gsar pa rnams la 'jig rten bstan bzhag dang bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyi mdo dang*/ gzungs dbang gi rgyal po'i mdo phyir tsam bshad pa yin te/ lo gzhon pa dang rjes la slob dpon dge rgan gyis nan bcags byed mkhan grul thub pa med pas rjes ye ma byung*/ de skabs yar 'brog nas dbon sa chu shul ma gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gra dbu la 'bod mir sde pa kha ba lung nas 'byor/

tshes bco lnga'i nyin mo bkra shis gling du phyin/ khrom dbang zhig kyang byas/ 'brug sgra cher bsgrags pa sogs/ rten 'brel gyi sgo 'ga' shas shar/ rtogs ldan bzang rgyan pa dang gleng brjod pa 'dra byas dus/ chos rje shongs chen pa dang*/ dpon po mkhas btsun pa dang*/ khams rings chos mdzad sogs la khong gis bo dong btsan thabs yun ring du bslab tshul sogs khong ra'i slob ma rnams ngoms par 'dugalar sems chung dga' mod 'dug ste/ bla chung phal cher la yod pa'i chos brgyad sad su de khong la'ang gda'o/ / snga sor lha rtse'i dmag grol ba nas 'di'i bar du phrag dog can gyi bla ma slob dpon sngags pa bon po dgon sde rigs mang po zhig nas/ nged la bsam sbyor ngan pa'i mthu btad ngan byed rbod gtong sna tshogs byas pa'i ltas mang po rang zhig rmi lam du shar byung na'ang*/ rnam rtog za ba'i snyems khrigs ye ma byung*/ ri rtser gtor ma chen po btang ba des/ de dag thams cad phar log pa'i ltas gsal po zhig tshes bco lnga'i dgongs mo de byung ste/ bdag rang khro bo'i sku gcig tu gyur nas/ ri nag po gcig bshig cing bsgyel ba dang*/ yang ngas mi nag po nyi shu rtsa 'dren zhig gi ske bcad de mgo rnams zos/ 'phro rnams g.yang sa la bskyur ba dang*/ ri brag shin tu mtho ba dog mo gcig tu/ rlung nag 'tshub ma mi bzad pa'i gseb nas/ 'jigs su rung ba'i gzugs kyis sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab 'dugathams cad bdag la rgol du byung ba la rang shar bden med sgyu ma lta bu shes nas/ de ka la bzhag pas nged rnams ma 'dzin par gtong rogs kyis zer de thams cad tsab tsob tu 'jug pa la/ phaṭa cig rgyab/ dbyings rig bsres nas bskyur btang bas/ nged rgyal po yin pa la/ nged btsan/ nged gza'/ nged klu yin pa la 'di 'dra byed pa a zer zhing tshom sding gi nam mkha' mtha' med pa cig la yas nas song*/ sems stong gsal g.yo ba med pa yun ring pa cig tu gnas byung*/

de mtshams cig nam mkha' nas snying rje sgoms snying rje sgoms zer ba'i sgra cig byung*/ spyir nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog rnams stong nyid rkyang pas lam du khyer na/ re zhig lam du longs yod kyang*/ ro ma gcig ldang nyen yod/ phugs mtha' gtsang yong ba la snying rjes zin pa dgos zer ba'i chos skad la brten nas/ lung bstan rdzus ma byed pa yin par ngo shes byung*/ mnyam gzhag de kha'i ngang nas 'di skad du/ snying rje'i rgyus dang nga che ste/ mdzo bdag gi klogs su mdzo rab ang*/ /sems can gdod nas med pa la/ /snying rje'o snyam na snyam mkhan 'khrul/ bya ba'i tshig de gsal por lhang gis shar zhing*/ slar gang du yang bzhags med pa'i mnyam bzhag de ga la/ la bzlas pas/ ja sbyor gnyis gsum tsam song ba na/ rig pa 'jam zhing bde ba mdangs byams snying rje ched bstad bsgoms pa ma yin par rang shugs su shar ba cig byung*/ sngar gyi 'jigs pa can de rnams gzugs mdzes pa'i rnam pa can du byas nas sgum sgum phyag 'tshal zhing bshags pa 'bul rjes su bzung du gsol zer ba'i rnam pa 'dug pa la yang*/ dga' tshor dang mtshan 'dzin dang*/ sred pa dang*/ rlom sems sogs gang yang ma byung ste/ tshig 'di skad ces thol te smras so/ / 'di thams cad nga rang gi rig pa'i rtsal/ / phyi snang srid lha 'dre ga la srid/ / khyod lha 'dre yul nas med pa la/ / rbod gtong dang gnod byed ga la yod/ / nang rig pa yod du skad byas kyang*/ / byar med kyi ngang la rig pa stor/ / sngar nga rang gi rig pa zer ba byas/ / nga rang nyid med pa la rig pa ci// lus snang ba 'di mi bden rdzun pa'i ngang*/ / sems rig pa ming stong sgra skad tsam/ khyed gnod pa byed na su la byed/ khyi blun po bya grib kyi rjes la rgyug/ snang srid kyi lha 'dre khyed rnams dang*/ / mi bdag ces ming skam tha dad kyang*/ / don rig pa gcig las gnyis su med/ / gnod bya gnod byed kyi rtsa ba bud/

/ khyed bshags pa 'bul na su la 'bul/ / lar bzod gsol len na su yis len/ / nyes pa ni rmi lam gyi bu dang 'dra/ / 'gyod tshangs ni nam mkha'i me tog yal/ / thugs rjes 'dzin bya dang 'dzin byed su/ / mtha' med kyi nam mkha' stong seng la/ / 'dzin 'dod kyi spar nom byed pa 'khrul/ / 'ja' tshon la rta rgyugs byed mkhan gang*/ / zhes pa la sogs pa nyams 'ur ba'i tshig mang du yod de/ de tsam ma gtogs da dgos brjed 'dugade nas de rnams khrag gi mchi ma nar nar phyung nas smon lam re btab/ lus sa la bor ba bzhin byas te yal song*/ de ltar byung ba 'di yang dngos rang ni ci yin rmi lam rang yang ma lags/ gnyid la ni ma song*/ gsal snang ni nyin mo las kyang che/ nyams sam de ka yin de 'ong*/ yang skabs 'dir smras pa/ nges don gyi gnad 'gag go ba 'dis chog/ mdo rgyud kyi dgongs don thal mar brdal/ / sangs rgyas su sgrog pa la re ma dgos/ khong kha sgrigs mkhan kun yi re mug/ lhan skyes kyi blo gros khong nas shar/ / 'gal 'brel gyi rig pa zad pa med/ /thal 'phreng la slob gnyer ma dgos tsam/ / pir skyog gi po ti kun rlung la bskur/ /rig pa rang grol 'di gdengs re thub/ / sde brgyad 'byung po kun bka' bzhin nyan/ /drag dmar gyi bsnyen pa la mi re tsam/ / rakasha dang thod 'phreng kun srang khar 'thor/ / phung po zan bsgyur 'dis go re chod/ / mthu btad dang 'dre kha la zhal skyengs byung*/ / yang bzlog la mur nyid mi dgos tsam/ / phur thogs kun gang dga' ci dga' gyis/ / stong nyid la 'dun pa sgyur bas chog/ sdang dgra la phyi rtags nang mar 'ong*/ / mdze thod la nor rnying 'chol mi dgos/ / rdzas 'khor lo kun rtsig phugs su rul rul 'dra/ / zhen med kyi snying rje 'di go chod po/ dgos nges kyi lha mi kun dbang du 'dus/ / pho rtags la phyag mchod mi dgos tsam/ / dbang sdud kyi sho ril kun chu la shor/ / rtsol med kyi bum can 'di go chod po/

/ bde drod kyi ngang la srog thur 'dres/ / rgod rkang dang lcags sbubs la mi re tsam/ khong sha sred 'bu sred kun 'o re brgyal/ / gang shar gyi lha sku go chod po/ / 'dod don kun gegs med lhun gyis 'grub/ / rnga brdung la mi tshe skyel ma dgos/ khong re dogs can kun dang 'dra re kan/ / zhes bya'o/ / de nas zla ba de kha'i tshes bco brgyad dang bcu dgu la/ dmag brda 'go ma rnams rgyab/ g.yas ru byad pa'i yul langs su grags pa/ dpon g.yog thams cad phung ba/ sku chags kyi zhig cha chen mo de mdzad/ mdo bshad pa dang drang srong pas nged kyi mchod gzhis gsar rnying thams cad la yang yul log gi dmag bskul la/ byang zhabs drung rang gi phyag rtags khyer nas sleb/ de skabs nged yar 'brog la 'brel du 'gro'i chas kha brdeg 'bru tshun chad grub pa yin na yang*/ zin bun ches pa'i stabs/ dgag dgos du ma 'dug pa nas/ de res 'gro ma thub/ skabs der 'bras spungs pa dang bde mchog rtse ba rnams snga sor rang re la 'jigs skyob kyi blo gtad byas pa yin kyang*/ bar der yul log gi gra la cung zad theb pa'i sdod lugs ma mkhas pa la brten/ byed lugs dang bstun pa'i yong lugs kyi rnam pas gzan so ci rigs pa byung*/ mtshed pa'i phyag g.yog rnams kyis yul log gi skabs mi 'tsham pa du ma byas yod kyang*/ re zhig sgros med du bzhag go / yul log gi zer bun che ba rang gi skabs der yang nged la ni do gal tsam ma byung ste/ mtsham mo ba'i khog nas dpa' 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg khri phrag lnga pa zhig dang rdo rje phag mo la yang de tsam zhig phul/ nyin gcig nag po chen po la yang stong phrag bzhi phul/ de dag gi ring la nyin mo kun dga' dpal bzang gis 'go byas/ gzhi sdod rnams kyis shar gyi shol ra chen mo'i shing 'debs rnams byed kyin bsdad/ rten 'brel legs pa zhig yin 'dugade dus btab pa'i shing la ma skyes pa cig kyang ma byung*/

phyogs nas yongs pa'i mi rnams na re/ gtsang mdog gnyis ka na yul langs dang*/ dmag gi shom lugs dang*/ da lta rang khyed kyi gnas dgon chos gzhi sa thams cad hab zas la gtong ba tsam gyis rngam 'jigs 'di 'dra la/ 'di ru sleb dus 'di 'dra'i sos dal ba rang ga 'dra yin nam zer mkhan rkyang ba byung*/ de dus rgya gan nas kyis 'go byas pa'i nyang gtsang gi pho yan sogs kyi dmag rnams ni lam la dal 'gros rang dang bo dong rang du yang zhag bzhi lnga bsdad/ 'di phyogs su yul langs mus mdog gi dmag rnams gzhi med du 'thor grub pa'i rjes la/ nyi ma gnyis gsum nas skad cha nges can tshor ba'i nom pa la rngams nas rgyugs/ de'i sngon la bo dong yan chad la ci yang yong ma nus/ gzhug tu yul 'joms dang ngam ring gi nor sogs nom pa la rngams rgyugs byas pa la dpa' rtags len pa de yang ya cha bar gda'/ gang ltar yul langs gtsang mdog gnyis car la dmag shin tu mang ba de rgyu mtshan med pa la byer pa de yang bsrung ma rnams kyi bka' chad yin par the tshom med do/ / mkha' 'gro chos skyong bya ba rbad bskul byas pa rkyang pas 'gro ba rang cig min/ dam tshig ma nyams shing chos bsgom pa la bu bzhin skyong ba cig yin lags/ de nas mi ring bar bde 'jam du song ba dang*/ rang yul nas a khu lags kyang sku na tshod smin grags pa'i 'gres nad kyis/ zhal ma bzhugs zer 'bod mkhan byung bas rkyen byas te 'phral du bteg grwa pa gang yod rnams khrid nas mtshed kyi mda'i gang rdzong chung chung der/ nged dbus nas 'khor gyi bar grwa pa rnams sdod sa byed pa byas/ nged kyis kyang zhag gnyis bsdad/ rim pas chas 'ongs pas/ dbu rgyan rdzong gi gru hrul po de la zhugs yongs dus/ ga nas byung cha med pa la bud med nag rul le ba 'jigs pa zhig gru nang du zhugs nas mnyam por byung*/ chu'i dkyil rang du sleb tsam la/ rlung nag lung med zhig langs gru thams cad chus khengs/

sdib la khad pa la/ snang stong sgyu ma rmi lam dang lta bur rang shar te/ snyems khrigs rbad kyis chod pa na/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku'i rnam pa zhig wal gyis shar/ de kha'i ngang la 'gram du sleb/ rlung yang zhi/ bud med de yang gar song ma byung*/ mdol byung du sleb dus gtsang sde srid kyang*/ dbus phyogs kyi byus legs shing yar lam rgyal rtser phebs pa dang 'dzom ste/ 'bod mkhan gnang byung ba ltar rgyal rtser phyin/ rtse chen rgyab kyi dga' thog na kha nas gzung chibs rags mang po dang*/ ya tshad nas chos sde'i ser bsgreng grangs mang zhing phyag khyer rol mo sogs bzab rgyas dpe med rang gi bkod shoms mdzad 'dugadagongs bzhed ltar gyi rkyen sel dbang chos ci rigs pa phul/ ngam ring nas byang zhabs drung rang phebs dgos byung ba'i skabs/ mnan gtad 'gom 'jog sogs kyi 'khor lo mang po bris pa rnams shul du lus pa'i rjes ngan bstan/ 'khor lo mang po zhig de skabs khyer 'dug pa/ nged kyi bkru sbyangs byas/ dge tsha chen mo'i gos sku 'grims pa'i nyin chos sde'i sku 'bum chen mor phyin/ chos sder mang ja sbrel ma dang*/ rta bzang ba gcig gis gtsos pa'i 'gyed dang*/ bsngo rten rnam gzhag thams cad kyang gang bzang rang bsgrubs/ rten mjal rnams zhib par byas/ bla brang du zhabs drung 'phags pa'i drung dang yang mjal skabs der zhag bcu tsam bsdad/ khang sar grwa tshang nas kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brnyan gsung 'byon ma spyan drangs de gsol ba btab/ re zhig rtse ru bzhugs na legs pa 'dra snyan du phul kyang*/ phyis grwa tshang bas nan bcags zhus nas de 'phral spyan drangs 'dugagazhan yang nyin re bzhin 'phel gdung la sku grib sel byed kyi sku khrus phul bas legs pa'i dge mtshan yang byung*/ snga sor rmi lam la/ rgyal rtse'i li ma lha khang na rten bcu lhag zhig ram me 'dugagazhan gang yang med pa'i stong sang nge ba de 'dra lan gnyis gsum byung ba/

de skabs mngon sum lta bur gyur 'dugade nas 'gro khar lhun grub spe'u nas rnams ngo chen zhu bar sleb/ rang res snyan du phul bas gang 'os cig yong gsung ba byung*/ 'gro ba dang thug pas rjes 'thud rgyu ma byung*/ da lta nyin byed gling pas ngo so yong tsam byas pa'i sa cha 'di yin/ byang rang gi dpon g.yog thams cad blo rigs 'dra ba cig ka gdogade skabs ri nang sngags 'chang ba yang 'phrad par byon/ khong shes rab spus gtsang zhing sgrub pa nus pa/ rnying ma ba'i lugs la nag chang gis ma khyer/ dge slong gi brtul zhugs la gnas pa'i gam gtsang ba zhig 'dug cing*/ / nged dang snang ba dag pa zhig yin na'ang*/ las sbyor dang 'dre 'dul 'ga' zhig gnad du ma song bas lan gda'/ skabs 'dir snying rlung la gnod byed kyis bskyod pa'i blo shin tu mi bde ba tshugs pa med pa 'dra ba zhig 'duganged kyis gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi dbang bskur zhig kyang byas/

cung zad bde ba tsam byung ste/ phyis mi ring bar 'tsho ma thub par 'dugarting la bsngo rten sogs skyel mkhan 'brang phur sleb byung ste/ smon lam dang sgrib sbyong gi dmigs btad yang yang byas/ drag sngags 'jig rten pa rnams mang pa'i skyon yin nam/ shin tu rtsub pa'i rnam 'gyur cig gi ngang nas/ 'jug tu lam bde ba'i ltas tsam ni byung ngo*/ / de skabs mus gling ga sogs mus stod kyi dgon pa rnams dang*/ dbus kyi gra thang dang*/ byams pa gling gi 'dzin skyong byed dgos phebs kyin 'dug na'ang*/ mi phal cher gyi mig lam du mi bde zhing rdzong dpon gyi rigs shin tu rang ma dga' ba cig yong ba dang*/ nges don kyi bstan pa la phan pa ni mi yong ba 'dug pas/ de dus rang yang dgongs grol zhus/ phyis yi ge 'ga' re phul bas ston ser kha cig khrol byung*/ de skabs nged rgyal rtse nas g.yung gi la brgyud nas phyin pas/ g.yung dar rgyas pa rnams kyis 'bod mi nan bcags byung nas/ lam zhor la khor tsam phyin/ mang ja 'gyed bcas sogs bsgrubs/ yar sris su yar 'brog nas thab 'dzin byung*/ mang ja 'gyed bcas sogs sgrubs/ de nas myur bar shad 'brang phur sleb/ cho ga sogs btsugs shing*/ dgon so sor mang ja 'gyed bcas/ mkha' rag tsho bzhi la thang ston sogs sku rjes bzang thag chod btang*/ de rjes bal po rgya mtsho sprin sogs bzo bo mkhas pa gsum gyis dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs rgya mtho gang pa re gar lugs su bzhengs pa dang*/ rang byung gi zangs la bcom ldan 'das sman pa'i rgyal po'i sku lugs ma mtho gang ba cig rnams nang rten gyi tshul du bzhengs pa/ de rnams bzo sgros shin tu gtsang ba rgya gar ba la 'gran bzod par byung*/ lung pa'i phu na yod pa'i sman chu de yang zhag shas bsten/ skabs cig gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud kyi man ngag la brten te/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgrub pa zhig byas pa yang*/

dri bzang pos lung nang thams cad chod pa dang*/ sgra chen po dang bcas pa byung*/ 'di skabs kyang bdud rtsi mang du babs/ 'grub legs shing ya mtshan che bar byung*/ mi ngo rnams la'ang tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs dang*/ dbang rjes gnang 'ga' re byas/ mes po rin po che de nyid kyi sku gdung yang dus de thub bzhugs pa dang*/ a khu lags kyi gdung de yang ring du bzhugs pa la dgos pa mi 'dug pas/ ngan song sbyong ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ / 'od bzhu'i cho ga zhib 'them dang bcas pa legs par bsgrubs/ 'di skabs zhig bsam 'grub rtse'i sku khrus rab 'byams pa dkon mchog dpal bzang 'das pa'i bsngo rten rnams 'byor/ khong 'dris che zhing nged la snang ba dag pa zhig yin pas rgyang tsam zhig smon lam mang du btab/ thebs pa'i rtags mtshan bzang tsam cig kyang byung*/ phyogs kyi chos zhu ba 'dra yang sleb/ rang re'i zla la yod pa'i nang zan rnams bde mchog gi cho ga de gtong gin yod pas/ / zhor la yang 'gro ba 'dug pa tshun 'khor lo bde mchog spyod 'chang dbang po'i lugs kyi gdams pa/ lam slong gi 'khrid snyan rgyud yongs rdzogs dang*/ gzhung drug gi bshad pa sogs chos skor cha tshang zhig bshad/ 'bras spungs pa rgya le chos mdzad 'das pa'i bsngo rten bzang rab cig skyel mkhan byung ba dang*/ 'tshur phu nas drung pa rin po che gu shi grags pa don grub kyi thugs dam gsal 'debs mtshon byed tsam skyel mkhan yang byung*/ pha tre bo sku skye rin po che'i sprul sku da lta'i 'di dang po rang gang du phebs brtag pa dang sku skye phebs pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ skabs 'dir yang yar 'brog nas spyan 'dren gyi brtag pa byed dgos pa'i nan bcags rang mchod dpon pas byed du byung bar ci rigs pa byas pa'ang lags/ de ltar 'brang du zla ba gsum la sna bstad pa zhig bsdad zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu skor la/ lha rgyal gling du sleb tsam dang*/

sde pa lha 'od pas shog gsung ba ltar g.yul rgyal rdzong du phyin/ tshe dbang dang*/ rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi rjes gnang sogs dgongs bzhed ltar phul/ lha mdongs kyi klu sdings der/ sde pa kun bzang pa sku mched sogs/ lha mdongs pa'i zhal ngo rnams dang phrad cing*/ 'o brgyal bar 'dug bsam ste/ brdab lan gang bzab rang phul/ yol rin chen gling du phyin/ mkhan chen blo gros rgyal mtshan pas gzhi len tshogs 'khor sogs bzab rgyas rang byung zhing*/ shangs chos kyi rigs byin rlabs mgon bka' sngar khong gis ma gsan pa mang dag cig bgyis/ der zhag gsum bsdad pa'i nyin gcig ri gong mjal ba la nyin 'khor byas/ mchod pa snyan dar tshogs 'khor sogs sngar gyi rgyun bzhin mtha' rgyas su bsgrubs/ sde pa dpal rgyas drung yang 'phrad du byung*/ chu shul rtser gro mo che pas yod dgos tshul nan bcags dpe med yin tshul byed kyin 'dug na'ang*/ kho bas grub mtha'i phyogs 'dzin yin gyu'i khungs kyis snga sor nas rin po gcig kyang ma byung*/ rdzong la ni ma phyin/ gzhom du gzhi len cig ni byung*/ mtshar pa snang bdag mo rje btsun drung gis shog gsung phyin/ dpon g.yog kha cig gi steng du/ shel grong dge slong sogs ri bde ba kha cig bsnan pa'i 'ga' shas la/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang dang*/ dgon pa ba rnams la chos 'brel cig dang*/ lha khang gi logs bris pa rab gnas rnams byas/ gzhi len sogs bzab rgyas rang mdzad na'ang*/ rten 'brel gyi sgo rnams tha mar rang zhig byung*/ ri bde sngar 'dzugs dus shangs pa bka' rgyud kyi lugs/ 'dzugs pa'i khungs mdzad kyang*/ bar skabs der thugs 'gyur grub nas lo gcig tsam song ba'i skabs de yin/ de nas rim gyis shin du sleb/ zhabs drung rin po che dang mjal zhag shas cig bsdad/ chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba yang skabs 'dir nged kyi zla la phebs byung*/ lha sar 'dzugs rgyu'i dar po che rnams brtsems/

rkyen sel gyi dbang rjes gnang 'dra phul/ de nas lha sar phyin/ 'di skabs zhag bdun bsdad/ dar po che btsugs pa'i skabs/ nam mkha' dwangs shing me tog gi char babs/ gzhan dar po che 'dzugs pa la mi mang lag mang dgos pa'i dka' las che tsam 'dug kyang*/ dka' ba ye ma dgos par/ nyi ma snga thog gcig la ka phal cher tshugs/ dar po che thog ma de slong bzhin pa'i ngang la/ mi mang po'i co dir gyi dbus/ dar shing yang 'phred gsegs la 'gul bzhin pa yin yang*/ dar shing gi rtse mor bya rog snum zhing bkrag dang ldan pa cig chags/ dar de rtsa ba nas lhongs lhongs kyi bar du chags chags pa de la bsdad/ de nas skad snyan po zhig 'don gyin lding 'khor byed pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas dang*/ yang lho phyogs kyi dar po che gzhan gcig la'ang de mtshungs byung*/ lha sa go gnyis thams cad du phyag mchod smon lam mar me sogs kyang dkyus mthun 'bul rgyu byung zhing*/ nyin re bzhin lha khang rnams lan gnyis gsum mjal ba sogs byas sems can thams cad la phan pa'i smon lam mang po btab/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brnyan gsung 'byon ma/ sku'i g.yas g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dang tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan te/ byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po de la/ sgos mchod 'bul ba sogs kyi gnad 'dug pas sgo 'byed gcod can gyi gzhugs khang byas shing*/ mchod rdzas cha tshang ba bshams/ smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma 'di yang de dus brtsams pa yin nub cig jo bo'i drung du yun ring smon lam 'debs shing bsdad/ ra mo cher sngon chad dar po che 'dzugs mkhan cher mi 'dug pa la/ dar po che 'dzugs pa'i srol brtod/ jo shag rnam pa gnyis dang kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brnyan la mchod pa phul nas smon lam btab pa'i skabs/ nyams snang gi tshul du ngo mtshar gyi gtam cung zad yod de gleng mi dgos par gda'/ snga sor 'brang na yod pa'i dus nas 'di'i bar du/

o rgyan gzhi ka nas bdag mo'i drung gi rtse zhabs drung gdung brgyud de'i dgongs rdzogs la yod dgos tshul gyi bskyar chags yang yang byung zhing*/ zhabs drung gdung brgyud de nyid la/ skra bcad tsam ma gtogs chos bka' thams cad nged kho nas phul ba yin pas gal che sa rang yin yang*/ de phyogs 'gro ba'i 'dun pa bstad res kyis rang gzhan gnyis kar gyi thad du ltas lod cing 'tshub pa kho na shar bas 'gro thes ni ma byung*/ zhabs drung bdag mo'ang thugs log cing*/ shun zhabs drung sogs rang re la thugs nye ba'i khungs rnams kyang da res 'gro dgos rgyu rang yin pa la/ zhes gyod rdal mang po gnang gin 'dug ste thabs ma byung*/ de nas shun du 'ongs te/ dpon g.yog skya ser phyogs kyi chos zhu ba dang bcas pa/ kar dge 'bru gsum sogs grub mtha' sna tshogs 'dus pa zhig la/ snga dro bzhin skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dang*/ nyin gung zhabs drung dpon g.yog nyung bsdus la/ shangs chos kyi skor dang*/ dbang rjes gnang ci rigs pa'i chos thun gnyis gsum re don gnyer so so dang bcas pa la byas shing*/ lan cig phug khang slob dpon pa bsod nams grags pa sngar 'dris yod pa ltar/ rgyud sde lnga'i dbang sogs 'dod chos 'ga' zhig zhu ba la byon byung ba/ thugs bzhed kyi chos rnams bshad/ khong dbang po dwangs shing*/ yon tan spus gtsang ba zhig 'dug pa la mngon spyod drag las la blo gzhol ba 'di phugs rang nyid la gyong chen por 'gro nyen yod snyam pa yang byung*/ gzhan mang po la'ang smras/ khong pa rang la'ang zur tsam gros 'debs byas pas/ 'phral bla ma'i sku rim tsam bsgrub pa la mi gzhan gyis phrag dog gi sgo nas brjod gleng byas pa ma gtogs/ de 'dra ye byas pa med gsung gin 'dug na'ang*/ phyis de bzhin thog tu babs pa kun la gsal/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas don gnyer mang dag la dbang bskur zhig kyang byas/

zhabs drung nas kyang gsan/ yang don gnyer mang dag la phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i 'khrid rgyas pa cig kyang bshad/ yung thang nag gur pa'i chos mdzad la yang ngo sprod bskyar ma dgos zer ba ltar byas shing*/ lha sar dar po che slong rgyu'i 'phros 'ga' re yod pa sogs/ slar yang lha sar phyin te de res zhag bzhi bsdad/ snga phyi sdoms par dar po che bcu bdun tsam bslangs/ 'di skabs stag lung nas sde pa'i zhabs drung yab sras dang*/ ban dpon kun dga' rgyal bzang sogs/ stag lung phyogs nas grwa rigs mang po dang*/ 'phan yul gyi phyogs nas bu slob yon bdag mang po zhig nges 'phrad par byung*/ so so la 'dod chos kyi 'brel ba re yang byas/ snga phyi gnyis kar sdod sa dga' ldan khang sar du byed dgos byung ste/ rgyal 'gong gi cho 'phrul che ba rang cig gda'/ se ra byes pa'i slob dpon sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud du gtogs pa yin gsung ba'i zhal snga nas 'khon btsun yang*/ nged la 'phrad par phebs shing dgongs bzhed kyi chos mang dag 'dug pa yang byas/ 'di skabs sde pa dga' ldan pas ni yig 'brel tsam yang ma byung*/ snga sor sde pa yid bzhin gtsang na bug de la yod pa'i skabs/ nged la ltos pa yod pa min yang*/ sde dpon drag kha zhig 'di ltar bzhugs dgos pa 'phangs bsams te/ zas nor gnyis ka nas 'brel ba gang drag zhus pa yin rung*/ 'di skabs ni khongs pas kyang cang med/ tshur lam yang shun du zhag shas cig bsdad nas/ phyir yongs dus zhabs drung nyid skyel mar yang phebs/ snye thang gser khang du zhag snga phyi gnyis mkhar rngar zhag gcig rnams bsdad/ chos rdzong gi gnas sngar ma mjal bas mjal du phyin/ mang ja 'gyed bcas cig btang*/ gser khang nas nang so gzhon pa rdo rje pad ma'i drung gis/ snying thag pa'i dad pas kun nas blangs te/ bde mchog chos gling gi sgrub sde 'dir gsar 'dzugs dang*/ khor rang gi sku skal dang gsar 'phar steng nas phogs sogs mchod thes thams cad sbyor ba'i bka' gros rnams byung zhing*/

de 'phral phyag thog tu 'khyon pa 'di yin/ bla ma dam pa ye shes dbang po la 'phrang phubs bshor kha 'bul gyin yod 'dugade skabs 'phra bu ba stongs pas snyems mda' nas sngar 'khyud e yong bde skyid par nan bcags la bas kyang ye ma byung*/ de nas skyid ru ba sde pa kun rgyal gyis 'bod mi nan bcags stabs/ 'phrang gong du zhag gnyis bsdad/ khrom dbang zhig kyang byas/ nub gnyis kar la shin tu 'tshub cha che ba dang*/ khyad par 'bras spung gi chos skyong mngon sum du 'ongs nas/ khang pa bsgyel ba'i tshul byed kyin 'dugade rjes kam pa la'i la rtse thub skyel ma la chos mdzad gsal yang mig gcig pa byung ba/ phyi lon gyi tshul du yong lugs 'di bzhin 'dug pas/ rim gro bzlog pa rgya che bar rang dgos tshul byas shing*/ de mthun rim gro than thun 'dra btang ba'i rigs yin pa 'dug na'ang*/ dbyings chen ma byung bas mi ring bar skyid ru ba rang la de bzhin shar song*/ de nub srin po rir bsdad/ sngar 'khyud ltar lha khang der nyal/ 'jun pa dpon g.yog rnams byon nas/ chos skyong seng ge nag po'i bskangs gso dang*/ rnga brdung gi 'ar 'ur mang po byed kyin 'duganam tho rangs tsa na hī hi zer ba'i sgra chen po gcig dang po thog ma pha tshad na yod snyam pa la/ rting la ri klung med khyab cing*/ nam mkha' mtha' med kyi bar du yang khyab pa 'dra ba cig yun ring rab byung*/ de nas gong dkar du 'byor/ gong ma khu dbon dang mjal/ sngar gyi rgyun ltar las thog mar rkyen sel rnams phul rjes spyir dbang chos rnams grangs mang rab byas/ khyad par du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje'i lugs kyi dbang khrid lung bshad pa rnams mtha' rgyas dang bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang*/ lwa ba pa dang*/ lang ka rgyal bzang gi 'grel ba'i lung sogs phul/ gzhan zur chos zhu mkhan rnam grangs mang ba la/ gang la gang 'tshams kyi rjes gnang 'khrid dmigs than thun mang du byas/

bzhi sde dbu mdzad sogs mang rab cig la nges don rgya mtsho'i lung dang*/ o rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi 'khrid sogs bshad/ chos sder khor tsam phyin zhing*/ sngar khyud kyi mchod pa snyan dar sogs kyang phul/ bla ma dam pa ye shes dbang po'i drung du dbang chos 'ga' yang zhus/ de nas rtser sgrol ma nyer gcig gi zhal thang gsar bzhengs rnams 'grems par mdzad nas/ rnam dag gtsug nor lugs kyi rjes gnang rnams phul/ sde pa sger pa rnams kyi thugs 'dod kyi gtso bo bstan 'dzin rin po che'i sku'i skye bar grags pa ngam ring nas yod pa 'di/ sku skye yin nam min/ 'gro don yong ngam mi yong brtag pa dgos zhes snga sor 'brang phur rje drung rtogs ldan pa gsung gin 'dug pas/ de skabs lha sar brtag pa byed par khas blangs/ skabs 'dir tshogs 'khor bzab pa cig dang bcas/ rjes drung sku bgres pas 'dri bar byon byung ba la/ brtag pa ji ltar shar ba bzhin/ rje bstan 'dzin rin po che'i thugs rgyud dngos yin min ci shes/

bar chad ma byung na 'gro don ni ci rigs pa yong ba 'dug smras pas/ sngar mtshan grags de byung phyin 'gro don yong na de chog par 'dug gsung*/ de 'phral spyan 'dren gyi thugs brtse brtad song*/ de nas bla ma dam pa ye shes dbang po rtser yang spyan 'dres zhus te/ spyir yang chos bka' 'ga' re zhus sngar rdo rje rings pa ba la thob zin yang byin rlabs kyi sgo zhig yod pas/ bdag med ma'i byin rlabs rgyas pa de zhus/ 'di shin tu byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan che bar byung*/ de nas yar lam yang 'brang phur yongs zla phyed skor zhig bsdad/ chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho ba la thub pa dgongs rgyan gyi 'dzug khrid zhig byas pa le'u dang po tsam song*/ lha rgyal gling dang 'de thung la sogs pa'i mchod gzhis la/ ban khral lam pa zhig byas pa'i grwa gsar rnams kyi skra phud re yang blangs/ 'di res zla phyed tsam bsdad/ rang re'i dbon pos kyang skra bcad byas/ 'brang nas yong ba'i snga dro rta thog tu ma mkhyon tsam la/ gzhis ka gong dkar nas paṇa chen chos mdzad ston pa'i sku brnyan 'dra bshus cig dang*/ rang res bkod pa byas nas bzhag pa'i dpal lha mo'i thang ka de yang grub 'dug pa khyer nas byung*/ rten 'brel legs par go rim pa'i sna dkar rtser 'byor/ zhal ngo khu dbon la tshe dbang sogs rkyen sel gyi rim pa rnams dang*/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i dbang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ gzhan don gnyer mang dag dang bcas pa la/ kun rig gi dbang dang*/ gzhan sngags pa 'ga' re la yang chos ci rigs dang*/ bla brang 'gag pa dpon slob rnams kyang yod pa la/ 'khrid ci rigs bshad/ yar 'brog tu sdod pa'i bar la/ mchod cha'i rigs ster mkhan byung ba kun/ bde mchog chos gling gi dgos che'i dbang du byas nas/ khong dpon slob la ster bar byas te/ ster mkhan mang po ni ma byung*/ gang byung ba rnams sprad/ a ma lags kyang khor tsam phebs byung*/

'di skabs sna dkar rtser dus rim thog tu 'byor ba'i sngags pa rnams kyis 'tshams sogs zing zing mang po 'dugazhag bco brgyad tsam bsdad/ de nas yar yong dus lam zhor la/ chos sde na dpon sa'i nang brten du thub dbang gi sku brnyan mi tshad gcig bzheng pa mdzad 'dug pa'i rab gnas la byin/ glo bur du rlung 'tshub chen po ldang ba dang*/ rab gnas grub mtshams la/ gshin po'i bsngo brten 'bul mkhan zhig kyang byung*/ phyir yong dus lam la yang rlung chen pos mtshams bcad pas 'dra bar zhig byung ba/ sde pa a khu drung pa de mi ring bar sku gshegs pa la blta ba 'dugade nub srin lag gnas su yang so so'i bsngo zhus dang*/ gzhi len byed mkhan sogs shin tu mang bar byung*/ de nas lam la rim pas rgyud de/ rgyal rtser sleb pa'i lcags mal ngal gsos/ chos sder mang ja 'gyed bcas mkhan chen 'phags pa'i drung du bsngo rten sogs sgrubs rtse chen gyi rgyab der yang slob dpon rnam pa spyi chos khrims thams cad 'phrad par byon/ 'dir yang mang ja 'gyed bcas sogs phul/ de nas 'brong rtse'i mdun du sde pa bgres pa rang byon pa'i ja 'dren zhig byung ba la/ glo bur du rlung 'tshub mi zad pa/ nyi ma'i 'od kyang 'gribs/ mun sros pa 'dra ba las phyogs thams cad sngo skya yal yal yod pa lta bu'i spyi dang mi 'dra ba rang zhig byung*/ 'dol byung du zhag shas bsdad cing*/ khong tsho'i dus rim dang thugazhal ngo tsho rang gi sku dog cung zad sel ba'i ltas shar/ 'dir skyid phug sku skye ba la gter ma'i chos ci rigs pa'i lung dang*/ brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa'i 'go zhig btsugs/ chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho bas kyang gsan/ de nas bsam sdings su zhag lnga tsam bsdad/ dgon pa ba rnams la chos 'brel du 'chi med kyi 'khrid zhes byas/ tshong 'dus su yongs skabs nyi ma dwangs po rang yong 'phro la/ phebs bsu'i sa nas klu sdings su sleb kyi bar la/

rlung nag mi bzad pa mun sros pa 'dra ba snga sor 'brong rtsed byung ba de 'dra ba zhig byung*/ 'brong rtse dang 'di'i ltas gnyis kar de 'phral du yang mkhar bshig sogs byung zhing*/ mi ring bar 'das grongs kyang ci rigs byung song ba la blta las che/ de nas zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu la bsam 'grub rtser sleb pa yin/ sleb 'phral la gza' skar dang bstun pa'i kun gzigs steng gi bzab khang la rab gnas kyang byas/ zhag shas snga sor gyi rgyun ltar tshe dbang sogs rkyen sel rnams rim can du phul/ 'dir zla gcig tsam lon nas/ brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa'i 'phros de yang*/ brtag pa phyi ma'i le'u gsum pa yan chad song de man chad bshad lung tsam byas/ de bar du sku skye ba sogs la gsar rnying ma nges pa'i lung 'dra yang bklags/ chos rje ye shes rgya mtsho'i drung yang zhal ngo rnams kyis spyan 'dren mdzad pa'i gting skyes rang la phebs song*/ 'phying ru gong dkar rdo rje gdan nas bla ma dam pa ye shes dbang po chos dbyings su sku thim pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba 'debs kyang sleb/ rten bzhengs ma tshar bar sde pa nas bshor 'debs zhig zhus pa'ang byung*/ bla ma dam pa de bya btang yin pas rten bzhengs kyi rgyu yang phal cher 'di nas ka bsrings pa yin/ nged shin tu bka' nan ches pa'i stabs/ 'di skabs yun ring ba zhig sdod dgos byung ste/ sde srid yab sras drung du dpal rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ dge legs su byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe lngar dbang bskur ba dang*/ gzhan yang don gnyer dge bshes 'ga' shas dang*/ khams pa grwa rigs 'ga' dang bcas pa la yang*/ dbang yongs su rdzogs pa tshar gcig byas/ dpal bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi skabs/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing*/ mchod pa'i bkod pa sogs cho ga mtha' rgyas dang gzhan yang gtor ma'i cho ga sogs rdo rje phreng ba dang*/

man ngag snye ma nas gsung pa ltar/ rang gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du sgrubs/ de skabs sde srid kyi phyag tu 'byor pa'i rten gyi rigs 'gangs che ba rnams la/ sku khrus dang rab gnas kha gso sogs dang*/ bkral btags kyi gur la bgegs sprod sogs kyang byas/ de rjes sde srid rang la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur yongs rdzogs zhig kyang bsgrubs/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i cho ga la brten pa'i drug cu rtsa bzhi'i lag len gyi yi ge cung zad rgyas pa 'di yang skabs 'di dag tu brtsams pa yin/ chos rje shangs pa slob dpon la brtag pa dang po'i le'u bdun pa yan chad kyi bshad pa tsam song*/ yang 'di skabs mdo khams byang ngos phyogs kyi dgon pa nyug rjes nas/ ka bzhi rgyal mtshan seng ge'i sku skye/ bla ma kun dga' lhun grub pa'i phyag g.yog gnyer pa yang byed pa/ sog po'i yul du 'dzam thang pa'i grwa rigs che chen nang so'i yang g.yogs grag kha byed pa/ kun dga' bkra shis zer ba de ka bzhi pa'i dpon po gnyis dang bcas pa rnams dbus gtsang gi gnas mjal dang*/ che chen nang so'i mang skol la byung ba dang brtun/ bla ma kun dga' lhun grub kyi 'bul skyel brda mtshon tsam dang*/ dbon po gnyis po yang re zhig chos zhu ba'i dbang du byas/ nged la dmigs nas byon/ kun dga' bkra shis g.yog mang dag dang bcas pa la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang*/ rgyud sde lnga'i dbang*/ gur zhal gyi rjes gnang sogs 'dod pa bzhin du byas/ 'di nas sog yul la bla ma zhig nges par rdzong dgos zer nas/ nan bcags ches pas kun dga' blo 'phel ba sogs grwa rigs 'ga' yang bla chas dang bcas te rgyal khams de dag tu 'gro don la rdzong dgos byung*/ de skabs khong rnams kyis 'dzam thang nas rje rgyal ba seng ge'i sku skye khams du byon pa de ni gshegs/ sku skye gnyis pa'i tshul de dbon po zhu tshang ri shing pa'i zhal ngo drang srong 'di yin zer bar 'dug pas/

'khrul med yin nam min brtag pa byed dgos zer ba/ cung zad brtags pas yin du ni rung yang*/ 'dzam thang phyogs su phan thogs pa ni mi yong zer ba byung*/ de kha ltar zhib rgyas su smras so/ / yang byang zhabs drung nas ngam ring du tshang slog mdzad rgyu byung yang*/ yong sgo yod ba'i mnga' zhabs lar med pas zhu ngo byed dgos gsung*/ de mthun ngo chen zhus pas yong sgo drag pa'i dbang du byas zur tsho skor rnams thams cad byung ba yin/ de skabs ngam ring chos sde pa rnams kyis/ kha snga bang mgyogs byas pas yong sgo drag shos gang sle sogs mang tshad gcig chos sde la 'jags grub 'dugaspyir sde pa las dge 'dun la byung ba de los dga' ste/ byang pa rang la kha 'gegs su song pa de yin/ sde srid nas nged la 'di skabs lho nas 'phyong lung 'brog pa dang*/ gtsang bsam 'grub bde chen ma lag skor bcas chos bzhis su sbyor 'jags gnang*/ rtag brtan gyi chos sde 'di 'dzugs pa'i bka' gros nges thams cad kyang de skabs byung ba lags/ sde pa lha srung drung yang chos skor 'jug pa mdzad de/ mtshan kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por btags/ de nas hor zla drug pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu skor la yang btegs nas chos 'khor rtsa'i mdo der snar thang nas thabs 'dzin cig kyang byung*/ byang chen du zhag gsum bzhi gcig bsdad/ gnas srin po ri'i klu sdings su zhag gcig bsdad pa/ gnas chos sde'i slob dpon sogs skya ser mang po zhig 'phrang mkhan yang byung*/ chos 'brel re yang byas/ lung nag shel dkar nas rgya gan nas chos dgos pa ci 'dra yod kyang*/ 'bod mi nan can rang gi stabs rdzong rtse la phyin zhag po gnyis bsdad/ tshe dbang dang gur mgon gyi gtor dbang dgos zer ba ltar byas/ de nas tshur lam brag ram gyi gnod sbyin la gtor ma zhig kyang dgos pa'i ltas byung ba dang*/ sngar yul de la ma phyin pas ji ltar 'dug lta ba dang*/

sbrags khor tsam phyin pas/ gnod sbyin de dgyes pa'i ltas cung zad byung*/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu bdun la jo nang du sleb/ grwa btsun rnams kyis bsu ba bzab rgyas byas shing zla gcig tsam ji ltar bde pa'i ngang nas/ khams po ngor dgon pa ba dbon po lhun grub sogs mang rab dang*/ ka bzhi dpon po sogs la chos kyi rnam grangs lam 'bras la sogs pa mang dag byas/ rang re'i grwa tshang gi grwa pa gsar pa rnams kyis sgrub dkyil rang res sgrigs pa 'di kha'i steng du nas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub mchod thog ma 'dzugs pa de/ jo nang rang gi ser kha sgrub mchod kyi steng du 'dzugs pa'i rtsis su byas nas/ bris thig gar sogs sngar nas sbyangs pa rnams kyang de skabs gra 'grig par byas/ hor zla bdun pa'i nang du chog grwa 'grig cing legs par byung*/ lo 'di'i nang du tsam me sdod ma dgos tsam la/ ya ma dang khrag ngan sogs kyis yang yang na ba zhig ka byung*/ sgrub mchod grol ba'i rjes la dpon po lhun grub sogs 'ga' zhig yul du mgyogs par ldog 'gro ba'i stabs sbyor drug cig kyang 'chad dgos byung*/ snga phyir bskul mkhan gzhan yang yod la/ khong tshos kyang bskul nas sbyor drug gi 'khrig yig che ba 'di brtsams/ de'i yan lag tu nges par dgos par mthong nas/ rtags tshad kyi yi ge ngo sprod phyi nang 'khrul 'khor rtsa 'grel rnams kyang ston ka de la ka bris pa yin/ 'dir sleb pa nas gzung de bar du sgrub gnas skyid phug bde ldan gyi zhig sos legs par grub pa dang*/ spyi khang skor sogs de lo yang las ka than thun mang du grub/ sku 'bum mthong grol chen mor bri'i skor khang la bzang sgrigs 'ba' zhig gi bla re dang*/ bum ldir la yang de mthun gyi bla re khor yug/ lha khang gzhan ma so sor bar skabs mdzod bzung dus bla bre gyag pa rnams la yang bla bre nyi shu skor cig phul/

'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char sogs ltas ngo mtshar che bar byung*/ rang re jo nang pa la bltos pa rnams tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan gsum gang dgos kyang sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo 'di la zhabs tog gi rten 'brel sgrig pa rang gal che ba 'duga'adi rtags mngon gyur du ston mkhan yin pas thams cad kyis 'bad 'bungs byed dgos so/ / gnas gzhi gsar du 'debs dgos de lo 'di la brtag pa ma chug cing*/ lo gsar nas shin tu bzang ba'i ltas shar pas de lo then pa yin/ de nas ston gzhug skyid phug tu rab gnas dang bstun te phyi mtshams me la bsdad/ sbyor drug gi bshad pa'i rtsom pa de'i 'go btsugs nas/ gzhi gtan la 'bebs pa'i skor rnams song ba tsam zhig nyin gung thun bar thun bar la bka' bcu ba kun dga' dbang phyug pas bris/ dbon po lhun grub sogs dang khong tshos nan gyis bskul nas/ lung rig rgya mtsho sogs 'di kha'i grwa pa 'ga' shas khams phyogs su 'gro don la 'gro 'dod rnams la so so'i 'dod chos than thun 'dra yang ma chag par byed dgos byung*/ de rjes khong rnams kyang khams phyogs la thegs/ de nas dgun khrid sngar lugs bzhin btsugs/ grwa pa gsar pa'i rigs mang po dang bcas/ 'khrid gsar pa ltos che bar byung*/ lo 'di la byang zhabs drung rang la bcur thag cung zad byung ba ni/ snying gi grogs thams cad thang la bor ba'i rnam pas/ rgyun du sku rim bsgrubs shing byang pa rang gi phyir du gzhan la gtor rgyag dang*/ mthu gtad byed mkhan gyi sngags pa'i rigs las thugs nye shos gcig gnyis ma gtogs/ phal cher 'di dang 'di yin no zhes gsal bar zhus pa'i sngags pa rnams la brul drag byung ba'i skabs de yin/ bla ma dkon mchog legs 'dzin pa nged la sngar nas 'dris che ba yin pa la/ khong gi sras po rgan pa de skyon che ba zhig med na'ang*/ 'phral gyi byed lugs ma shes pas/ bsam 'grub rtser btson nang du 'das/

slar dkon legs pa rang la yang dka' skyon gyi sgo 'dug pa dang*/ ngo chen zhib sed zhus pas sa skya'i sgo rum du mna' skyal bas chog par byung*/ ston pa rdo ra ba yang srog 'dzem la 'di khar bros/ phyis dgongs pa zhus pas yul la phyin chog par byung*/ des mtshon gzhan 'ga' re la yang phan thogs byung*/ snga sor ston ka phyag 'tshal la mo nas gtor ma zhig btang ba/ rmi lam du mdangs dkar gyi btsan de gtor ma'i skal ba chad zer slong ba'i rnam pa byung bas/ bar der mdangs dkar rdzong la gtor ma gnyis gsum zhig btang bas/ mi thams cad mdangs dkar la dgon pa gsar 'debs byed rgyu yin par 'dug zer ba'i tshod rgyag gis lung pa bkang*/ 'di skabs rtse chung gi la mgo la sde pa gzhung gi spe'u 'di rgyag ba mdzad song ste/ dgos pa rang ni cang mi gda'/ de dus rje btsun u rgyan mtsho mo'i sku skye'i drung*/ jo nang gi gnas mjal la phebs gsung ba zhig yod pa'i skabs/ rmi lam du khong dpon slob nang cig nas yar phebs nas/ mtshan brjod 'don gyin 'dug pas/ dum cig nas ma thon bar chad song*/ de nas 'dir phebs kyang ma byung ste/ khong rang dpon slob la 'phrin las kyi bar chad yong ba'i ltas su go /

dus khrid grol la khad la rgyal rtse nas bla ma zhabs drung yang phebs/ de nyid glo bur du 'braung rtser rlung 'tshub byung ba de ka 'dra ba zhig byung ste 'dir sku bsnyel ba de la blta ba yin nam/ de min ni legs par byung*/ tshogs su sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa zhig kyang byas/ 'dir smras pa/ legs pa'i yon tan 'char tshul brgya/ / shes bya'i mtha' la thug med 'char/ / bsod nams bral ba'i skye bo la/ / rtag tu nub pa'i mtshan mo nyid/ / nyin byed 'od zer gcig shar bas/ / yul phyogs bye ba brgya gsal yang*/ /byang ngam 'og tu kha bltas pa'i/ /phug par rtag tu mun pa nyid/ /skal ldan rnams la bla med byang chub myur ster zhing*/ /'gro ba kun la bden don mtha' yas 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /zab mo dbu ma bde gshegs snying po'i gtam 'di dang*/ /zab lam mthar thug rdo rje'i rnal 'byor las gzhan ci/ /zhes pa'ang bar skabs su smras pa'o/ / / / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bdag nyid kyi rnam thar nges par brjod pa'i rtogs brjod/ -PAGE 366--PAGE 217-
